name: Buckles or Clasps
definition: A pin buckle or clasp is a device used for fastening two loose ends, with one attached to it and the other held with a pin (also named prong) in a secure but adjustable manner, e.g. for watches or belts.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Buttons
definition: A button is usually a disk-like piece of solid material having holes or a shank through which it is sewed to one side of an article of clothing and used to fasten or close the garment by passing through a loop or hole in the other side.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cable Tie
definition: A cable tie or tie-wrap, also known as a hose tie, zap-strap, or zip tie,[1] is a type of fastener, for holding items together, primarily electric cables or wires.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Clip Bulldog
definition: A bulldog clip is a device for temporarily binding sheets of paper together. It consists of a rectangular sheet of springy steel curved into a cylinder, with two flat steel strips inserted to form combined handles and jaws. The user presses the two handles together, causing the jaws to open against the force of the spring, then inserts a stack of papers and releases the handles. The spring forces the jaws together, gripping the papers firmly.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Clip Paper
definition: A paper clip (or sometimes paperclip) is an instrument used to hold sheets of paper together, usually made of steel wire bent to a looped shape.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Folding Clasp
definition: The folding clasp is a type of closure for watch straps. It is most commonly found in metal bandes. In contrast to the pin buckle, the bracelet is not fully opened with the folding clasp but is opened (folded up) on hinges. This widens the bracelet and it can be removed from the arm.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Grommets
definition: Round grommets look like metal or plastic rings that help reinforce holes. A cord or lace threads through the hole, also known as the eye. A grommet press or a grommet setting tool and a small hammer help fasten the grommet to the garment. (See Reference 3) Examples of grommets are found on laced running shoes and laced clothing. A grommet belt allows a person to adjust the fit by inserting a buckle's metal pin through a reinforced hole.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hook and Eyes
definition: Hooks and eyes consist of two parts that interlock. The hook part features a curved shape. The eye has an opening which resembles a U-shape into which the hook is inserted to clsoe the item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hook and Loop Fasteners
definition: This variety of fastener is closed by pressure and opened by pulling it apart.  These fasteners are made of tiny, firm, hooks on one part and softer loops on the other. The size of the fastener indicates its holding strength.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Jeans Button
definition: A Jeans Button is generally used as a method of fastening for denim trousers or denim jackets.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Laces or Shoelaces
definition: Shoelaces, sometimes called shoestrings (US English) or bootlaces (UK English), are a system commonly used to secure shoes, boots and other footwear. Laces can also be used for other types of items, but function similarly to shoelaces.  Laces typically consist of a strings or cords, finished off at both ends with stiff sections, commonly known as aglets. The lace typically passes through a series of holes, eyelets, loops or hooks on either side of the closure. Loosening or removing the lacing allows the item to open, while tightening the lacing and tying off the ends secures the item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: sRGB
definition: sRGB defines the chromaticities of the red, green, and blue primaries, the colours where one of the three channels is nonzero and the other two are zero. The gamut of chromaticities that can be represented in sRGB is the colour triangle defined by these primaries. As with any RGB colour space, for non-negative values of R, G, and B it is not possible to represent colours outside this triangle, which is well inside the range of colours visible to a human with normal trichromatic vision. sRGB is sometimes avoided by high-end print publishing professionals because its colour gamut is not big enough, especially in the blue-green colours, to include all the colours that can be reproduced in CMYK printing.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hex-Value
definition: Colour-hex gives information about colours including colour models (RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK), Triadic colours, monochromatic colours and analogous colours calculated in colour page. Colour-hex.com also generates a simple css code for the selected colour. Common is the hexadecimal colour definition in six-digit form, that is, as a series of three hexadecimal numbers each written in two digits, according to the scheme: #RRGGBB. Reference for sample content: https://www.color-hex.com/
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

Pantone® Inc

name: Dispersible
definition: Dispersing agents have been added to the substance. Dispersing agents are added to process liquids to prevent unwanted deposits by keeping them finely dispersed. They function in both aqueous and non-aqueous media.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Emulsifiable
definition: An emulsion is a mixture of two immiscible (unblendable) liquids. One liquid is dispersed in the other. Many emulsions are oil/water emulsions, with dietary fats being one common type of oil encountered in everyday life. Examples of emulsions include butter and margarine, milk and cream, and vinaigrettes. In butter and margarine, fat surrounds droplets of water (a water-in-oil emulsion). In milk and cream, water surrounds droplets of fat (an oil-in-water emulsion).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Insoluble
definition: The substance is not capable of being dissolved in a solvent.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Not or Hardly Miscible
definition: The substance is immiscible or nearly immiscible. Substances are said to be immiscible if in any proportion, they do not form a solution. For example, diethyl ether is fairly soluble in water, but these two solvents are not miscible since they are not soluble in all proportions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Suspended
definition: The substance is in suspension. A suspension is a homogeneous fluid containing solid particles that are sufficiently large for sedimentation. When the solid is mixed with liquid, suspended particles will eventually settle. An example of a suspension would be sand in water. The suspended particles are visible under a microscope and will settle over time if left undisturbed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Water Soluble
definition: The substance is soluble. Solubility is the ability of a given substance to dissolve in a solvent. It is measured in terms of the maximum amount of solute dissolved in a solvent at equilibrium. Certain liquids are soluble in all proportions with a given solvent, such as ethanol in water.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Periodic Catch
definition: The catch date is reflective of seasonal catch like lobster trapping.
codeListDefinition: The process of how the fish is dated, for example REAL_TIME as fish are caught they are dated and time stamped like tuna, ONE_TIME_CATCH on a date for fish farming, or PERIODIC_CATCH meaning the catch date reflective of seasonal catch like lobster trappin

name: Real Time
definition: Fish are caught and are then dated and time stamped.

name: Calendar Date
definition: A date in a calendar is a reference to a particular day represented within a calendar system. The calendar date allows the specific day to be identified. The date uses a format expressed in three parts: year, month and day.  Other format orders may be used - The month may be expressed as a number or in alphabetic form (optionally abbreviated). This format is sometimes referred to as Numeric Date.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ordinal Date
definition: A calendar date consisting of a year and a day of year ranging between 1 and 366 (starting on January 1). The two numbers can be formatted as YYYY-DDD.  The date uses a format based on the year and the number of the day within the year. Example: 2009-036 = 5 February 2009. This format is sometimes referred to as a Julian Date.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Week of year number
definition: The number of a week in a calendar year. This format is a numeric value between 1-52 or 53. WW: week of year.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

codeListDefinition: A code describing the type of handedness the trade item is designed to be used for example LEFT_HANDED, RIGHT_HANDED, etc.

definition: Designed to be used by left-handed people with ease.
codeListDefinition: A code describing the type of handedness the trade item is designed to be used for example LEFT_HANDED, RIGHT_HANDED, etc.

name: Coeliac
definition: Denotes a product that can be safely consumed by a person with coeliac disease. Coeliac disease is caused by a reaction to gladin (a gluten protein found in wheat) and similar proteins found in other crops.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Diabetic
definition: Denotes a product that intends to decrease the need for insulin or oral diabetic agents by adjusting caloric and carbohydrate intake.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dietetic
definition: Denotes a product that is specially prepared or processed for people on restrictive diets.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Free From Gluten
definition: Denotes a product that can be used in a gluten free diet, as specified by the appropriate authority within a target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Grain free
definition: Indicates that the product is suitable for a grain-free diet that eliminates all grains, including wheat, spelt, barley, rye, dried corn, millet, rice, and oats, as well as foods — and sometimes even ingredients — derived from them.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Halal
definition: Denotes selling or serving food ritually fit according to Islamic dietary laws.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High Carb
definition: High Carb is not a fast diet but much more a complete diet. "High Carb" means that most of the calories in your daily diet come from carbohydrates. At the same time, it is also a low fat diet because the fat content in the diet is relatively low.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High protein
definition: Indicates that the product is suitable for a protein-defined diet in which protein foods are dominant, calories are low, carbohydrates are largely avoided and fat is avoided to a limited extent.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Infant Formula
definition: Infant formulas come in powder, liquid concentrate, and ready-to-feed forms. Infant formulas come in a variety of types: Cow's milk formula is the most commonly used type. The milk has been altered to resemble breast milk. Soy protein based formulas are frequently used for infants allergic to cow's milk or lactose.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Keto
definition: A ketogenic diet is a form of low carb diet. It is characterized by an extremely low carbohydrate and very high-fat diet. Due to the lack of carbohydrates, the metabolism changes and gets into the so-called "ketosis".
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Kosher
definition: Denotes selling or serving food ritually fit according to Jewish dietary laws.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lactase Enzyme
definition: This product is an enzyme supplement used to help people who have trouble digesting milk and other dairy products (lactose intolerance). Lactase enzyme is normally produced by the body to help break down (digest) lactose.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lactose free
definition: Indicates that the product is suitable for a those with an intolerance to lactose as the product does not contain the lactose sugar that is normally found in a dairy product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Low calorie
definition: Indicates that the product is suitable for a calorie-defined diet in which the calorie intake is restricted.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Low Carb
definition: Low-carb diets is a diet that restrict carbohydrate consumption. Foods high in carbohydrates (e.g., sugar, bread, pasta) are limited or replaced with foods containing a higher percentage of fats and moderate protein (e.g., meat, poultry, fish, shellfish, eggs, cheese, nuts, and seeds) and other foods low in carbohydrates (e.g., most salad vegetables such as spinach, kale, chard and collards), although other vegetables and fruits (especially berries) are often allowed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Low Fat
definition: A low-fat diet is one that restricts fat and often saturated fat and cholesterol as well. Low-fat diets are intended to reduce the occurrence of conditions such as heart disease and obesity.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Low protein
definition: Indicates that the product is suitable for a protein-defined diet in which the protein intake with food is restricted.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Low salt
definition: Indicates that the product is suitable for a salt-defined diet in which the salt intake with food is restricted.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Meal Replacement
definition: A calorie-controlled, pre-packaged product in the form of a bar or a beverage (ready-to-drink or powder) that is used to replace a meal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mothers Milk Substitute
definition: The item is approved as substitute mother's milk the appropriate authority of the target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Nutrition Supplement
definition: Nutritional supplements are any dietary supplement that is intended to provide nutrients that may otherwise not be consumed in sufficient quantities; for example, vitamins, minerals, proteins, amino acids or other nutritional substances.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Organic
definition: Denotes a food product that was produced with the use of feed or fertiliser of plant or animal origin, without employment of chemically formulated fertilisers, growth stimulants, antibiotics or pesticides.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Paleo
definition: Paleo diet, is a fad diet type requiring the sole or predominant eating of foods presumed to have been available to humans during the Paleolithic era.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pescatarian
definition: A pescatarian diet excludes meat and poultry but includes fish or seafood (and may include dairy products and eggs).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Plant based
definition: A plant-based diet is a way of eating that focuses on vegetables fruits, whole grains, legumes (beans, peas, and lentils), nuts and seeds. (i.e. foods that come from plants. It is not a vegan/vegetarian diet that avoids animal products, but it de-emphasizes animal products and its contribution to our meals).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Probiotics
definition: Probiotics are live bacteria and yeasts that are good for you, especially your digestive system.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Raw food diet
definition: A dietary practice of eating food that is uncooked and unprocessed. Also known as Raw foodism, rawism.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Total Diet Supplement
definition: Dietary supplements include vitamins, minerals, herbs, botanicals, enzymes, amino acids, or other dietary ingredients. You take these products by mouth in pill, capsule, tablet, or liquid form to replace your diet.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vegan
definition: Products that are not of animal origin and at no stage of production and processing has use been made of, or the product been supplemented with ingredients or processing aids or substances that are of animal origin. The product has not been tested on animals. Local regulations, where they exist, prevail since the term may be a combination or all of the above statements.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vegetarian
definition: Denotes a product that contains no meat or other animal products but depending upon the local market regulations may also contain milk, eggs, products from bees (and in some markets also fish), and their components. Please refer to local regulations.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Without Beef
definition: Denotes a product that contains no beef or beef-products. Beef is considered to be a taboo food product by some religions most notable Hinduism, Buddhism and Jainism.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Without Pork
definition: Denotes a product that contains no pork meat.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dairy

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dairy for Passover
definition: Kosher certified dairy product for Passover.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Kosher Dairy Equipment
definition: A hot product, while pareve in its essence, has been manufactured using equipment that was also used to manufacture hot dairy products where no kosherization occurred in between. It is important to note that a thorough cleaning of the equipment still occurs between production runs and there is absolutely no dairy products contained in an item labeled DE. Link: https://cor.ca/view/183/what_does_dairy_equipment_mean.html

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lacto-Ovo

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lacto-Ovo-Pesca

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lacto-pesca

name: Kosher Mevushal

name: Max Door Drawer Lid Clearance
definition: Item is displayed with the door or lid open to require the maximum clearance. Applies for example to Refrigerators, dishwashers, ovens, Washers, dryers, furniture, and laptop computers.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Max Door Drawer Lid Clearance With Handle
definition: Item is displayed with the door or lid including its handle open to require the maximum clearance.  Applies for example to refrigerators, dishwashers ovens and furniture.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Maximum Squash
definition: The specific measurement for the product that when squashed will safely fit on the shelf without damage.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Out Of Package
definition: Product is removed from consumer packaging, assembled if necessary for final use and its dimensions. For example: Computer desk; entertainment centre; microwave oven; lawnmower; a floor cleaner; a grouping of table and chairs; stove; telephone; camera; large appliance (e.g. washing machines); small appliance (e.g. food processors).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product with stand
definition: Product is removed from consumer packaging and has an included stand installed. The associated dimensions are of the product and the stand as fully assembled. For example: Television dimensions with the included stand.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product without stand
definition: Product is removed from consumer packaging and the included stand is not installed. The associated dimensions are of the product without the stand as fully assembled. For example: Television dimensions without the included stand.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Retail Display
definition: Product is measured as modified for display. For example: Display Ready Packaging with fold-up lid or fold-forward front; a box of chocolate bars with display flap; display stand for dishware; merchandise for consumer purchase that is in a ‘display’ carton that requires modification, such as a product in cans contained within a carton; free-standing displays for a variety of grocery products, candles, decorative items like picture frames); a laptop computer.

name: Stick
definition: A stick is packaged in hollow tubes with an elevator platform inside that moves up and down to dispense the product. This platform can be elevated by turning a screw or push up that causes it to travel up along a central post.
codeListDefinition: The mechanism or method by which the product is dispensed from its container.

name: Time interval activated

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: GLN Registries
definition: An exception message generated due to an error within the GLN registries process.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compact Flash
definition: A mass storage device format used in portable electronic devices.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: HC MMC Plus
definition: A flash memory card standard.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Impact Flash
definition: Impact Flash
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Memory Stick
definition: A removable flash memory card format.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Memory Stick Duo
definition: A smaller flash memory card for pocket-sized digital cameras and cell phones.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Memory Stick Pro
definition: A removable flash memory card format.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: AC DC Adapter
definition: A power supply that is built into a plug and is not built into the unit it is powering.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Additional Attachments
definition: Indicates whether a product comes with separate accessories for example a shower hose sold with a shower head.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Adjustable
definition: Code indicating the ability, or lack of ability, to change to conform to a specific user's needs, usually as it relates to size.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Animated
definition: The trade item having the appearance of something alive, animated in anyway.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Antique
definition: Is item old and considered to be an antique?  This varies by different qualifications depending on market and item what is considered an antique.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Anti-slip Property
definition: Indicates whether the product has got anti-slip properties or is slip-resistant for example the floor of a drain whirlpool tub or right drain soaking tub.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Approved for Tube Feeding
definition: The item may be physically marked that it is approved for tube feeding by the appropriate authority of the target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Aspect Ratio Control
definition: A feature providing the means to set different viewing window sizes for a television.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Auto-channel Setup
definition: A feature which automatically sets up all channels available and tunes the television channels at the touch of a button.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Automatic safety switch
definition: Indicates whether a product has got a automatic safety switch or automatic shut-off that prevents unintended or unsupervised use of e.g. an oven.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Benzoyl peroxide resistant
definition: Code indicating that the product is resistant to Benzoyl Peroxide contact.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Built-in Alarm Clock
definition: A clock that is designed to make a loud sound at a specific time and is built into the unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Centre Channel Capable
definition: A fifth speaker output for replication of crisp and clear sound.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ceramic Cooktop Safe
definition: Indicates that a product is suitable for ceramic cooktop hob or stove. A ceramic cooktop consists of a low-expansion thermal glass-ceramic that is transparent to infrared, which houses halogen heaters below it.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Child Lock Software
definition: Software security used to prevent unwanted tampering with feature settings.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Clip On
definition: Designed to attach by means of a clip
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Clothing label
definition: Code indicating the presence of a label on clothing. Examples: product size, wash details, branding, etc.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Coated Wire
definition: Indicates that the wire is coated with a plastic, vinyl or other sleeve-like protection,
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cold
definition: The product is designed to be used with or keep contents which are cold or chilled. Example: Ice chest.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Collectible or Memorabilia
definition: The trade item considered collectible by consumer or evokes memories to the end consumer
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Coloured
definition: Indicates that a product is coloured.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Common Interface Module
definition: An extensible digital interconnect found in digital Televisions. This feature enables the viewing of pay channels without the need for cable box or set top boxes.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Computer Programmable
definition: Indicates that a product is computer enabled to be programmed by a consumer (non-manual).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Convertible
definition: Code indicating the presence of the ability to be changed in form, function, or character.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cordless
definition: The product does not require a cord. Example or cordlessproducts  phone, battery powered drill.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Corner Element
definition: Indicates that a product is a corner element.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cover
definition: Indicates whether a product has a cover included  for example garden furniture that comes with a PVC cover.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Customer Cuttable
definition: Indicates whether the product can be easily cut for custom use for example foam.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Datalogging
definition: Indicates that a product has digital recording capabilities for example a Datalogging Sound Level Meter, Digital Multimeter Meter, Digital Temperature Meter.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Decorated
definition: Indicates whether the product is delivered with decoration for example a pre-lit pine flocked artificial Christmas tree with white incandescent lights.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Delicate surfaces
definition: Indicates the product is marked as to be used for delicate surfaces.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Detachable hood
definition: Code indicating a hood can be detached from the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Detachable strap
definition: Code indicating a strap can be detached from the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Digital Cable Ready
definition: The ability to project digital cable with the use of a separate tuner.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dimmable
definition: It covers both, switches that change the electric power output as well as lamps that are capable of emitting light at varying degrees of brightness.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dishwasher Safe
definition: Indicates that a product is suitable for dishwasher.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: DVBC Cable Ready
definition: The ability to project DVB-C cable with the use of a separate tuner. DVB-C stands for Digital Video Broadcasting.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Eco-friendly
definition: The product is not harmful to the environment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Elastic or Flexible
definition: Indicates whether a product is elastic or flexible for example a shower hose.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Electric Stove Safe
definition: Indicates that a product is suitable and safe to use for an electric stove.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Electronic Safety Features
definition: Indicates whether a product has got electronic safety features or system.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Embossed
definition: The product has a design or pattern which stands out in relief.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Endurance Burning
definition: Specifies whether a furnace/oven has a slow-burning feature. For example a closed heating device where the amount of air entering the fire box is controlled to slow down combustion.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Energy Saving
definition: Indicates that a product saves energy for example an energy saving LED desk lamp or Energy Star window air conditioner.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Engraved
definition: The item has been engraved or etched with a logo, monogram, or other image.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Estate Bottled
definition: Means that the winery listed on the label owns or controls 100 percent of the grapes that went into the bottle, and the wine was crushed, fermented, finished, aged and bottled all in the same place, and that place has to be located in the same viticultural area.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Exterior Pockets
definition: The trade item contains pockets on the exterior or outside of the item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Extractable Shower
definition: Indicates that a product has an extractable shower.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Extremely Clean
definition: The package is physically marked as extremely clean which slightly lower level of cleanness than sterile is. This means that it is free from bacteria and other microorganisms to a level defined as extremely clean by the appropriate authorities of the target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Factory Finished
definition: Indicates whether a product has been factory finished and does not require any after treatment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fast Curing
definition: Indicates whether the product is a fast curing one for example adhesives, mortar or concrete.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Filter System
definition: Indicates whether a product is supplied with a filter system for example a water dispenser with water filtration system.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fire Resistant
definition: Treated so as to be non-flammable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Flexible Head
definition: Indicates whether a product has got a flexible head for example water tap.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Flicker Free
definition: A feature that increases the frequency of which the picture refreshes measured in hertz (50 to 200Hz) Flicker-free technology noticeably improves viewing quality.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Flight Approved
definition: The item is approved to be safe for travel by authorities that control flight security like in the US the TSA.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fog Resistant
definition: The item is designed to resist fogging or condensation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Foldable
definition: Whether the trade item, device or appliance is foldable, collapsible or not. Example Ironing board
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Frame Grounded
definition: Indicates whether the product is grounded by frame for example a plug socket.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Framed
definition: Indicates whether the product is framed (e.g. mirror).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Freezer Safe
definition: Indicates that the product is suitable for using in a freezer. E.g. the product is a plastic box in which a consumer can freeze food.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fretted
definition: A fret is a raised element on the neck of a stringed instrument.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Frost Resistant
definition: Resistant to frost and can thus be used outside.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Gas Cooktop Safe
definition: Indicates that a product is suitable to use for gas cooktop hob or stove.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Gearbox Housing From Aluminium
definition: Indicates whether a gearbox housing is made from aluminium.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Glazed
definition: Indicates that a product is glazed for e.g. Glazed Polished Tiles, Glazed Brown bricks.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ground Sleeves
definition: Indicates whether a product is delivered with ground sleeves for example small goals with ground sleeve.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Grounded
definition: Indicates that a product  is electrically grounded for example a 3-Wire 16-Gauge Grounded Indoor/Outdoor Extension Cord, Outdoor Plug-In Mechanical Timer with 2 Grounded Outlets, 6-Outlet Grounded Power Strip.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hand-painted
definition: Code indicating the product contains hand-painting on one or more of its surfaces.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hand wash only
definition: Product is meant to be washed by hand only.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Handmade
definition: Code indicating the product was made by hand, not by machine.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hard-sided
definition: The construction of the exterior or the sides of the item are rigid or hard as opposed to being soft (fabric).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Heat Resistant
definition: Indicates that a product is heat resistant.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Heated
definition: Indicates whether the product has got a possibility to heat (e.g. heated toilet seat).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Height Adjustable
definition: Indicates that a product  is adjustable in height for e.g. a Electric Height Adjustable Desks, Height Adjustable A/V Steel Cart .
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High Definition Copy Protection
definition: High Definition Copy Protection (HDCP) is a chip that descrambles a High Definition (HD) broadcast to allow one to watch HD broadcasts.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High Definition Ready
definition: The ability to receive a High Definition signal. The Television can show the required screen resolution and have the necessary connections to be able to show High Definition content.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hood
definition: Code indicating the product has a hood.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hot
definition: The product is designed to be used with or keep contents which are hot or heated. Example: Padded delivery bag, or beverage container.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: HR Plus Glass
definition: Indicates whether the insulation of the glass is HR+.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: HR Plus Plus Glass
definition: Indicates whether the insulation of the glass is HR++.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: HR Plus Plus Plus Glass
definition: Indicates whether the insulation of the glass is HR+++.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Humidity Resistant
definition: Indicates whether a product is humidity resistant or moisture proof for example moisture resistant medium-density fibreboard (MDF).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hydraulic
definition:
Indicates that a product  is hydraulic for e.g. a 2-Ton Hydraulic Trolley Jack,  
Timber Champ 7-Ton Electric Log Splitter, Hydraulic Bottle Jack.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hypoallergenic
definition: A claim the product causes fewer allergic reactions than other ones.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Induction Cooktop Safe
definition: Indicates that a product is suitable for induction hob or stove cooktop. In an induction cooktop a coil of copper wire is placed under the cooking pot and an alternating electric current is passed through it. The resulting oscillating magnetic field induces an electrical current in the pot.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Inflatable
definition: Indicates that a product is inflatable for example an Inflatable Round Kiddie Pool.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Instruments readable from multiple sides.
definition: Indicates whether the instruments of the product are readable from multiple sides.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Instruments readable from two sides.
definition: Indicates whether the instruments of the product are readable from two sides.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Insulated
definition: Indicates that a product  is insulated to protect against environmental factors such as cold, heat, etc..
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Interconnectable
definition: Indicates whether the product can be connected with other products for example lamps or smoke detectors.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Iron Cooktop Safe
definition: Indicates that a product is suitable for iron cooktop hob or stove.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ladder Included
definition: Indicates whether a product is delivered with a ladder.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lamp Equipped
definition: Indicates whether a product is delivered with lamps/bulbs/illuminants.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Light Source Attached
definition: Indicates whether a light source is attached to the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Light Source Built In
definition: Indicates whether the product has got a light source built in (e.g. mirror).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lighting Dimmer Switch
definition: Indicates whether a product has got a lighting dimmer switch.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lightweight Construction
definition: Indicates that a product  is a lightweight construction use of lighter or smaller sized materials for e.g. a Lightweight climbing painted h frame scaffolding for construction.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Limescale remover
definition: The product removes limescale, a hard white or grey substance that forms on the inside of pipes, taps and water containers or on tiles.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lined
definition: Indicates that a product  is lined with a material for e.g. lined steel pipes.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lockable
definition: Indicates that a product is lockable for example Chrome Plated Showcase Window Key Lock, Sliding Door Outside Pull with Key, Rolling Stacking Portable Metal Trolley Tool Box.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Machine Washable
definition: Indicates whether a product is washable in a washing-machine.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Magnetic
definition: The trade item has a magnetic ability to attach to other items.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Magnetic Closure
definition: Indicates that a product  has magnetic mechanism to shut or close.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Memory Card Reader
definition: A computer peripheral that is used to transfer the content of a memory card without the use of another device.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Metal feet
definition: Code indicating the presence of metal feet on a product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Microwave Safe
definition: Indicates that the product is safe to use in a microwave oven. E.g. the consumer can put a microwave safe plate in a microwave to heat food.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mounted Flange
definition: Indicates that a flange is mounted on the trade item. A flange is a part for sealing.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Night Vision
definition: Denotes devices that enhance night-time vision.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Noise Cancelling
definition: Active noise control (ANC), also known as noise cancellation, or active noise reduction (ANR), is a method for reducing unwanted sound by the addition of a second sound specifically designed to cancel the first.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Non comedogenic
definition: Non-Comedogenic Products don't clog pores & assist with breaking down excess oils.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Non-toxic
definition: Non-toxic items aren't poisonous. It's generally safe to eat or breathe non-toxic substances, and they don't harm the environment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Nut Mount
definition: Indicates whether a product for example a vice has a nut mount to attach it to a workbench.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Oil Free
definition: Indicates whether the product is oil free, to eliminates the need for maintenance for example a Compressor.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: On Screen Clock
definition: A clock visible on the screen.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: On Screen Menu
definition: Interactive menus that come up when changing television set-up options such as brightness and contrast.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Opens from both sides.
definition: Indicates whether the product can be mounted for right or left opening for example a door.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Opens from left side.
definition: Indicates whether the product can be mounted for left opening only for example a door.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Opens from right side.
definition: Indicates whether the product can be mounted for right opening only for example a door.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Oven
definition: Indicates whether a product is supplied with an oven.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Oven Safe
definition: Indicates that a product is safe and suitable to use in an oven.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Overrun Brake
definition: Indicates that a product has a overrun brake for e.g. a trailer for a boat has a baking mechanism to stop the trailer from hitting a vehicle.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Padded
definition: Indicates that a product  is padded is added material to protect or shape the trade item for e.g. a padded chair.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Parental Control
definition: Options that allow parents to monitor or limit what a child can see or do and/or time-limit these activities.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Parfocal Lens
definition: A parfocal lens is a lens that stays in focus when magnification/focal length is changed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pedestal Staircase
definition: Specifies whether the stairs has (a right angle) on a pedestal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Permeable
definition:
Indicates that a product is permeable for e.g. permeable flooring, parquet, 
laminate, tiling.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Personalizable
definition: The item is can be personalized by the customer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: PH neutral
definition: pH neutral is when the product is neither acid nor alkaline. At a temperature of 25 °C a pH of 7 is neutral (e.g. pure water).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Picture Enhancement
definition: A brand owner enhancement to the picture quality which may be created by hardware, or software, or both.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Picture Viewing Capability
definition: The ability to view digital photographs via a digital card reader.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pin Grounded
definition: Indicates whether the product is grounded by pin for example a plug with a hole for a ground pin as well as the tabs on the side.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Plant Based
definition: A plant-based diet or product is one consisting mostly or entirely derived from plants, including vegetables, grains, nuts, seeds, legumes and fruits, and with few or no animal products.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Polished
definition: Indicates that a product can be used for polishing, for example Polished Aluminium Wheel Cleaner, Polished Granite Cleaner and Resealer, Hard-Surface and Polished Concrete Concentrated Cleaner.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Portable
definition: Whether the trade item is capable of being travel enabled or easily portable to various locations.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Power Saving
definition: Indicates whether a product saves power/energy.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pre-programmable
definition: Indicates whether the product can be pre-programmed for example a programmable thermostat.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Protective Layer
definition: Indicates whether the product has got a protective layer for example a bike tire with special layer in case of breakdown.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pump Included
definition: The trade item includes a pump for inflation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Quadrature Amplitude Modulation
definition: Quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) enables direct reception of digital cable channels without the use of a set top box.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Railing
definition: Indicates whether the product has got a railing, for e.g. a Handrail, Stair Rail.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ready Painted
definition: Indicates whether a product is sold ready painted.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Rechargeable Battery
definition: Indicates whether the product is equipped with a rechargeable battery. This code will be deprecated in the future. Please use attribute isBatteryRechargeable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Red Eye Reduction
definition: The item has red-eye reduction capabilities. The red-eye effect in photography is the common appearance of red pupils in colour photographs of eyes. It occurs when using a photographic flash very close to the camera lens (as with most compact cameras), in ambient low light. The effect appears in the eyes of humans and animals that have tapetum lucidum.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Refillable
definition: Code indicating the product can be refilled.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Removable Cover
definition: The item has a cover which can be removed. Such as an umbrella sometimes comes with a cover/pouch for storage, or a plastic storage container with a lid.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Removable Flash
definition: The flash is removable from the trade item
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Battery Replacement
definition: Indicates whether a rechargeable battery in a product can be replaced e.g. in case of a Cordless Drywall Screwdriver.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Retractable Cord
definition: Indicates that the part of the item can be withdrawn into a holder or trade item, as in a cord or leash.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: RFID Blocking
definition: The item is constructed in a way to prevent Radio Frequency Identification devices from penetrating through the item. This ensures that RFID embedded items inside can not be read through the item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Risers
definition: Indicates whether the product has risers (e.g. stairs with steps and risers that fit into).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Rotatable
definition: Indicates whether a product is rotatable (able to be turned around on an axis).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Rotation or Turning Stop
definition: Indicates whether the product has got a rotation stop or an activated turning stop for example a drill hammer with SDS-plus admission.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Safe For Food Use
definition: Indicates that a product is suitable for food use. User can use the item for food preservation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Safety Facilities
definition: Indicates whether the product has got safety facilities for example guards on a grinder or safety features on gas installations.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Saw Blade Replacement
definition: Indicates whether a saw blade can be replaced for example a reciprocating saw with a removable blade.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Scratch Resistant
definition: The trade item's material is strong enough to prevent scratches under certain conditions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Self-levelling
definition: Indicates whether the product has got a functionality for self levelling for e.g. a self-levelling underlayment. Self levelling products have high flow characteristics and do not require the addition of excessive amounts of water for placement.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Self Timer Mechanism
definition: The trade item has a self timing mechanism, meaning trade item can operate independently for a set period of time.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shock absorbing
definition: Indicates whether the product is shock absorbing at the ends or in general for example a handle axe with shock reduction grip.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Short Time Burning
definition: Indicate whether a furnace/oven is suitable for short-time burning.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Simultaneous Picture Teletext
definition: The ability to view teletext while still watching the picture (subtitled or captioned). Teletext is a television information retrieval service.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Single lever mixer
definition: Indicates whether a water, shower or bath tap is a single lever mixer and can be used with one hand.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Small Parts Holder
definition: Indicates whether a product is supplied with a holder for small parts such as tool bits.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Soft Close Mechanism
definition: Indicates that a product  has a soft closing mechanism for .e.g. toilet seat, garbage cans, dressers.

name: Sound Levelling Capability
definition: Sound levelling reduces the spikes in sound levels during programming typically from commercials.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Spinner Wheels
definition: The trade item has free spinning/turning wheels which allow it to be rolled in any direction.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Spray Water Proof
definition: Indicates whether the product is water proof from spray water for example having an IP4 code (Water splashing against the enclosure from any direction shall have no harmful effect).  Waterproof Digital Solar Powered Hose End Timer
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sprayable
definition: Indicates whether the product can be sprayed for example an MS-Polymer multi-texture sealer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stay cool handle
definition: Code indicating the presence of a stay cool handle on a product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sterile
definition: The package is physically marked as sterile, which is the highest level of cleanness. This means that it is free from bacteria and other microorganisms to a level defined as sterile by the appropriate authorities of the target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Straight
definition: Indicates that the product is a straight model with no turns for example a straight staircase.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Strap
definition: Code indicating the presence of a strap on the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stretch
definition: Code indicating the ability of a product to stretch within certain limits.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Suspension Device
definition: Indicates that a product has a suspension device to mount the trade item to wall.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Swivel Connector
definition: Indicates whether a product (e.g. shower hose or cable) has got a swivel connector to prevent hose or cable twisting.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Swivel Head
definition: Indicates whether the product has a head which can be pivoted or swivelled (e.g. head of a bath tap).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tear Resistant
definition: The trade item material is strong enough to prevent tear under certain conditions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Temperature Limiter
definition: Indicates whether the product has got a temperature limiter (e.g. water tap).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Thermal Insulating
definition: Indicates whether the product is thermally insulating for example a foam pipe insulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Thermal Protected
definition: Indicates whether the has got a thermal protection. This means, when overheating, the product will be switched off by its control unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tools Included
definition: Indicates whether the product is supplied with tools.

name: Touch Screen

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Twist On Anchor Bracket

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Usable In Damp Rooms
definition: Indicates whether the product can due to the humidity  resistance be used or installed in damp rooms (e.g. bathroom).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Washable

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Water Resistant
definition: The item is designed to resist and entirely prevent the penetration of water.

name: Waterproof
definition: Item is designed to resist and entirely prevent the penetration of water.

name: Weather Protection

definition: Indicates whether the product can be connected with Wi-Fi.

name: XVYCC Color Gamut Technology
definition: An expanded version of the YCC color gamut, with 1.8-times more reds, greens, and blues of sRGB color. It is often made synonymous with Deep Color, which is an increased bit depth.

name: Adolescent
definition: An interim life stage of an animal which is the process of developing from a baby into an adult, however it will vary based on the type of animal and the size, weight or age of the animal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Adult
definition: The life stage of an animal which is fully grown or developed, however it will vary based on the type of animal and the size, weight or age of the animal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: All
definition: The product can be used at all animals regardless of age or size.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Baby
definition: The earliest life stage of an very young animal, however it will vary based on the type of animal and the size, weight or age of the animal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Senior
definition: The oldest life stage of an animal, however it will vary based on the type of animal and the size, weight or age of the animal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Extra soft
definition: Very high moisture content cheese. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, the moisture content on fat-free basis of equal or greater than 80% known as “Soft white cheese”).
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the relative firmness of the cheese based  on moisture content. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Soft
definition: High moisture content cheese. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, the moisture content on fat-free basis of more than 67% and less than 80% known as “Soft cheese).
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the relative firmness of the cheese based  on moisture content. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Semi soft

codeListDefinition: The code indicating the relative firmness of the cheese based  on moisture content. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Firm
definition: Low moisture content cheese.  The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, the moisture content on fat-free basis of more than 50% and less than 62% known as “Firm cheese”).
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the relative firmness of the cheese based  on moisture content. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Hard
definition: Very low moisture content.  The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, the moisture content on fat-free basis of less than 50% known as “Hard cheese”).
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the relative firmness of the cheese based  on moisture content. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Extra hard
definition: Extremely low moisture content.  The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, the moisture content on fat-free basis of equal or less than 34% known as “Hard grating cheese”).
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the relative firmness of the cheese based  on moisture content. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Troy Ounce or Apothecary Ounce
definition: Troy ounce or apothecary ounce: The troy ounce is a unit of imperial measure. In the present day it is most commonly used to gauge the weight and therefore the price of precious metals.  One troy ounce equals 480 grains or 31.1035 grams.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Assortment

name: Board Foot
definition: Board Foot: A specialized unit of measure for the volume of rough lumber (before drying and planing with no adjustments) or planed/surfaced lumber. It is the volume of a one-foot length of a board one foot wide and one inch thick. Some countries utilize the synonym super foot or superficial foot.

name: Barrel US
definition: Barrel US: There are varying standards for barrel for some specific commodities, including 31 gal for beer, 40 gal for whiskey or kerosene, and 42 gal for petroleum. The general standard for liquids is 31.5 gal or half a hogshead; the general standard for dry contents is 7,056 Cubic Inches.

name: Hundred board Foot

name: British Thermal Unit
definition: British thermal unit: The British thermal unit (BTU or Btu) is a traditional unit of energy. It is approximately the amount of energy needed to heat one pound of water one degree Fahrenheit. One Btu is equal to about 1.06 kilojoules. It is used in the power, steam generation, heating and air conditioning industries.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bushel (US)
definition: Bushel (US): A bushel is an imperial and U.S. customary unit of dry volume, equivalent in each of these systems to 4 pecks or 8 gallons. It is used for volumes of dry commodities (not liquids), most often in agriculture

name: Bushel (UK)

name: Hundred weight (UK)

name: Terajoule

name: Calorie - International Table (IT)
definition: This code is being DEPRECATED. Use code E14 Kilocalorie to express food calories. Calorie - International Table (IT): A calorie is 1/100 of the amount of energy required to warm one gram of air-free water from 0 °C to 100 °C at standard atmospheric pressure; this is about 4.190 J.  Its use is archaic, having been replaced by the SI unit of energy, the joule. However, in many countries it remains in common use as a unit of food energy. In the context of nutrition, and especially food labeling, the calorie is approximately equal to 4.1868 joules (J), and energy values are normally quoted in kilojoules (kJ) and kilocalories (kcal).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Days
definition: Days: A day is one three hundreds and sixty fifth (1/365) of a year
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Decigram

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Decilitre

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Decimetre
definition: Decimetre: A decimetre is  equal to one tenth of a metre.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dram (US)
definition: Dram (US): The dram (archaic spelling drachm) was historically both a coin and a weight. Currently it is both a small mass in the Apothecaries' system of weights and a small unit of volume. This unit is called more correctly fluid dram or in contraction also fluidram. The term also refers to the fluid dram, a measure of capacity equal 1⁄8 of a fluid ounce, which means it is exactly equal to 3.696 691 195 312 5 mL in the United States.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dram (UK)
definition: Dram (UK): The dram (archaic spelling drachm) was historically both a coin and a weight. Currently it is both a small mass in the Apothecaries' system of weights and a small unit of volume. This unit is called more correctly fluid dram or in contraction also fluidram. The fluid dram is defined as 1⁄8 of a fluid ounce, which means it is exactly equal to 3.551 632 812 500 0 mL in the Commonwealth and Ireland. In England dram came to mean a small draught of cordial or alcohol; hence the term dram-house for the taverns where one could purchase a dram.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Gram Per Square Metre
definition: "Gram per square metre: In the metric system, the density of all types of paper, paperboard, and fabric, is expressed in terms of grams per square meter (g/m²).  This quantity is commonly called grammage both in English and French (ISO 536), though many English-speaking countries still refer to the "weight". The term density here is used somewhat incorrectly, as density is mass by volume. More precisely, it is a measure of the area density, areal density, or surface density."

definition: The Zero-Suppressed identifier, also called a "Zero Suppressed UPC", is a compressed GTIN-12 (6-digits plus a check digit). The compression utilizes a GTIN-12, where the UPC Company Prefix begins with a zero, and contains a sequence of 4 or 5 zeroes in defined positions. name: Jet Fresh
definition: Freshly picked and immediately packed and shipped at mature stage and flown to destination for adequate distribution (i.e. imports from South America, Africa or Europe). Flown by jet to market; the carton will be labelled Jet Fresh, when applicable, stickered Jet Fresh. For the produce industry, most common with berries, stonefruits and pineapples
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Preconditioned
definition: Product stored at proper temperature prior to shipment to allow ripening and/or colouring, adequate for distribution and/or consumption. Pre- conditioned product is matured to a specific maturity level as a result of ripening through either temperature, gas treatment, humidity or any combination thereof.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ready to Eat
definition: Fruit/Vegetable is ready to be eaten and no ripening is needed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tree Vine  Ripe

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Triggered
definition: Fruit/Vegetable ripening has been triggered using some artificial method, such as gas ethylene. The fruit or vegetable will be edible in a short time after it reaches the store.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pound per square inch - Gauge
definition: Psig (pound-force per square inch gauge) is a unit of pressure relative to the surrounding atmosphere. At sea level, Earth's atmosphere actually exerts a pressure of 14.7 psi. Humans do not feel this pressure because internal pressure of liquid in their bodies matches the external pressure. If a pressure gauge is calibrated to read zero in space, then at sea level on Earth it would read 14.7 psi. Thus a reading of 30 psig, on Earth, on a tire gauge represents an absolute pressure of 44.7 psi (lb/in2).

Indication of the value of Shigella. 
Shigella:  Shigella is a genus of Gram-negative, non-spore forming rod-shaped bacteria closely related to Escherichia coli and Salmonella. Shigella is a genus of bacteria that are a major cause of diarrhea and dysentery – diarrhea with blood and mucus in the stools – throughout the world. name: Aerobic plate count
definition: Aerobic Plate Count (APC) is used as an indicator of bacterial populations on a sample. The test is based on an assumption that each cell will form a visible colony when mixed with agar containing the appropriate nutrients.
codeListDefinition: Method of analysis used to determine quantity of the specified microbiological organism (E.g. probiotic live microbe) in the product. Example: Aerobic plate count, Flow cytometry.

name: Flow cytometry
definition: Flow cytometry (FC) is a technique used to detect and measure physical and chemical characteristics of a population of cells or particles. In this process, a sample containing cells or particles is suspended in a fluid and injected into the flow cytometer instrument. The sample is focused to ideally flow one cell at a time through a laser beam, where the light scattered is characteristic to the cells and their components.
codeListDefinition: Method of analysis used to determine quantity of the specified microbiological organism (E.g. probiotic live microbe) in the product. Example: Aerobic plate count, Flow cytometry.

name: Auburn

name: Black
definition: Black hair is the darkest and most common of all human hair colours globally, due to larger populations with this dominant trait. It is a dominant genetic trait, and it is found in people of all backgrounds and ethnicities. It has large amounts of eumelanin and is less dense than other hair colours.
codeListDefinition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the natural colour of the hair for which the product is intended.

name: Blonde
definition: Blonde or fair hair is a hair colour characterized by low levels of the dark pigment eumelanin.
codeListDefinition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the natural colour of the hair for which the product is intended.

name: Brown
definition: Brown hair  varies from light brown to almost black hair. It is characterized by higher levels of the dark pigment eumelanin and lower levels of the pale pigment pheomelanin.
codeListDefinition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the natural colour of the hair for which the product is intended.

name: Grey
definition: Grey hair is a combination of normally pigmented hairs interspersed with white ones. Hair turns white when the pigmentation cells responsible for colour (melanin) stop being produced.

name: Red
definition: Red hair varies in hue from a deep burgundy or bright copper to burnt orange or red-orange to strawberry blond. Characterized by high levels of the reddish pigment pheomelanin and relatively low levels of the dark pigment eumelanin.
codeListDefinition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the natural colour of the hair for which the product is intended.

name: White
definition: White hair is not caused by a true gray or white pigment, but is due to a lack of pigmentation and melanin. The clear hairs appear white because of the way light is reflected from the hairs.
codeListDefinition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the natural colour of the hair for which the product is intended.

name: Acetaminophen
definition: Acetaminophen is an analgesic drug used to treat headaches, arthritis, etc., and also to reduce fever, often as an alternative to aspirin.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Halogenated Organic Flame Retardants
definition: Halogenated organic flame retardants are intended to inhibit ignition and the spread of flames. Halogenated chemicals are chemicals that contain bromine, chlorine, fluorine or iodine bonded to a carbon atom.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Bisphenol
definition: Bisphenol is an organic compound with the chemical formula (CH3)2C(C6H4OH)2. It is a colourless solid that is soluble in organic solvents, but poorly soluble in water. BPA is controversial because it exerts weak, but detectable, hormone-like properties, raising concerns about its presence in consumer products and foods contained in such products
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: DEHP
definition: Di-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) is a member of the phthalate family used as a softening agent for many PVC applications.  DEHP is sometimes called dioctyl phthalate (DOP) or Bis(2-ethylhexyl)phthalate (BEHP).  In the EU package markings require a mark to show "PHT".
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Mercury
definition: Mercury is a naturally occurring element that is found in air, water and soil. It exists in several forms: elemental or metallic mercury, inorganic mercury compounds, and organic mercury compounds.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Paper or Wood
definition: If any portion of this item, including reusable packaging, is made from wood or paper, then answer “Yes”. Reusable packaging is intended to stay in use with the product. Ex: Wooden box in which a lawn game, such as a croquet set, is stored after use.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Phenylalanine
definition: Phenylalanine is an amino acid widely distributed in plant proteins. It is an essential nutrient in the diet of vertebrates.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Polystyrene (CAS 9003-53-6)
definition: Polystyrene (CAS 9003-53-6) is a plastic polymer from the monomer styrene. It comes in many forms: sheet, expanded or extruded foam, or as oriented polystyrene. What is commonly known as Styrofoam™ refers only to the extruded form of polystyrene.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC)
definition: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) is a plastic polymer used in a wide array of products. It is the third most widely produced plastic.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: Salicylate
definition: Salicylate is salt or ester of salicylic acid.
codeListDefinition: Specifies a non-food ingredient of concern for a trade item as a code.

name: By child nutrition serving
definition: Nutrient measurement is based on the child nutrition serving value. Example: USDA Food and Nutrition Service (USDA FNS).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Nutrient measurement is based on a measurement value for example grams or ounces.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: By package or container
definition: Nutrient measurement is based on the contents of the package or container.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: By serving

name: Bicarbonate (or hydrogen carbonate)
definition: GS1 Tagname Description: Bicarbonate (or hydrogen carbonate) is an intermediate form in the deprotonation of carbonic acid. It is an anion with the chemical formula HCO3. Bicarbonate serves a crucial biochemical role in the physiological pH buffering system. Bicarbonate is a major element in our body, and is present in all body fluids and organs. Secreted by the stomach, it is necessary for digestion. When ingested, for example, with mineral water, it helps buffer lactic acid generated during exercise and also reduces the acidity of dietary components. Finally, it has a prevention effect on dental cavities. - UOM for Nutrient Panel: - GS1 Notes, Keywords, and Examples: - GS1 Comment: GS1 temporary code - GS1 Synonyms:
