name: Animal Print
definition: Animal print is a clothing and fashion style in which the garment is made to resemble the pattern of the skin and fur of an animal such as a leopard, zebra, tiger, snake, giraffe, alligator, etc.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Architectural
definition: The product has an architectural pattern. This is the idea of capturing architectural design ideas as archetypal and reusable descriptions.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Bubble Foam
definition: The product has a bubble/foam pattern. A soap bubble is an extremely thin film of soapy water enclosing air that forms a hollow sphere with an iridescent surface. Foam is an object formed by trapping pockets of gas in a liquid or solid.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Camouflage
definition: The product has a camouflage pattern. Originally used to protect military force personnel and equipment from observation by enemy forces, today also common in fashion.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Crack
definition: The pattern of dense cracking formed on the surface or appearance on the product.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Floral
definition: Floral is a term used to describe something that is relative or related to the flower, that concerns the flower or its characteristics.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Gingham
definition: The product has a gingham pattern: Gingham is woven like Pepita body-bindingly, but with wider body ridges. This creates such wide black-and-white diagonal stripes when white warp and black weft threads collide that the blocks no longer appear clearly delimited, but merge with the adjacent blocks of the same colour into a shape.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Gradient
definition: The product has a gradient colour.  A colour gradient (sometimes called a colour ramp or colour progression) specifies a range of position-dependent colours. Example: Pink transitioning to Dark Red.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Herringbone
definition: The product has a herringbone pattern. An arrangement of rectangles, so named for a fancied resemblance to the bones of a fish such as herring. The blocks can be rectangles or parallelograms.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Houndstooth
definition: The product has a houndstooth pattern. Created in canvas-binding fabrics, when the chain and the shot each have two thread-wide stripes. The encounter of white warp threads with black weft threads gives the impression of tiny wind turbines.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Mottled
definition: The product has a mottled pattern. Irregular marks, spots, streaks, blotches or patches of different shades or colours.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Other Pattern
definition: The product has a pattern but has not been specified in this code list. This code will be used for any new pattern that is not specified.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Paisley
definition: The product has a paisley pattern. An abstract, decorative fabric pattern that represents the Persian Boteh pattern. In its basic form, it represents a leaf with a pointed, curved end, in the style of a large comma and recalls the Gothic fish bubble ornament.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Pepita
definition: The product has a pepita pattern: Created when warp and firing strips of mostly eight threads wide are woven body-bindingly, typically as 2/1 bodies. Those blocks in which white warp threads meet black weft threads appear diagonally striped.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Photoprint
definition: The product has a photo printed on its material.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Pinstripe
definition: The product has a pinstripe pattern. Very thin stripes of any colour running in parallel. The colour-highlighted warp threads are incorporated into a base fabric, which appear as fine longitudinal strips.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Plaid
definition: The product has a plaid pattern. Squares and lines known as a sett. The plaid pattern best characterized by horizontal and vertical lines intersecting each other that together form different sizes of squares or checks all throughout the fabric is also known as Tartan or the Scottish plaid.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Polka Dot
definition: The product has a polka dot pattern. Equally large, filled, regularly arranged circles. The dots are not woven, but printed on the fabric, sometimes embroidered.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Spiral
definition: The product has a spiral pattern that is a flat curve that describes revolutions around a fixed point (pole) as it moves further and further away from it.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Stripes
definition: A stripe(s) pattern is a long, narrow band or strip differing in colour or texture from the surface on either side of it.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Symmetry
definition: 'The product has a symmetrical pattern that has a regular distribution of parts or objects on either side of an axis or around a centre point
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Tiling
definition: The product has a tiling pattern. Tiling is a two-dimensional pattern resembling a tiled surface.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Turbulence
definition: The product has a turbulence pattern that is a formation of vortices in a fluid. Many natural patterns are shaped by this complexity, including vortex streets, other effects of turbulent flow such as meanders in rivers. Or nonlinear interaction of the system.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Unicoloured
definition: The product has a unicoloured pattern (one unique colour for the product). Also known in some markets as Solids.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Wave, Dune
definition: The product has a wave/dune pattern. Wave is inequality of the surface of a liquid expanse (sea, lake...) due to currents, wind; mass of water that rises and falls. And dune is mound, a hill of fine sand formed by the wind on the seaside or in the interior of deserts.
codeListDefinition: Indicates the pattern code of the product.

name: Gas
definition: A material, which has a vapor pressure greater than 300 kPa (43.5 psia) at 50°C (122°F) or is completely gaseous at 20°C (68°F) at a standard pressure of 101.3 kPa (14.7 psia).  Including: ·       Aerosol:  Any non-refillable receptacle containing a gas compressed, liquefied or dissolved under pressure, the sole purpose of which is to expel a nonpoisonous (other than a Division 6.1 Package Group III Material) liquid, paste, or powder and fitted with a self-closing release device allowing the contents to be ejected by the gas. ·       Asphyxiant Gas:  A gas, which dilutes or replaces the oxygen normally in the atmosphere. ·       Compressed Gas in Solution:  A non-liquefied compressed gas, which is dissolved in a solvent. ·       Liquefied Compressed Gas: A gas, which when packaged under pressure for transportation is partially liquid at temperatures above -50° C (-58° F).  A liquefied compressed gas is further categorized as follows:  o    High Pressure Liquefied Gas: A gas with a critical temperature between -50 °C (-58° F) and + 65° C (149° F). o    Low Pressure Liquefied Gas:  A gas with a critical temperature above + 65° C (149° F).  ·       Non-Liquefied Compressed Gas:  A gas, which when packaged under pressure for transportation is entirely gaseous at -50° C (-58° F) with a critical temperature less than or equal to -50° C (-58° F). Oxidizing Gas:  A gas, which may, generally by providing oxygen, cause or contribute to the combustion of other material more than air does.

Fuel oil is made of long hydrocarbon chains, particularly alkanes, cycloalkanes and aromatics. The term fuel oil is also used in a stricter sense to refer only to the heaviest commercial fuel that can be obtained from crude oil, heavier than gasoline and naphtha.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Gasoline or petrol is a transparent petroleum-derived liquid that is primarily used as a fuel in internal combustion engines. It consists mostly of organic compounds obtained by the fractional distillation of petroleum, enhanced with a variety of additives. Some gasolines also contain ethanol as an alternative fuel. In North America the term "gasoline" is often shortened in colloquial usage to "gas" but some people use the term "petrol".
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Natural Gas
definition: A naturally occurring hydrocarbon gas mixture consisting primarily of methane, with other hydrocarbons, carbon dioxide, nitrogen and hydrogen sulfide. Natural gas is widely used as an important energy source in many applications including heating buildings, generating electricity, providing heat and power to industry, as fuel for vehicles and as a chemical feedstock in the manufacture of products such as plastics and other commercially important organic chemicals.

A by-product of natural gas processing and petroleum refining, it is commonly used as a fuel for engines, oxy-gas torches, barbecues, portable stoves, and residential central heating. Propane is one of a group of liquefied petroleum gases. The others include butane, propylene, butadiene, butylene, isobutylene and mixtures thereof.

name: Stringer Pallet
definition: A pallet constructed with boards (stringers) on edge to which the top deck and bottom deck boards are attached. The stringers may be notched to facilitate four way entry and lifting by a fork lift or other pallet jacking device.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vertical Drum Pallet
definition: A rigid platform with integrated restraints to prevent vertically orientated cylindrical containers from slipping. Vertical Drum Pallets are used for assembling, storing, stacking, handling and transporting cylindrical containers, e.g. drums, barrels, or kegs, as a unit load, suitable for lifting by a forklift, pallet jack, or other jacking device.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pallet 800 X 400 mm
definition: One third size of the standard Euro Pallet size with dimensions of 800 x 400 mm. 1/3 European Pallet.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: 1/2 ISO 3 Pallet
definition: Half size flat pallet with dimensions of 610 x 1016 mm (24 x 40 In); primarily used in the Americas region.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: 1/4 ISO 3 Pallet
definition: Quarter size flat pallet with dimensions of 610 x 508 mm (24 x 20 In); primarily used in the Americas region.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Custom Platform
definition: A portable, horizontal, rigid platform used as a base for assembling, storing, stacking, handling and transporting goods as a unit load, suitable for lifting by a forklift, pallet jack, or other jacking device.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pallet 1000 x 1100 mm
definition: Pallet 1000 x 1100 mm (100cms X 110cms). Standard sized pallet of dimensions 100 centimetres by 110 centimetres (cms). EDIFACT X9. This is contained in Recommendation 21 as AH https://www.unece.org/uncefact/codelistrecs.html
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Double mobilrack
definition: A portable, horizontal, perforated metal platform for storing, stacking and handling transporting goods as unit load, with dimensions 2025 x 1180 mm, suitable for lifting by a forklift, pallet jack, or other jacking device. Fits in the space of  2 EUR pallets.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Single mobilrack
definition:
A portable, horizontal, perforated metal platform for storing, stacking and handling transporting goods as unit load, with dimensions 1545 x 1180 mm, suitable for lifting by a forklift, pallet jack, or other jacking device. 
Fits in the space of  1 EUR pallet.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Slip sheet
definition: A firm sheet of plastic, cardboard or other material which may be hooked or attached to a forklift or other transportation equipment. The slip sheet is used to pull products stacked on top of it. Use packaging dimension attributes to specify the size of the slip sheet.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Non-palletised goods
definition: Indication that the unit is despatched without a standardised layer (pattern) or platform type, e.g. individually packed and despatched.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Floor Loaded (Container)
definition: A shipping container of freight that is loaded with freight from the floor up, rather than on pallets. A full floor-loaded container can hold more freight than a palletized load.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bare Stem No Operator
definition: This control is a peg or stem extending from the unit. There is no handle or lever on the end of the stem.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cross Handwheel
definition: The control is a device, which resembles a cross or "+", which when attached to the stem can be turned to operate the unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Electric Actuators
definition: An electronic actuator converts energy (in the form of electricity) into motion. The motion can be rotary or linear, depending on the type of actuator.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Extended Lever Handle
definition: The control is a flat piece of material made such as for one end to fit over the stem and can be turned to operate the unit. The unit is considered an extended lever as it has another piece of material into which the stem is inserted thereby causing the handle to be set away from the unit it operates
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Extended Lever Handle With Memory Stop
definition: The control is a flat piece of material made to fit over the stem and can be turned to operate the unit. The unit is considered an extended lever as it has another piece of material into which the stem is inserted thereby causing the handle to be set away from the unit it operates. Memory stop is a device which allows the user to set the range of motion allowable for the handle.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Extended Rpund Handle
definition: The control is a circular device which when attached to the stem can be turned to operate the unit. The unit is considered an extended lever as it has another piece of material into which the stem is inserted thereby causing the handle to be set away from the unit it operates.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Gear Operator
definition: The control is a device which contains a gear box and having a circular handle, thereby increasing the number of turns of the handle required to change the direction of the closure member, and reducing the force needed to operate the unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Horizontal Chain Lever Handle
definition: The control is a bar attached to a unit, designed to be mounted horizontally. A chain is attached on each end of the bar. By pulling on one chain or the other, the unit can be set into operation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Insulation Handle
definition: The control is a device comprised of non-conductive materials which can be turned to operate the unit even when thermal pipe insulation is affixed around the unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lever Handle
definition: The control is a flat piece of material made such as for one end to fit over the stem and can be turned to operate the unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lever Lock Operator
definition: The control is a long handle with a catch mechanism. The position lock can be used to set the valve in the full open or full closed position. This type of control may or may not have the ability to be locked with a padlock.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Locking Lever Handle
definition: The control is a flat piece of material made such as for one end to fit over the stem and can be turned to operate the unit. The lever has a secondary piece of material, which when engaged can hold the lever in one position. This type of control may or may not have the ability to be locked with a padlock. The control is a flat piece of material made such as for one end to fit over the stem and can be turned to operate the unit. The lever has a secondary piece of material, which when engaged can hold the lever in one position. This type of control may or may not have the ability to be locked with a padlock.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lockshield Operator
definition: The control is a stem with a keyed end. The control is operated by a lock shield key. The Key can be a simple as an allen key or more complex depending on the security required.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pneumatic Actuators
definition: A pneumatic actuator converts energy (in the form of compressed air, typically) into motion. The motion can be rotary or linear, depending on the type of actuator.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Position Lock Operator
definition: The control is a long handle with a catch mechanism. The position lock can be used to set the valve in any position or as a memory stop so the valve may be reopened to the previous position. This type of control may or may not have the ability to be locked with a padlock.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Round Handle
definition: The control is a circular device which when attached to the stem can be turned to operate the unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Slotted
definition: A groove or slot which allows for screwdrivers to be used to operate the control.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Solenoid
definition: A solenoid is a transducer device which converts energy into linear motion.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Solid Tee Operator
definition: The control is a piece of material in the shape of a "T" in which the stem can be inserted. The Tee can then be rotated to operate the unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Square Operating Nut
definition: The control comprises a nut at the top of the stem. This nut is square in shape. Turning the nut turns the stem causing the unit to operate.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vertical Chain Lever Handle
definition: The control is a bar attached to a unit, designed to be mounted vertically. A chain is attached on each end of the bar. By pulling on one chain or the other, the unit can be set into operation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Wing Handle
definition: The control is a flat piece of material made such that the center of the device can over the stem and can be turned to operate the unit. The section of the bar are bent allowing for an easier grip and resemble wings.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ansi
definition: American National Standards Institute (ANSI) oversees the creation, promulgation and use of thousands of norms and guidelines that directly impact businesses in nearly every sector: from acoustical devices to construction equipment, from dairy and livestock production to energy distribution, and many more. ANSI is also actively engaged in accrediting programs that assess conformance to standards.- http://www.ansi.org/
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Asme
definition: The American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) is a professional body, specifically an engineering society, focused on mechanical engineering. The organization's stated vision is to be the premier organization for promoting the art, science and practice of mechanical and multidisciplinary engineering and allied sciences to the diverse communities throughout the world. Its stated mission is to promote and enhance the technical competency and professional well-being of its members, and through quality programs and activities in mechanical engineering, better enable its practitioners to contribute to the well-being of humankind. Http://www.asme.org/
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Astm
definition: American Society for Testing and Materials International (ASTM) specification documents, test methods, classifications, practices, and guides. These standards describe the characteristics of materials, systems, products, and services. ASTM documents are divided into nine sections, Metals, Construction, Paints, Petroleum Products, Plastics, Textiles, Rubber & Electric Insulating Materials, General Test Methods, and Miscellaneous. ASTM technical committees are made up of professionals from around the globe who develop ASTM standards. There are over 130 ASTM technical committees covering diverse industry areas ranging from metals to the environment. http://www.astm.org
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cispi
definition: Cast Iron Soil Pipe Institute (CISPI) The Institute is dedicated to aiding and improving the plumbing industry. Through the preparation and distribution of technical reports, we seek to advance interest in the manufacture, use and distribution of cast iron soil pipe and fittings, and through a program of research and the cooperative effort of soil pipe manufacturers, we strive to improve the industry's products, achieve standardization of cast iron soil pipe and fittings, and provide a continuous program of product testing, evaluation and development. Assurance that pipe and fittings meet the approved standards and tolerances of the Institute is provided either by Ç®; or the CI NO-HUB® trademarks which are the collective marks all member companies may place on their products. www.cispi.org
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Csa
definition: Canadian Standards Association (CSA) As a membership-based association serving business, industry, government and consumers in Canada and the global marketplace. As a solutions-oriented organization, CSA works in Canada and around the world to develop standards that address real needs, such as enhancing public health and safety. Advancing the quality of life. Helping to preserve the environment. Facilitating trade. CSA helps people understand standards through education and information products and services.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Iapmo
definition: International Association of Plumbing and Mechanical Officials (IAPMO) As a membership-based association, IAPMO is proud to utilize an open consensus process in the development of our flagship Uniform Plumbing Code® and Uniform Mechanical Code®. These codes are established through scientific research, debate, and analysis, strengthening our position at the forefront of the plumbing and mechanical industries. Www.iapmo.org
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Iso
definition: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) ISO is a non-governmental organization that forms a bridge between the public and private sectors. On the one hand, many of its member institutes are part of the governmental structure of their countries, or are mandated by their government.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mss
definition: The Manufacturers Standardization Society (MSS) of the Valve and Fittings Industry is a non-profit technical association organized for development and improvement of industry, national and international codes and standards for: Valves, Valve Actuators, Pipe Fittings, Valve Modification, Flanges, Pipe Hangers, and Associated Seals. The primary function of MSS is to provide its members the means to develop engineering standard practices for the use and benefit of the industry and users of its products. The Society, the only organization dedicated solely to the technical needs of the industry, is currently comprised of 25 technical committees to write, revise and reaffirm industry standards. http://mss-hq.org/
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Nsf
definition: National Sanitation Foundation International (NSF) NSF Internal helps protect you by certifying products and writing standard for food, water and consumer goods. NSF International is The Public Health and Safety Company™, providing public health and safety risk management solutions to companies, governments and consumers around the world. www.nsf.org
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Other
definition: Other agency not defined in the list
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: American Mechanical Joint
definition: An American Mechanical Joint is a rubber gasket is compressed by a ductile iron gland drawn up with low-alloy steel bolts which affords liberal deflection and allows expansion and contraction of the line without leakage and is rated for a water working pressure of up to 350 psi.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Belled
definition: The end length of increased diameter into which a pipe end can be fitted.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Butt
definition: The connection is a flat cut end designed to mate directly to the end of another product. This connection is to connect the same sized pipes or valve ends together.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compression Joint
definition: A compression joint kind of tubing or pipe connection where a nut, and then a sleeve or ferrule is placed over a copper or plastic tube and is compressed tightly around the tube as the nut is tightened, forming a positive grip and seal without soldering. Also a flexible compression fitting.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Crimped
definition: This type of joint requires the joint be crimped once sections are fit together. Some of the necessary connection parts must be added or acquired separately.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Female Threaded
definition: Female threaded
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Flanged Joint
definition: Flange generally refers to the actual raised rim or lip of a fitting which can be bolted to the flange of an opposite unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Flare Joint
definition: A Flare Joint is where a pipe or tube is widened to join with a larger diameter pipe, for example between a copper tube and a main water feed line.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Grooved Joint
definition: Outer diameter of item has a groove which is designed to be joined together using external gaskets and couplings.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lug
definition: The lug body has protruding lugs that provide bolt holes matching those in the flanges. An advantage of the lug body type is that piping on one side of the valve may be disassembled while the valve remains bolted in place, allowing for the remainder of the system to continue in operation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Male Threaded
definition: Male Threaded
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mechanical Joint
definition: A Mechanical Joint is a joint which typically consists of: (a) a flange which is integrally cast with the bell of the pipe, (b) a rubber gasket which fits into the recess in the socket, (c) a follower ring which compresses the gasket, and (d) nuts and bolts used to tighten the joint.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: No Hub Iron
definition: A connector for no-hub iron pipe consisting of a rubber sleeve and a stainless steel band secured by hose clamps. A variation, a neoprene sleeve with two adjustable steel bands, is used for connecting dissimilar materials, as when connecting new plastic pipe to an existing cast iron drain pipe.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pack Joint
definition: Pack Joint
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Plain
definition: SPG - Spigot, FTG- Fitting, M- Male Pipe Size- Straight end to connect or insert into the bell end or fitting to join to connecting pipe.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Press
definition: This type of joint requires the joint be crimped once sections are fit together. All of the necessary connection parts are present.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Push
definition: A joint which can be pushed onto the opposite end manually to form a solid connection. This type of connection fits around an inserted pipe or fitting end.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Quick Connect
definition: A connection which has the ability to joined and un-joined repeatedly or at will. This type of joint does not degrade the product over time. This type of joint is not considered by the industry to be a push joint.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Socket
definition: The connection is a female socket end designed to allow for the insertion of straight pipe/tubing and joined using soldering, sweating, brazing, welding, or cementing. This connection is also called solder cup, hub, or slip joint.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Swivel Joint
definition: This type of joint uses a pressure type seal while allowing rotation of the units being joined.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Union Joint
definition: This type of joint can connect and disjoint two pipes very easily without deformation to the pipe or tube.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Wafer
definition: A wafer is a seal using a tightly fitting seal, i.e., gasket, o-ring, precision machined, and a flat valve face on the upstream and downstream sides of the valve.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Yoke Joint
definition: A connection whereby a piece is expanded on one end into a seal face to form a joint.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Chemically Treated After Harvesting
definition: The fruit or vegetable has been treated chemically after harvesting e.g. Treated with a Chemical Preservative
codeListDefinition: Specifies if the fruit or vegetable has been treated or not post harvesting with a chemical or wax.

name: Not Treated After Harvesting
definition: The fruit or vegetable has been not been treated chemically or waxed after harvesting.
codeListDefinition: Specifies if the fruit or vegetable has been treated or not post harvesting with a chemical or wax.

name: Waxed
definition: The fruit or vegetable has had a layer of wax applied after harvesting.
codeListDefinition: Specifies if the fruit or vegetable has been treated or not post harvesting with a chemical or wax.

name: Crown Removed
definition: Product has had the plant part of itself removed e.g. the top of a pineapple.
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Cut
definition: Cut
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Fattened
definition: Fattened
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Leafless
definition: Produce all leaves removed  e.g. celery, radish.
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Minced
definition: Minced
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Packed In Ice
definition: Produce has been packed in ice.
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Slaughtered
definition: Slaughtered
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Split
definition: Produce has been cut/split into sections.
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Stem Removed
definition: Stem of produced has been removed e.g. cherry or broccoli.
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Trimmed
definition: Produce has been cut or removal of parts of item.
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Washed
definition: Produce has been cleaned by washing.
codeListDefinition: Produce has gone some physical process whether altered or other physical processes after harvesting.

name: Battery
definition: Trade Item is provided with batteries
codeListDefinition: Indicates the type of power supply the trade item is provided with for example a USB power supply or mains. A power supply is a hardware component that supplies power to an electrical device.

name: Mains
definition: Trade Item is provided with a mains power connection devices
codeListDefinition: Indicates the type of power supply the trade item is provided with for example a USB power supply or mains. A power supply is a hardware component that supplies power to an electrical device.

name: Solar
definition: Trade Item is provided with a solar power system
codeListDefinition: Indicates the type of power supply the trade item is provided with for example a USB power supply or mains. A power supply is a hardware component that supplies power to an electrical device.

name: USB
definition: Trade Item is provided with a USB power connection device
codeListDefinition: Indicates the type of power supply the trade item is provided with for example a USB power supply or mains. A power supply is a hardware component that supplies power to an electrical device.

name: Vehicle DC  Adapter
definition: Trade Item is provided with a vehicle DC Adapter
codeListDefinition: Indicates the type of power supply the trade item is provided with for example a USB power supply or mains. A power supply is a hardware component that supplies power to an electrical device.

name: Final
definition: Item has attribute values that reflect go to market state.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Preliminary
definition: The trade item has data that the information provider intends to correct or add values to due to pre-production unknowns.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Air Fry
definition: Cooking by circulating hot air around the food, allowing to fry, grill and roast without the use of fat or oil.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: As Drained
definition: The state of the product after it has been separated from any liquid within the package’’ – For example, a can of apricots in syrup would have a different nutritional composition if the apricots are consumed with the syrup rather than if the syrup is drained before consuming the apricots (because of the high sugar and energy content of the syrup).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bake
definition: Cooking food in an oven by dry heat applied evenly throughout the oven.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Barbecue
definition: Method of cooking meat with the heat and hot gasses of a fire
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Baste
definition: Basting is a cooking technique that involves cooking meat with either its own juices or some type of preparation such as a sauce or marinade. Similar to Pre-basted, Deep-basted and Self-basting.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Blanch
definition: Food preparation wherein the food substance is rapidly plunged into boiling water and then removed after a brief, timed interval and then plunged into iced water or placed under cold running water.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Blind Bake
definition: Baking a pie crust or other pastry without the filling
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Block form
definition: A product is formed or shaped into a larger geometric shape than what would be used for a serving or use. It is intended that the user would cut, slice, or otherwise separate portions of the item for individual consumption or use.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Boil
definition: Cooking food in boiling water, or other water-based liquid such as stock or milk
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Boneless
definition: The bones (vertebrae) have been removed from the flesh portion.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Braise
definition: Cooking with "moist heat", typically in a covered pot with a small amount of liquid
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bread
definition: A process where a piece of uncooked meat, poultry, fish or other seafood is coated with a combination of batter and breading or cracker crumbs.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Breast bone remove
definition: A meat or poultry product has had the sternum bone removed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Brew
definition: Brew: to prepare by steeping, boiling, and fermentation or by infusion and fermentation, to prepare (a drink or other liquid) by infusion in hot water
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Broil
definition: Cooking food with high heat with the heat applied directly to the food, most commonly from above. Heat transfer to the food is primarily via radiant heat
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Chunk
definition: A product is broken up into medium or larger pieces of irregular shape.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Combi Heat
definition:
Type of preparation in devices in which the heating of food is possible with different methods used together. For example:
• Microwave combined with hot air: Use this function to rapidly bake the foods. 
• Grill combined with fan: Use this function to bake evenly the food and at the same time brown their surface.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Combi Steam
definition: Type of preparation in a device that additional to the function of a convection oven is able to generate steam. By transmitting the temperature to the food via steam and convection cooking, times in Combi ovens are shorter than in general preparation types and the product loses less moisture.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Convection
definition: A cooking method which utilizes a convection oven which imparts heat assisted by fans to force air movement, as opposed to a conventional oven, which relies on convective heat transfer unassisted by fans. By moving fast hot air past the food, a convection oven operates at a lower temperature than a conventional oven. The air circulation, or convection, tends to eliminate "hot spots" and thereby cooking food more quickly and evenly.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cook
definition: Subjected to heat for a time sufficient to produce the characteristics of a cooked product. The product must be ready-to-eat. Also referred as fully cooked.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Corn
definition: The treatment of meat with large-grained rock salt, also called "corns" of salt, together with sodium nitrite, potassium nitrite, or any combination of them.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Crumble
definition: A product is broken up into medium or smaller sized pieces of irregular shape.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cube
definition: A product is cut into small to medium sized squares or rectangles.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Culture
definition: Bacterial cultures are added to pasteurized cream, to develop flavour, before it is churned into butter.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Deep Fry
definition: Cooking method whereby food is submerged in hot oil or fat.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Double Steam
definition: Cooking technique to prepare delicate food such as bird nests, shark fins etc. The food is covered with water and put in a covered ceramic jar
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dry
definition: The product is dried, a process to remove the moisture of the product. The product must be ready-to-eat.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fillet
definition: A fleshy boneless piece of meat from near the loins or the ribs of an animal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Filter wood smoke
definition: The use of smoke derived from burning select (hard) woods, then filtered to remove large particles. The bioactive compounds found in smoke are used to impart colour and flavour.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Flake
definition: Flaked is the leftover pieces of meat, poultry or fish.  It consists of small sized pieces, or "flakes"
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Form slices
definition: A product is formed separately as slices.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Freeze
definition: Convert the product from room temperature to a frozen state.Simple
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Freeze dry
definition: The product is dried by a process of freeze-drying.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fry
definition: The cooking of food in hot fats or oils.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Grate
definition: A product is reduced into smaller pieces by rubbing on something rough.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Griddle Fry
definition: Form of cooking where the food is fried with its own fat.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Grill
definition: Form of cooking that involves direct heat. The definition varies widely by region and culture
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Gutted
definition: Remove the intestines and other internal organs of an animal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Heat_And Serve
definition: Prepare the item by simply heating or warming to a desired temperature or visual state prior to serving
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: In shell
definition: A product is with or in its original shell. Can also be referred as "with shell" and shell on".
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Jelly
definition: Indicates that a gelling agent (agar, carrageenan or gelatin) has been used in the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Liquid smoke
definition: Liquid smoke is a natural by-product of burning wood. The vapor (smoke and steam), is condensed through a cooled tubing, is distilled into a concentrate, and filtered of its impurities (soot and ash). The meat product is subjected to heat in the presence of a vaporized liquid smoke solution.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mechanically separated meat
definition: A process where an edible meat is obtained by removing most of the bone and cartilage from a comminuted meat product from which the bone and cartilage was not previously removed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mechanically tenderise
definition: A process where the integrity of a solid and uncooked meat or poultry surface has been compromised by being pierced by blades, needles or other similar instruments, or the meat/poultry has been injected with a marinade or other tenderising solution.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Microwave
definition: Cooking food by employing microwave radiation
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mince
definition: A food preparation technique in which food ingredients are finely divided into uniform pieces.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mix
definition: Mixing of ingredients, sometimes includes additional ingredients. Example: Mixing powders in water or milk.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Multiple see preparation instructions
definition: Multiple preparation type steps are required for the product. See the preparation instructions for the needed steps.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pan Fry
definition: Form of frying characterised by the use of less cooking oil than deep frying
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Poach
definition: Cooking food by gently simmering food in liquid, generally water, stock or wine
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Prepared
definition: The state of the product after preparation (e.g. after adding milk or water).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pressure Cook
definition: Method of cooking in a sealed vessel that does not permit air or liquids to escape below a preset pressure
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pressure Fry
definition: Meat and cooking oil are brought to high temperatures while pressure is held high enough that the water within is prevented from boiling off
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Protein binders
definition: Treatment of meat or poultry products with functionally active proteins such as fibrinogen or transglutaminase to allow the proteins in the meat or poultry to encapsulate fat and hold fat and water together in the final sausage or product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Purify smoke
definition: A wood smoke process of fish and meat whereby the unhealthy substances found in un-purified smoke, such as polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), ash and tar, have been removed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ready_To Drink
definition: No Preparation. The trade Item is ready for use after being taken out of the packaging (if packaging exists) without the need of any further action prior to consumption or use
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ready_To Eat
definition: Besides unpacking no additional preparation required.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Reconstitute
definition: Restore a dry or concentrated food to its original strength or consistency by adding water.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Refrigerate
definition: Convert the product from room temperature to a chilled state.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Roast
definition: Cooking method that uses dry heat, whether an open flame, oven, or other heat source.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Roll
definition: A meat, poultry or fish product which has been boned, rolled and tied.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Rotisserie
definition: Style of roasting where meat is skewered on a spit and revolves over a flame
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Salt
definition: Indicates salt (sodium chloride) was added during manufacturing process.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Saute
definition: Cooking food using a small amount of fat in a shallow pan over relatively high heat
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sear
definition: Technique used in grilling, roasting, braising, sautéing, etc. That cooks the surface of the food (usually meat, poultry or fish) at high temperature so that a caramelised crust forms
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Season
definition:
Seasoning is the process of adding herbs, salts or spices to food to enhance the flavour.
Note:  In meat and poultry products it can also designate "Seasoned water".
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Semi boneless
definition: A meat or poultry product which has been at least 45% deboned.  Partial removal of bones can facilitate rolling or stuffing product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Semi dry
definition: The product is partially dried, process to reduce the moisture of the product. The product must be ready-to-eat.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shankless
definition: A meat or poultry which the forelimb or foreleg has been removed at the elbow joint or the hind limb of hind leg removed at the knee joint.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shave
definition: A product is cut off in thin layers that is larger than what would be termed shredded, but not as uniform as sliced.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shell remove
definition: A product is without its shell. It can also be referred as peeled for shellfish.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shred
definition: A product is pushed across or through a shredding surface to make long, narrow strips.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Simmer
definition: Cook food by heating it in water kept just below the boiling point (same as coddling)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Skinned (skin removed)
definition: Remove the skin from an animal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Slice
definition: A product is cut into thin, flat piece from a larger portion.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Slit shell
definition: A product is within their original shell with one exception that the shell has been slit along the back. Can also be referred to as Easy Pell, EZ peel and Zipperback
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Smoke
definition: Process of curing, cooking, or seasoning food by exposing it for long periods of time to the smoke from a wood fire
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Smoke flavour
definition: A flavour additive, "flavouring", based on liquid smoke.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Soak
definition: To immerse in liquid for a period of time. E.g. Soak the Chia seeds 10 minutes in water before eating.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Solid
definition: This term indicates how the meat, poultry or fish was packaged: Solid means it was packaged as a whole loin piece.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Split fish
definition: Split Fish is fish cut open from throat to vent or tail; or from nape to tail. Gills, guts and roe removed; head may sometimes be removed. The backbone may be left in or removed except for an inch or two at the tail.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Spreadable form
definition: A product is formulated in such a fashion as to be easily smoothed out onto another item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Steam
definition: Cooking by first boiling the water so it will evaporate into steam, then the steam will carry heat to the food, thus achieving heating the food
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stew
definition: Preparing meat cut into smaller pieces or cubes by simmering it in liquid, usually together with vegetables
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stick form
definition: A product is cut or formed into individual strips. Even in the stick state the item is still a solid product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stir Fry
definition: Chinese cooking technique used because of its fast cooking speed
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: String form
definition: A product is cut or formed into individual strips which when separated form or appear to be strings. While in its combined state, the item may appear to be a stick, but it is when the item is separated or consumed it takes on the string state.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stuff
definition: Stuffing, filling, or dressing is an edible mixture, composed of bread, grain, herbs, fruit, nuts, vegetables, fat or other ingredients, used to fill a cavity in the preparation of another food item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Thaw
definition: Convert the product from a frozen state to a chilled or room temperature state.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tips
definition: Fish trimmings, not minced, from the tail and nape sections of a fish.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Unprepared
definition: The initial state of the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Unspecified
definition: Unknown, not applicable
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Wedge
definition: A product is cut in triangular shaped pieces. In some cases, one side of the triangle may be an arc, specifically if the wedge was cut from an item which is in the shape of a wheel or circle.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Wheel form
definition: A product is formed in a round shape resembling a wheel or circle.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Whip
definition: To beat ingredient(s), such as egg whites, cream, etc., using a wire whisk or rotary/electric beater in order to incorporate air into the existing product, thereby increasing volume/stability.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Available only through a hospital when prescribed by a doctor.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: This pharmaceutical or medical device must be prescribed for the first time at a hospital.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: No_Prescription Required
definition: No prescription is needed for this trade item
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: A prescription is required and may be prescribed by any licensed prescriber.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Prescription Under Monitoring
definition: The healthcare product can be prescribed only after specific exams. The result of the exam (such as radiography, blood count, scanner, etc.) will determine if the product can be prescribed or not.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Specialist Prescription Required
definition: Medical Device of pharmaceutical must be prescribed under the direction of a specialist authorised to prescribe the trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Acidification
definition: Dropping pH of food
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Alcohol Curing
definition: Treatment of food by adding alcohol in order to preserve the product
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Alive
definition: Living animal or plant,  not dead.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Attested Milk
definition: Raw Milk (without heat treatment)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Boiling
definition: Cooking
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Brining
definition: Water saturating or strongly impregnating with salt
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Canning
definition: Preserved in a sealed airtight container, usually made of tin-coated iron
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cold Smoke Curing
definition: To smoke the food at between 70 degrees to 90 degrees F.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Conserve
definition: Keep from harm or damage
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dehydration
definition: To remove water from food
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Drying
definition: Making with moisture having evaporated, drained away
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fermentation
definition: Any of a group of chemical reactions induced by living or nonliving ferments that split complex organic compounds into relatively simple substance
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fine-filtered/Microfiltered
definition: Microfiltration (MF) is mainly used for the reduction of bacteria in skim milk, whey and brine. It is also used for defatting whey intended for whey protein concentrate (WPC) and for protein fractionation. MF membranes have a pore size of 10-1 to 101 µm. The resulting permeate of MF separation is water, minerals, lactose and some proteins.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Freeze Drying
definition: Preserving food by freezing and then drying in a vacuum
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Freezing
definition: Turning into ice or another solid by cold
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fresh
definition: Recently made or obtained food in its' natural conditions and not altered by any preservation methods
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fry
definition: The cooking of food in hot fats or oils.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Heated
definition: Preserving the food by exposure to heat (e.g. cooking, grilling, etc.). Specific heating requirements may be regulated by local legislation. Example: exposure to at least a temperature of 70 °C/158 °F for at least 10 minutes.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High Pressure Pasteurisation
definition: High Pressure Pasteurisation is a pasteurisation process where the product is treated with pressure of up to 10'000 bar and heat between 0°C and 120°C
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High Pressure Processing
definition: High Pressure Processing (HPP) is a pasteurisation process where the product is treated with pressure of up to 6’000 bar without the use of heat
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High Temperature Pasteurisation
definition: High Temperature Pasteurisation is a pasteurisation process where the product is treated with heat between 85°C and 135°C
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High temperature short time (HTST)
definition: High temperature short time (HTST) pasteurization requires fluid milk to be heated to 72°C for 15 seconds (continuous flow pasteurization).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High Temperature Treated Milk
definition: Legally also pasteurisation, MHD for longer (about 2 to 3 weeks), ESL-milk
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hot Smoke Curing
definition: Hot-smoking partially or totally cooks the food by treating it at temperatures ranging from 100 degrees to 190 degrees F.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ionisation
definition: To convert into an ion or ions
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Irradiation
definition: Food irradiation is the process of exposing food to ionising radiation in order to disinfest, sterilise, or preserve food.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Marinated
definition: Marinate a food in a mixture of e.g. oil, vinegar, spices, or herbs, before cooking it, so that it can develop a special flavour. This preserves the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Other
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pasteurisation
definition: Pasteurisation is a process where the product is treated with heat from 60°C to 85°C
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Preserved Without Artificial Nitrates
definition: A food is treated with natural curing agents and without artificial nitrates, e.g. celery powder.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Quick Freezing
definition: Freezing (food) rapidly so as to preserve its qualities
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Refrigerated
definition: Preserving the food by chilling and keeping it cold.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Salt Curing
definition: Preserving by using a salt brine
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sous Vide
definition: Low temperature long time cooking under vacuum
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sterilisation
definition: A process that effectively kills or eliminates transmissibleagents (such as fungi, bacteria, viruses, spore forms, etc.).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sugar Curing
definition: Treatment of food by adding sugar in order to preserve the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ultra-filtered
definition: A pasteurized product that is passed through filters which permit the smaller lactose, water, mineral, and vitamin molecules to pass through the membrane, while the larger protein and fat molecules are retained and concentrated.  As a result, the water and lactose (sugar) content is reduced; whereas the protein and calcium are increased.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ultra High Temperature
definition: Ultra High Temperature (UHT) is a pasteurisation process where the product is treated with high heat between 135°C and 155°C
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Under Modified Atmosphere
definition: Packed with a gas with protective proprieties
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vacuum Packed
definition: Sealed after the partial removal of air
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: The introduction of a new item.
definition: The introduction of a new item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Price decrease.
definition: Price decrease.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: A price increase.
definition: A price increase.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Range extension.
definition: Range extension.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Size change (Pack or Pallet).
definition: Size change (Pack or Pallet).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Temporary price reduction.
definition: Temporary price reduction.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Area
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Count
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Length
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Volume
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Weight
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: The weight of a product when all liquids used in the packaging of the product have been removed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using mililitres, litres or fluid ounces of as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per litre/pint drink including additives other than water).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using mililitre or litre as unitOfMeasure (price calculation of price per litre, not including the package deposit charge).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: The Price Comparison Content specified may be used to calculate the price per cubic metre.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using PCE as unit of measure (price per daily dose).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using pieces as unit of measure.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using gram or kilogram as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per kilogram).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using mililitre or litre as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per litre).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using pieces as unit of measure (allows calculation of price per load - used for washing up powder).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using metre as unitOfMeasure (allows caclulation of price per metre).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using pieces as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per piece).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using fluid ounce as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per pint)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using Ounce as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per pound)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: The Price Comparison Content specified may be used to calculate the price per square metre.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using pieces as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per wash - used for washing detergent).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using inches as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per yard)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using millilitre or litre or fluid ounces as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per litre/pint diluted drink).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Specified using grams, kilograms, or ounces as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per kilogram/pound prepared food).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Initial Load
definition: The sending of pricing information for the first time.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Reload
definition: Sending all current and known CURRENT pricing. This is used to start over by replacing previously synchronised information.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Resend
definition: Indicates that the message is used to recover a lost or missing message.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Restart
definition: The status used when a data recipient had rejected an item's pricing but wishes to resume price synchronisation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Resynchronisation of All Price Types
definition: Resynchronisation of all Price Types for pricing done at the lowest level consumer unit. Uses NO_ACTION code to differentiate price types that have changed from those that have not.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Allowance
definition: Credit reflected on an invoice.  This can occur either at the item or the invoice level. There are many types of allowances. Some are contractually based, e.g. backhaul, others are not formalized contracts. Some allowances are offered to the industry such as payment terms while others such as promotional allowances are trading partner specific.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bracket Tier Price
definition: The price associated with an item for the purchase of a specific number of trade items, or some other logistical measure (weight, cube, truck). These are often offered in a series (e.g. 100 to 299 case lots, 300 to 599, full truckload, half truckload; each offering a different discount).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Charge
definition: Debit reflected on an invoice.  This can occur either at the item or at the invoice level. There are many types of charges. Some are contractually based, others are not formalized contracts.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Contract Price
definition: The price associated with an item that has been negotiated or agreed to between trading partners exclusive of taxes but inclusive of allowances, charges and customs duty where applicable. This price would typically be associated with a formal contract between trading partners.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Declared Customs Value
definition: This is the value of the item as declared by the supplier. This value is used by customs to calculate the customs duty that is payable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Introductory Price
definition: Not Available
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: List Price
definition: External price associated with a product absent of all allowances or charges. This is normally the printed price contained on supplier’s price list or catalogue. (May or may not be customer specific).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Other
definition: An unspecified type.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Promotional Price
definition: A price that is available only as part of a promotion.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Retail Price
definition: The retail (to consumer) price as suggested by the manufacturer. May or may not appear on the package.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Transaction Price
definition: The line item/GTIN price shown on the invoice document, including allowances and/or charges applying to the trading partner relationship (which can be zero), but excluding VAT and any other taxes, fees, and/or duties.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Transaction Price With Special Taxes
definition: The line item / GTIN price shown on the invoice document, including allowances and/ or charges applying to the trading partner relationship (which can be zero),  excluding VAT, but including any other taxes, fees, and/or duties.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Transaction price with special taxes and early payment discount
definition: A specific financial allowance, comprising special taxes, whose goal is to identify a special price type and price value that the data recipient would pay to the data provider IF it pays the invoice in a certain delay (such delay is previously negotiated between the dataProvider and the dataRecipient and does not have to be communicated with the tariff)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Transaction Price With VAT and Special Taxes
definition: The line item / GTIN price shown on the invoice document, including allowances and/ or charges applying to the trading partner relationship (which can be zero), including both VAT and any other taxes, fees, and/or duties.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Transaction price with VAT and special taxes and early payment discount
definition: A specific financial allowance, comprising VAT and special taxes, whose goal is to identify a special price type and price value that the data recipient would pay to the data provider IF it pays the invoice in a certain delay (such delay is previously negotiated between the dataProvider and the dataRecipient and does not have to be communicated with the tariff)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Underbond List Price
definition: The price associated with an item exclusive of all allowances, charges, taxes and customs duty. (May or may not be customer specific). This applies to imported items that upon arrival into the country are stored in a Customs bonded warehouse. The goods are then sold without the customs duty paid. The purchaser must pay the customs duty.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Underbond Transaction Price
definition: The price associated with an item exclusive of all taxes and customs duty but inclusive of all allowances and charges. This applies to imported items that upon arrival into the country are stored in a Customs bonded warehouse. The goods are then sold without the customs duty paid. The purchaser must pay the customs duty.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Monetary Amount
definition: An amount of or relating to money.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Percent
definition: One part in a hundred.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Data Synchronisation
definition: The process of continuous harmonisation of information between all trading partners ensures that the master data is the same in all trading partners systems.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Item Authorisation
definition: The act of granting permission to sell (or deliver) an item at a specific location or groups of locations where the authorisation could be triggered by either trading partner depending on the buying and selling relationship through GDSN.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Item Futurisation
definition: The process framework for communicating information related to CURRENT trade item version information using the Global Data Synchronisation Network (GDSN).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Party Synchronisation
definition: The process of synchronising party Master Data through GDSN.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Price Synchronisation
definition: The process of synchronising price information through GDSN.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Almost Seedless
definition: Item contains significantly less than normal mature seeds for this particular variety. Some mature seeds will exist in trade item. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines.
codeListDefinition: Specifies the amount of seeds for fresh fruits and vegetables e.g. for water melons, citrus fruits. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate.

name: Seedless
definition: Item contains No mature Seeds or potentially a few errant seeds. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines.
codeListDefinition: Specifies the amount of seeds for fresh fruits and vegetables e.g. for water melons, citrus fruits. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate.

name: Seeds
definition: Item contains the normal amount of mature seeds which are typical for this trade item. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines.
codeListDefinition: Specifies the amount of seeds for fresh fruits and vegetables e.g. for water melons, citrus fruits. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate.

name: Unidentified
definition: Quantity or presence of seeds not determined
codeListDefinition: Specifies the amount of seeds for fresh fruits and vegetables e.g. for water melons, citrus fruits. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate.

name: Assembly
definition: Country where product is assembled.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Birth
definition: The place the animal was born/hatched. The place may be a country, region (land or sea), city, etc. The actual birth place of a particular animal would be transactional. Note: the term animal includes but is not limited to mammals, birds, fish and crustaceans.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bottling
definition: The place in which the beverage is bottled.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Catch zone
definition: The sea zone in which the seafood in the trade item was caught.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cutter
definition: The place where the cutting operation on the carcass or group of carcasses is performed. e.g. approval number of the cutting hall acc. to Regulation EC No 1760/2000 of the European Parliament. Note: The animal is not killed at this location.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Farming
definition: The cultivation of animals, plants, fungi, and other life forms
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Importation
definition: The country from where the trade item has been purchased by the importer.
