name: Add Additional Language
definition: Used to identify the addition of one or more languages to the product’s primary language.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Additional Declared Net Content
definition: Used to identify an additional net content to provide an additional expression of the same net content.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Marketing Declarations
definition: Used to identify a marketing declaration such as “Improved Scent” and “Lasts 2x longer”… which are designed to impact consumer decisions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Minor Artwork Changes
definition: Used to identify an artwork change to the package artwork to promote or market the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Minor Formulation Change
definition: Used to identify a small change of formulation (example: a change to a type of oil that does not impact allergen claims…but may impact consumer decisions or online information)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Packaging with Minor Impact
definition: Used to identify a change to the dimensions (H W D) of a product that is less than 20%. Changing packaging dimensions less than 20% may still have an impact on consumer decision in certain product categories.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Primary Version
definition: Status on a CPV to notify recipient that a CPV is no longer active and that a previous version is now the active primary version.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Produced In different Locations
definition: Used to identify when a country of origin must be distinguished and declared, but a new GTIN is not required (apparel), CPV allows for that sharing. Likely to impact consumer decisions in many product categories.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product Name and Description
definition: Used to identify a change in name or description of a product (example: from “Spicy” potato chips to “Bold and Spicy”). Such a change may impact consumer decisions or online information.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Reconfiguration of Consumer Pack
definition: Used to identify a change in the configuration of a package, for example from a “sports top” to a twist off cap. This could impact consumer decisions or online information.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Removial of Additional Declared Content UOM
definition: Used to identify the removal of an additional net content expression.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Remove Additional Language
definition: Used to identify the removal of one or more languages from the product’s primary language.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Time Critical Promotion
definition: Used to identify a seasonal/time critical artwork/marketing declaration.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vintage
definition: Particularly used for high-volume/sell through wine who’s quality/price is not distinguishable by vintage but that contains a year on the bottle (as this year may impact a consumer decision).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lot number
definition: Lot number
codeListDefinition: The scope of the Recall or FSCA. Example: Brain electrostimulation, Contact Lenses, etc.

name: Serial number
definition: Serial number
codeListDefinition: The scope of the Recall or FSCA. Example: Brain electrostimulation, Contact Lenses, etc.

name: Software version
definition: Software version
codeListDefinition: The scope of the Recall or FSCA. Example: Brain electrostimulation, Contact Lenses, etc.

name: Unique device identifier - device identifier (UDI-DI)
definition: Unique device identifier - device identifier (UDI-DI)
codeListDefinition: The scope of the Recall or FSCA. Example: Brain electrostimulation, Contact Lenses, etc.

name: Self Service
definition: The product should be placed in an area where the consumer can self serve themselves to their purchase needs. The product may have been portioned, cut or modified prior.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Service Counter
definition: The product is recommended to be placed at a location where an employee from the trading partner will need to portion, cut, or modify the product to the end consumer based upon consumer need
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Not Required
definition: Protective equipment is not required.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Recommended
definition: It is advised that protective equipment should be worn.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Required
definition: Protective equipment must be worn
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Added
definition: A new record has been added to the data base.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Changed
definition: An existing record has been updated.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Deleted
definition: An existing record has been deleted.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Not Found
definition: No record found.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: 360 Degree Image
definition: Allows x-axis interactive rotation of product via website.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ambience/mood image
definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to invoke a connection to the item by setting a "mood" or feeling for the item and its use.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Application image
definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to depict how the product itself is used.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Assembly Instructions
definition: Link to a file the explains how to assemble (put together) the trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Audio
definition: Link to a file containing an audio clip which is relevant to the product. Examples are commercials, or instructional/ how to use audio files.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Award certificate
definition: The award certificate is a written document created by the Award Committee that describes the terms and conditions of the Award. Example: http://www.cronierwines.com/awards-in-2016/
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Barcode
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the barcode which is on the product or its packaging.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Certification
definition: Document which contains a special certification by a third party (e.g. International Food Standard [IFS], QS-Approval Mark for meat product, sausage, fruit, vegetables and potatoes or bio audits).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Chemical Assessment Summary
definition: Link to a file containing the chemical ingredient information sent to the supplier from a third party as a result of the assessment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Chemical Safety Report
definition: Link to the file containing a report detailing the risks arising from the manufacture and/or use of a substance and to ensure that they are adequately controlled.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Child Nutrition Label
definition: Link to a file containing the Child Nutrition Label as formatted according to regulations and rules of an appropriate regulatory body for the target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cleaning, disinfection and sterilisation instructions
definition: The cleaning, disinfection and/or sterilisation instructions that apply to the product. These may be in accordance with EN-ISO 17664.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Clinician medicine information
definition: A clinician focused product information document that is written by the pharmaceutical company responsible for the medicine. This document is intended to assist doctors, pharmacists and other health professionals in prescribing and dispensing medicines. In addition, this information can be used by health professionals in their consultations with patients, so that the patient can be better informed about their medicines.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Consumer Handling and Storage
definition: Link to a website, file, or image containing the manufacturer's recommendations for how the consumer or end user should store and handle the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Content/texture image
definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to depict the content or texture of an item. The image should be designed in such a way that the texture can be experienced by the consumer similar to stationary retail, e.g. creme, lipstick.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Crosssection View
definition: A picture of a trade item with a cut away vertical plane removed (e.g. Cross-section of a Tire revealing steel belts and tire tread detail).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Declaration of Conformity
definition:
A Declaration of Conformity is a document in which the manufacturer states that the product satisfies the essential requirements of the applicable legislation(s), e.g. for toys, medical devices or electrical equipment. By drawing up and signing the EU Declaration of Conformity, the manufacturer assumes responsibility for the compliance of the product. For more information please see
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX:32019R1020&from=DE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Diet Certificate
definition: Link to a website or file containing a diet certificate granted to the product
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Instructions for disposal
definition: Link to a website, file or instruction movie how to dispose a product properly or how to clean up a broken product in case the product contains materials like mercury.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Document
definition: Link to a document or text file containing product information. Examples of this type could be an instruction manual, assembly guide, or warranty document.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dop Sheet
definition: Link to a file containing the product's Declaration of Performance Sheet (DOP). This file can be either an image or a document.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Drug Fact Label
definition: The file link is to a drug fact panel of the trade item. A drug fact label usually contains such items as active ingredients, uses, warnings, purpose, directions, etc.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ecological fact sheet
definition: Link to a file containing the details of a product with its environmental impact and performance. E.g. Beelong.ch Eco-Score Fact Sheet.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Energy Label
definition: Link to the energy label for a trade item.  On 19 May 2010, the EU adopted the Directive 2010/30/EU on energy labels. Energy labels help consumers choosing products which save energy and thus money. They also provide incentives for the industry to develop and invest in energy efficient product design. They are found on a selection of white goods and other products and are designed to help customers see how energy efficient a model is before they buy.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Food contact conformity certificate
definition: The certificate of conformity for suitability for food contact is a document issued by the manufacturer or the person placing the product on the European market. It certifies that the product sold complies with the EC Regulation 1935/2004. Thus, it is proven to be safe to get in contact with food.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Group Characteristic Sheet
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hazardous Substances Data
definition: Link to a file where to locate the ‘out of network data’ additional data concerning the control of substances can be found.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: IFU/eIFU (Instructions for use)
definition: Link to a file containing the (electronic) Instructions For Use (IFU or eIFU).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Instructions for use including cleaning disinfection sterilisation instructions
definition: Indicates that the instructions for cleaning/disinfecting/sterilisation are included in the IFU (Instructions For Use).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ingredients label
definition: The Ingredients label image is a list of ingredients printed on the packaging. It may be separated by language in multiple areas on the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Internal View
definition: The picture of the inside of a trade item mainly used for non food products (e.g., The inside of a refrigerator or the inside of a suitcase.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Lighting fact label
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing information related to the light characteristics of the product. The lighting facts label makes it easy to compare bulb characteristics such as brightness, colour, life, and estimated operating cost for the year.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Logo
definition: Link to a file containing the Manufacturer or Brand Logo(s) associated with the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Marketing Information
definition: Link to a file with product information associated with selling a product or service.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Material Samples
definition: URL to website, images that the potential material, swatches, finishes the trade item might be available in.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mobile Device Image
definition: Trade Item image that represents the image the manufacturer supplies to the consumer for mobile device applications. This would be a pack shot or image of the trade item that may be optimised for digital mobile display or added elements to help consumer recoginise the product. This should not be used as the Mobile Ready Hero Image. Some regulations require an actual image of the product and do not allow Mobile Ready Hero Images.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mobile Ready Hero Image
definition: A Mobile Ready Hero Image (MRHI) is a representation of a real world product that may differ from a standard pack shot, but that maintains the majority of the physical pack’s key elements of design, shape and colour, and is therefore recognisable on a digital shelf. In addition the image should contain elements of The 4 Ws: Who is the brand, What it is, Which variety it is and how much. The Mobile Ready Hero Image (MRHI) is specified in the GS1 Mobile Ready Hero Image Guideline https://www.gs1.org/standards/Mobile-Ready-Hero-Image
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Montage image
definition: A Montage is the physical over layering of distinct images to create a final digital image. This process allows for a composite to be created with the future possibility of reconstruction without having to return to studio for correction, should an element be added or removed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Nutrition Fact Label
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the nutritional information.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Nutrition Fact Label with Ingredients
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the nutritional information with the inclusion of the ingredient statement.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Optimised hero image
definition: An Optimised Hero Image type is to support retail, consumers, distributors and foodservice operators in completing their online sites. These images will assist consumers to identify specific information about the products they are purchasing. The image is a representation of a real world product, built specifically for use on larger screens that may differ from a standard pack shot, but that maintains the majority of the physical pack’s key elements of design, shape and colour, and is therefore recognisable on a digital shelf.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Organic Certificate
definition: Link to a website or file containing an organic certificate granted to the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Other External Information
definition: Link to a file containing product information of an unspecified type.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Out of Package Image
definition: Link to an image of an item out of its packaging and, if necessary, assembled ready for use by the end user. This type of file is subject the current version of the GDSN Product Image Specification Standard.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Packaging Artwork
definition: Design files for packaging artwork for example Adobe source files.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Patient information leaflet
definition: A leaflet or brochure containing important information to patients/consumers about the product to facilitate discussion and assist with the decision-making process. Example: A leaflet on a medical device like a hip joint. Or a consumer/patient-focused leaflet that contains information on the safe and effective use of a medicines. Often known in some markets as Consumer Medicines Information sheet (CMI), Product Information Leaflet (PiL/ePIL).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Petfood Feeding Instructions
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the feeding instructions for the petfood product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Planogram
definition: Link to a file illustrating how and where retail products should be displayed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Preparation Instructions
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the preparation instructions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product Formulation Statement
definition: Link to a file containing the Product Formulation Statement, in lieu of a Child Nutrition Label, as formatted according to regulations and rules of an appropriate regulatory body for the target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product Image
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product Label Image
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product Website
definition: Link to a website containing product specific information. Examples of this could be a link to a website dedicated to the product or a link to the area within the manufacturer or brand owner website that contains the product information
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Link to QR Code
definition: Link to a QR code URL/URI.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Quality Control Plan
definition: Document which detailed information about the quantity of laboratory/analytical tests and the evaluated parameters.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Recipe Website
definition: Link to a website containing recipes associated with the product
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Recyclability assessment certificate
definition: Link to a file containing the certificate for recyclability granted to the packaging of the item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Regulatory Inspection Audit
definition: Inspection report of the inspections. For example foodstuffs, pharmaceuticals and other types of products that are regulated.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Risk Analysis Document
definition: Document which describes how the supplier assured the quality control of the end products or during the production process. The process can be a supplier internal control system, a simple kind of risk analysis or systematic preventive approach according Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Safety Data Sheet
definition: Link to a file containing the product's Safety Data Sheet (SDS). This file can be either an image or a document
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Safety Summary Sheet
definition: A link to a summary sheet document that is available to workers to understand how to deal with chemicals in an emergency situation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sample Shipping Order
definition: Document is a sample shipping order. A sample shipping order isn´t needed for every item (GTIN), but a shipping order can differ from GTIN to GTIN. E.g. in case an item is an organic product the sample shipping order needs to contain the organic product origin number according article 31 of the implementing regulations EG Nr. 889/2008. For non-organic items this information isn´t needed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sidekick image
definition: Retail, consumers, distributors and foodservice operators complete their online transactions using their smart devices. These images may be used to inform a customer of benefits or nutritional claims of a product. This is a supplementary image or graphic, generally used to support the Hero image.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Social media image
definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to depict the social media associated to the item. This image is being shared on the social media outlet.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Summary of Product Characteristics
definition: Specific document required before any medicinal product or biocidal product is authorized for marketing.  Example European Commission
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Supplement facts label
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing information related to the supplement or nutrient product. The supplement facts label provides about what active/nutritional ingredients are used in the formula along with dosage recommendations for dietary supplements.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Technical data sheet
definition: The product specification sheet, created by the manufacturer, summarises the technical characteristics and other properties of the product, relating to technological and commercial purposes. Example: https://dl.gedal.fr/docsgedal/FP/3255290252425.pdf
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Technical Drawing
definition:
A precise and detailed technical drawing of an object, as employed in industries such as engineering, construction, architecture etc. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Testing Methodology Results
definition: Document which contains microbiological and physico-chemical findings of the product which are observed during product testing.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Trade Item Description
definition: Identifies the reference to an external description of a Trade Item. The link (e.g. URL) to the external description. will be in the appropriate attribute
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Trade Item Image With Dimensions
definition: Link to a website, file, or image containing the product's image with its dimensions. This especially important for built-in products as ovens and fridges. Ex : http://www.docstoc.com/docs/125126778/GSS-GEW-Food-Savers-Food-Storage-Containers.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Video file
definition: Link to a product-related video file. Examples are commercials, trailers, or instructional / how to use video files.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Visual verification image
definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product for the purpose of visual verification. Usage may be to examine the trade item master data against the product image. Note these images might not necessarily comply with image standards and may be restricted for a visual verification usage.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Warranty Information
definition: Link to a file with information associated with any guarantee given by a company stating that a product is reliable and free from known defects and that the seller will, without charge, repair or replace defective parts within a given time limit and under certain conditions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Website
definition: Link to a website containing product or manufacturer information.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Zoom View
definition: A picture of a portion of a trade item (e.g., the wheels of a suitcase or the ingredients list of a food trade item).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dependent Proprietary
definition: Dependent trade items are Trade Items which may be required or which may be used in conjunction with the current trade item to make the current trade item functional.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Equivalent
definition: A product which can be substituted for the trade item based on supplier- defined functional equivalence to the trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Item Variant Master
definition: Another trade item of which this trade item is a variant. Used when the trade item is a variant of a previously specified trade item for example a new flavour of an existing soft drink. This reference may be used when the trade item has identical package type, physical dimensions and brand name as the itemVariantMaster trade item. This attribute only creates a logical link to a similar product. It is not used to negate the need for sending all item information about this product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Preferred
definition: A GTIN identification assigned by the manufacturer for the purpose of grouping multiple versions of the same title (e.g. limited edition, etc.).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Primary Alternative
definition: A Trade Item that is similar to the current Trade Item but is not exact match. Same form fit function, e.g. same product different colour, different package size, better quality.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Replaced
definition: Indicates the trade item identification of an item that is being permanently replaced by this trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Replaced By
definition: The trade item which permanently replaces the current trade item. This Trade Item is sent in the record for the original item that is being replaced.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Substituted
definition: The original trade item that is temporarily being replaced. This attribute is used with the replacement trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Substituted By
definition: The trade item that is temporarily replacing the original GTIN. This attribute is used on the original trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Canceled
definition: The catalogue item that was never manufactured has been removed from the Global Registry.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Discontinued
definition: The catalogue item that has been in the supply chain has been removed from the supply chain.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: In Progress
definition: The Catalogue Item is in the process of being processed at the Global Registry.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Registered
definition: The Catalogue Item has been registered at the Global Registry.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Carcinogenic mutagenic reprotoxic (CMR) substance
definition: Carcinogenic mutagenic reprotoxic (CMR) substance
codeListDefinition: The type of regulated chemical as defined by the regulatory agency. Example Endocrine Substance, Human Product, Medicine Product.

name: Endocrine substance
definition: Endocrine substance
codeListDefinition: The type of regulated chemical as defined by the regulatory agency. Example Endocrine Substance, Human Product, Medicine Product.

name: Human product
definition: Human product
codeListDefinition: The type of regulated chemical as defined by the regulatory agency. Example Endocrine Substance, Human Product, Medicine Product.

name: Medicinal product
definition: Medicinal product
codeListDefinition: The type of regulated chemical as defined by the regulatory agency. Example Endocrine Substance, Human Product, Medicine Product.

name: Country
definition: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.
codeListDefinition: The type of territory the regulation is issued by for example a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under a government. Examples include; UNION, MUNICIPALITY, PROVENCE_OR_STATE.

name: Municipality
definition: A city, town, or other district possessing corporate existence and usually its own local government.
codeListDefinition: The type of territory the regulation is issued by for example a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under a government. Examples include; UNION, MUNICIPALITY, PROVENCE_OR_STATE.

name: Provence Or State
definition: One of the constituent units of a nation having a federal government.
codeListDefinition: The type of territory the regulation is issued by for example a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under a government. Examples include; UNION, MUNICIPALITY, PROVENCE_OR_STATE.

name: Union
definition: A group of states or nations united into one political body.
codeListDefinition: The type of territory the regulation is issued by for example a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under a government. Examples include; UNION, MUNICIPALITY, PROVENCE_OR_STATE.

name: Aerosol_Reverse Epsilon
definition: Products complying with all the requirements of the Aerosol Directive are marked with the "reverse epsilon" symbol
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Agriculture_Protection Regulation
definition: Products complying with EU Council Directive 91/414/EEC. This directive concerning the placing of plant protection products on the market lays down rules and procedures for approval of the active substances at EU-level and for the authorisation at Member State level of plant protection products (PPPs) containing these substances. This Directive states that substances cannot be used in plant protection products unless they are included in a positive EU list. Once a substance is included in the positive list Member States may authorise the use of products containing them.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Animal ID Health Mark
definition: Food business operators, in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 853/2004, should ensure that all products of animal origin that they place on the market, bear either a health mark or an identification mark.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Battery Directive
definition: Directive describing the legal requirements on batteries intended to made available on the market provided that such products are labelled, marked or accompanied with commercial documents. Essentially safety and environmental aspects are defined (e.g. obligation of the seller to take batteries back, proscription to throw batteries into the household garbage) for different type of batteries (e.g. batteries used by the end consumer, batteries used in cars). In Germany the law on batteries (BattG) details these rules.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Biocide Regulation
definition: Regulation (e.g., EU Reg 528/2012) harmonising the rules on making available on the market and using biocidal products whilst ensuring a high level of protection of both human and animal health and the environment. It should not be used for trade items treated with biocidal products ('treated articles').
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: BPA Regulation
definition: Indicates the product has a regulatory requirement to show to the consumer that it may or may not contain Bisphenol A (BPA).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Buy American Act
definition:
The Buy American Act - requires the United States government to prefer U.S.-made products in its purchases. This includes the Berry Amendment to the Act in the provisioning of products for the US Government and federal programs like National School Lunch. 
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buy_American_Act
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Buy American Provision USDA
definition:
The Buy American Provision in accordance with the USDA is Section 104(d) of the William F. Goodling Child Nutrition Reauthorization Act of 1998 (Public Law 105-336) added a provision, Section 12(n) to the National School Lunch Act (NSLA) (42 USC 1760(n)), requiring school food authorities (SFAs) to purchase, to the maximum extent practicable, domestic commodities or products. This Buy American provision supports the mission of the Child Nutrition Programs, which is to serve children nutritious meals and support American agriculture. 
https://www.fns.usda.gov/school-meals/compliance-enforcement-buy-american
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: CE
definition: The CE marking is the manufacturer's, distributor's or EU authorised representative's declaration that the product meets EU standards for health, safety, protection of consumers and environmental protection in accordance with the regulation. The CE mark indicates that the product may be sold freely in any part of the European Economic Area, regardless of its country of origin. The mark consists of the CE logo and, if applicable, the four-digit identification number of the notified body involved in the conformity assessment procedure.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compliant With Fair Labor Standards Act
definition: The FLSA established a national minimum wage guaranteed 'time-and-a-half' for overtime in certain jobs, and prohibited most employment of minors in "oppressive child labor," a term that is defined in the statute. It applies to employees engaged in interstate commerce or employed by an enterprise engaged in commerce or in the production of goods for commerce, unless the employer can claim an exemption from coverage.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compliant With Flammability Act
definition: Compliant With Flammability Act
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compliant With Fur Product Labeling Act
definition: Requires the country of origin of imported furs to be disclosed on all labels and in all advertising
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compliant With State Environment Requirements
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compliant With Textile Fiber Product Identification
definition: A US regulation regarding the advertising and labelling of textile fibre products.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Compliant With Wool Products Labeling Act
definition: A US regulation that requires anyone who manufacturers or sells products containing wool to accurately label each item with the fibre content and origin
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Consumer product safety
definition: Regulation ensuring that products placed on the market are safe for consumer use, enhancing market surveillance and traceability, and introducing clear obligations for economic operators to prevent and manage product risks. E.g., EU Regulation 2023/988, or regulations from the Consumer Product Safety Commission in the US.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Contains Composite Wood
definition: Describes that the trade item or packaging contains composite wood that falls under regulatory menas due to chemicals used in process to create the wood, such as Formaldehyde  has both cancer and noncancer-causing effects on human health. For example:  California Air Resources Board is a department of the California Environmental Protection Agency. CARB’s mission, US EPA. https://www.epa.gov/formaldehyde .
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cosmetic_Information Regulation
definition: Regulation (EU Reg 1223/2009) establishing rules to be complied with any cosmetic product made available on the market, a high level of protection of human health and a high degree of protection of the environment. These rules include the necessity to indicate allergens and the displaying of the ingredients used in the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Declaration of performance (DOP) required
definition: A Declaration Of Performance (DOP) is legally required. See target market regulations for applicability.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Detergents_Safety Regulation
definition: Regulation  establishing rules designed to achieve the free movement of detergents and surfactants for detergents in the market while, at the same time, ensuring a high degree of protection of the environment and human health. For example (EU Reg 648/2004)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: E-mark
definition: The Estimated Sign (℮) (also referred to as "e-mark") is a mark that sometimes can be found on pre-packed goods in Europe. The e-mark indicates that the packaging is filled according to the European Directive 76/211/EEC.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Efficiency of Lamps Luminaries
definition: A directive defining the energy labeling of electrical lamps and luminaires (e.g. EU Reg 874/2012). This directive deals with environmental aspects as the electricity used by electrical lamps accounts for a significant share of total electricity demand.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: EMC Directive
definition: The main objective of the Directive 2004/108/EC of the European Council, of 15 December 2004, is to regulate the compatibility of equipment regarding EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Enclosed Attached Information
definition: Indicates the product contains enclosed or attached information available for regulatory compliance where applicable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Energy Guide Label Required
definition: A code that indicates that a trade item is in compliance with energy efficiency guide and is labelled as such.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: EU Regulation Label Required
definition:
Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 28 January 2002 laying down the general principles and requirements of food law, establishing the European Food Safety Authority and laying down procedures in matters of food safety. 
For the purposes of this Regulation, "food" (or "foodstuff") means any substance or product, whether processed, partially processed or unprocessed, intended to be, or reasonably expected to be ingested by humans. "Food" includes: drink, chewing gum and any substance, including water, intentionally incorporated into the food during its manufacture, preparation or treatment. It includes water after the point of compliance.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Restricted explosive precursors
definition: The product is concerned with the marketing and use of explosives precursors and must be registered by the economic operator. Explosives precursors are chemical substances that can be used for legitimate purposes, but that can also be misused to manufacture homemade explosives. For example restricted explosive precursors listed in Annex I of the Regulation (EU) No 2019/1148.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Reportable explosive precursors
definition: The product is concerned with the marketing and use of explosives precursors and must be reported by the economic operator. Explosives precursors are chemical substances that can be used for legitimate purposes, but that can also be misused to manufacture homemade explosives. For example reportable explosive precursors listed in Annex II of the Regulation (EU) No 2019/1148.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Feed_Safety Regulation
definition: Regulation (EU Reg 767/2009) to harmonise the conditions for the placing on the market and the use of feed, in order to ensure a high level of feed safety and thus a high level of protection of public health, as well as to provide adequate information for users and consumers.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Food For Special Purposes
definition: Regulation providing the basis for the assurance of a high level of consumer protection in relation to specialized food like food for infants and young children, food for special medical purposes, and total diet replacement for weight control (e.g. EU Reg 609/2013).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Food_Information Regulation
definition: Regulation providing the basis for the assurance of a high level of consumer protection in relation to food information, taking into account the differences in the perception of consumers and their information needs whilst ensuring the smooth functioning of the market. General principles, requirements and responsibilities governing food information, and in particular food labelling rules are established (e.g. EU regulation 1169 / 2011). These rules include the necessity to indicate allergens, the responsible food business operator, the name of the food, the displaying of the ingredients used additives.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Food Labelling Under 2 Years of Age
definition: Foods, other than infant formula, represented or purported to be specifically for infants and children less than 2 years of age shall bear nutrition labelling.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Food Labelling Under 4 Years of Age
definition: Foods, other than infant formula, represented or purported to be specifically for infants and children less than 4 years of age shall bear nutrition labelling.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Food_Supplement Directive
definition: Food supplements (EU directive 2002/46/EC) marketed as foodstuffs and presented as such. These products shall be delivered to the ultimate consumer only in a pre-packaged form. Consumer health and safety aspects are in focus as well as to provide adequate information on how to use the product properly.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Free Pharmaceutical Products Directive
definition: Directive describing the legal requirements on pharmaceutical products which are commercially available and intended to made available on the market provided that such products are labelled, marked or accompanied with commercial documents. General Consumer safety aspects are in focus like the dosage form linked with an application instruction (e.g. Do not use with alcohol). In Germany the law on medical products (AMG) details these rules.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: French Spare Parts Regulation
definition: Decree No. 2014-1482 of 9 December 2014 on the information and supply obligations concerning spare parts indispensable for the use of a good
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hazards classification, labelling and packaging regulation
definition: Regulation providing the basis to ensure that workers and consumers are clearly informed of the hazards associated with chemicals by means of a system of classification and labelling. The aim is to ensure that the same hazards are described and labelled in the same way in all concerned countries (e.g. Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 December 2008 on Classification, Labelling and Packaging (CLP) of substances and mixtures).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Herbicide Regulation
definition: The item is a substance used to control unwanted plants that are subject to regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Infant formula Labelling
definition: Infant formula except foods, shall be labelled in compliance with regulations.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Intended to Come Into Contact with Food
definition: Requires that food contact materials a re safe; Must not transfer their components into food in quantities that could endanger human health, change food composition in an unacceptable way or deteriorate its taste and odour. Are manufactured according to good manufacturing practice.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: LVD Directive
definition: The Low Voltage Directive (LVD) 2006/95/EC provides common broad objectives for safety regulations, so that electrical equipment approved by any EU member country will be acceptable for use in all other EU countries. The Low Voltage Directive does not supply any specific technical standards that must be met, instead relying on IEC technical standards to guide designers to produce safe products. Products that conform to the general principles of the Low Voltage Directive and the relevant particular safety standards are marked with the CE marking to indicate compliance and acceptance throughout the EU. Conformance is asserted by the manufacturer based on its conformity assessment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Market Authorisation
definition: The trade item has been authorised to be sold by a regulatory agency to be distributed in a market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Medical_Device Safety
definition: A directive establishing common rules on the safety, health protection and performance characteristics of medical devices in order to provide the safety and health protection of patients, users and, where appropriate, other persons, with regard to the use of medical devices ((e.g. Medical Device Regulation (EU) 2017/745) and in-vitro diagnostic devices (e.g. In vitro Diagnostic Device Regulation (EU) 2017/746)).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Minimum Durability
definition: Indicates the product has a regulatory requirement to show to the consumer the best to use before period so they obtain the full functionality of the product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Nano materials presence
definition: Indicates the presence of nano materials by the levels acceptable by the appropriate regulation. Note: in Europe, use code NANOPARTICLE in attribute claimElementCode instead.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Not Applicable
definition: Not Applicable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Packaging Safety Directive
definition: The product represented in its packaging and/or marketing as appropriate for use by persons as defined by regulatory agency?  Includes packaging, display, photography, licensed characters, promotion or advertising (in-store or ad) as appropriate for use by persons. An example is the Consumer Product Safety Commission regulation: https://www.cpsc.gov/Regulations-Laws--Standards/Statutes/Poison-Prevention-Packaging-Act/Child-Resistant-and-Senior-Friendly-Packages-packaging-guide/.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Period Safe To Use After Opening
definition: Indicates the product has a regulatory requirement to show to the consumer that product is denoted to have a period of time after opening before it becomes harmful to the consumer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pesticide Regulation
definition: The item is a substance used to control unwanted pests that are subject to regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pharmaceutical_Product Directive
definition: In contrast to the free pharmaceutical directive this directive describing the legal requirements on pharmaceutical products available only in pharmacies. These products have stronger regulations and restrictions to consumer safety aspects. For example the dosage recommendation needs to be explained in detail by the sales staff as well as possible interaction with other pharmaceutical products.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product Labelling Regulation
definition: A code indicating the trade item is compliant with the food labelling regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Product of Daily Use Directive
definition: Directive describing the legal requirements on the products of daily use focusing on consumer safety (e.g. do not use with …, not used by children). An example is the German directive BedGgstV.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Proposition 65 (Prop 65) [US California]
definition: Containing specific toxicants for a product which contains carcinogens and/or reproductive toxicants established in California’s Proposition 65 (Prop 65), The Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act, enacted in 1986.  This Act requires the state to publish a list of chemicals known to cause cancer or reproductive harm. Prop 65 applies to suppliers who sell products in the state if their products exceed safe harbour levels established in Prop 65. Safe harbour levels establish thresholds for no significant risk levels (NSRLs) for carcinogens and maximum allowable dose levels (MADLs) for chemicals that cause reproductive toxicity.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Regulated by Agency
definition: The trade item is regulated by the agency stated in the regulatoryAgency attribute.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Returning of Electronic Product Directive
definition: Directive of the returning of electronic products ensuring a high degree of protection of the environment. This directive defines returning quotes of returning electronical products needs to be fulfilled by the industry and by retailers (e.g. ElektroG in Germany).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: ROHS Directive
definition: Is not a quality mark but a European directive 2002/95/EC (stands for Restriction of Hazardous Substances). This directive restricts (with exceptions) the use of six hazardous materials like lead, cadmium and mercury in the manufacture of various types of electronic and electrical equipment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Safety data sheet required
definition: A Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is legally required. See target market regulations for applicability.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Scattered pollution regulation
definition: Decree No. 2011-1650 of 25 November 2011 on the procedures for declaring and paying back the non-point pollution charge and for keeping the registers referred to in Articles L. 254-3-1 and L. 254-6 of the Rural and Maritime Fisheries Code.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Security of Electronic Products Directive
definition: Directive on the safety of electronic products covering consumer health as well as environmental aspects (e.g. German law on product safety ProdSG).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Small Parts Regulation
definition: A small part is any object that fits completely into a specified size by regulation that approximates the size of the fully expanded throat of a child of age specified by regulation. A small part can be a whole toy or article, a Separate part of a toy, game, or other article or a piece of a toy or article that breaks off during testing that simulates use or abuse by children. Example in US See 16 C.F.R. 1501.4.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Textile labelling regulation
definition: Regulation (EU Reg 1007/2011). This Regulation lays down rules concerning the use of textile fibre names and related labelling and marking of fibre composition of textile products, rules concerning the labelling or marking of textile products containing non-textile parts of animal origin and rules concerning the determination of the fibre composition of textile products by quantitative analysis of binary and ternary textile fibre mixtures, in order to provide accurate information to consumers.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tobacco Directive
definition: The directive or regulation aims to improve the functioning of tobacco products within a market while ensuring a high level of public health protection. Example: European Directive 2014/40/EU on the manufacture, presentation and sale of cigarettes, roll-your-own tobacco, pipe tobacco, cigars, cigarillos, smokeless tobacco products, electronic cigarettes and plant-smoked products.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Toy safety directive
definition: Directive, which applies to products designed or intended, whether or not exclusively, for use in play by children under 14 years of age. Health and safety aspects of the child are in focus Amongst others security aspects of toys are defined (e.g. Warning: small components may be swallowed) as well as substances, which are not allowed to use in toys (e.g. softening agents).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Traceability Regulation
definition: Indicates that a trade item  is subject to government rules and regulations regarding traceability.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Trade item considered unpacked
definition: The trade item is considered as unpacked by regulation, even if physical packaging may exist. (E.g. European Regulation on fresh fruit & vegetables  EU 1169, EU 543, EU 852)
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Trade Item Tested Directive
definition: The product has conformed to testing requirements to meet regulation needs. An example is the Consumer Product Safety Commission https://www.cpsc.gov/Regulations-Laws--Standards/Statutes/The-Consumer-Product-Safety-Improvement-Act/.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Biocide regulation treated article
definition: Regulation (e.g., EU Reg 528/2012) harmonising the rules on making available on the market and trade items treated with biocidal products ('treated articles'), whilst ensuring a high level of protection of both human and animal health and the environment. It should not be used for biocidal products.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Treated with Herbicide Regulation
definition: Trade item has been treated with herbicide(s) that are subject to regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Treated with Pesticide Regulation.
definition: Trade item has been treated with pesticide(s) that are subject to regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: UK Conformity Assessed
definition: The UKCA (UK Conformity Assessed) marking is the UK product marking required for goods being placed on the market in Great Britain (England, Wales and Scotland) fully replacing the European CE marking from 1 January 2023. The UK CA marking supports fair competition by holding all companies accountable to the same rules. Reference: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/uk-conformity-assessment and https://www.gov.uk/guidance/using-the-ukca-marking.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Underwater Lighting
definition: The European standard EN 60598-2-18 is recognized by most countries as the safety standard for underwater lighting.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Unspecified
definition: Unspecified.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Uva
definition: EU 647 Cosmetic industry worked closely with the European Commission, and COLIPA, currently called COSMETICS EUROPE proposed a UVA labelling symbol. This indicates that the level of UVA protection provided by a product is at least 1/3 ratio of its SPF.  Manufacturers will show that their products meet the SPF/UVAPF ratio by displaying the letters “UVA” inside a circle whose diameter should not exceed the height of the SPF number.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vehicle License Plate Registration
definition: Provides proof of the registered motorized vehicle plate number.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vehicle Lighting Compliant
definition: Vehicle lighting meets regulatory compliance in road and off road safety. Example in the US is SAE-DOT
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Volatile Organic Compound Compliant
definition: Organic chemicals that have a high vapor pressure at ordinary, room-temperature conditions. Their high vapor pressure results from a low boiling point, which causes large numbers of molecules to evaporate or sublimate from the liquid or solid form of the compound and enter the surrounding air
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Above Regulated Levels
definition: Above Regulated Levels
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Below Regulated Levels
definition: Below Regulated Levels
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Exempt
definition: Exempt
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Earphone
definition: A source of sound output that controls the unit by means of an in-line remote control.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Not Applicable
definition: A statement that an affirmative or negative response is not required for the attribute.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Other
definition: Other than the standard values for the list.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Standard Single Device
definition: A remote control that operates a single device, usually the one it came with.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Universal Remote
definition: A remote control that can be programmed to operate various brands of one or more types of consumer electronics devices.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Animal Rennet
definition: Rennet derived from animals.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Microbial Rennet
definition: Rennet derived from mold able to produce proteolytic enzymes.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: No Rennet
definition: No rennet
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vegetable Rennet
definition: Rennet derived from vegetable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Other
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Reprocessing product
definition: An indication that education for reprocessing of the product is required. For example: In healthcare, adequate reprocessing of reusable medical devices is critically important in protecting patient safety. Reprocessing is intended to remove blood, tissue, and other biological debris to inactivate infectious microbes so that devices are safe for the next patient.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Safe use

name: Call for Authorization
definition: A call to a trading partner is required to obtain authorization to disposition defective, damaged, or otherwise non-saleable goods.

name: Compulsory Cover Return
definition: The trading partner cannot return the entire unsold book or periodical but must return only the cover or allowable part of the periodical.

name: Destroy for Credit
definition: Trading partner documents and subsequently destroys defective, damaged, or otherwise non-saleable goods and is issued a credit for the material by the other trading partner.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Destroy No Credit
definition: Indicates that in case a product is damaged, defective, or not-sellable it can be returned to the supplier. The supplier will then destroy the item and doesn’t give the consumer any money back (i.e.: an old copier).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Full
definition: The manufacturer has indicated the return policy can be for a full shipment of the merchandise received by the retailer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hold for Inspection
definition: Defective, damaged, or otherwise non-saleable goods are held for inspection and verification by a trading partner prior to the issuance of credit for the material.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: No Policy
definition: There is no effective policy regarding the disposal of defective, damage  and non-saleable goods
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Partial
definition: The manufacturer has indicated the return policy can only be for a partial shipment of the merchandise received by the retailer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Possible Cover Return
definition: Instead of returning the entire unsold book or periodical, the trading partner can return the cover or allowable part of the periodical.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Return for Credit
definition: Defective, damaged, or otherwise non-saleable goods are physically returned by a trading partner prior to the issuance of credit for the material.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Return Prohibited
definition: The return of non-saleable or unsold goods is prohibited by the supplier
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Return Prohibited Except Agreement
definition: The return of non-saleable or unsold goods is prohibited by the supplier unless specific trade agreement between partners
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Return Under Terms
definition: The return of non-saleable or unsold goods is possible but framed by the supplier terms & conditions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Extra light salted
definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively very low.  The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, this is a maximum of 25% of the dry weight of the fish, known as "Slack salted fish").
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the salt and moisture content of the product by using the appropriate expression. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Light salted
definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively light/low. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, this is more than 25% but not more than 33% of the dry weight of the fish, known as "Light salted fish").
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the salt and moisture content of the product by using the appropriate expression. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Dried heavy salted
definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively heavy and moisture content is significantly reduced. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, this is less than 33% of the dry weight of the fish and the fish has a maximum moisture content of 54%, known as "Dried heavy salted fish").
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the salt and moisture content of the product by using the appropriate expression. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

name: Extra heavy salted
definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively heavy, but the moisture content is not significantly reduced (e.g. in Canada, this is greater than 33% of the dry weight of the fish and the fish has a moisture content of between 54% and 65%, known as "Green heavy salted fish").
codeListDefinition: The code indicating the salt and moisture content of the product by using the appropriate expression. The determination of this is made by the supplier and may be subject to target market regulations or trade organization guidelines.

definition: Measurement of length of the belt from where the belt band begins to the first band hole.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Belt Width

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bench Plain Blade Length
definition: The length of the bench plane blade e.g. hand plane. A hand plane is a tool for shaping wood. When powered by electricity, the tool may be called a planer. Planes are used to flatten, reduce the thickness of, and impart a smooth surface to a rough piece of lumber or timber. Planing is used to produce horizontal, vertical, or inclined flat surfaces on workpieces usually too large for shaping. Special types of planes are designed to cut joints or decorative mouldings.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Bicycle Frame
definition: Identify the top of the seat tube, where the seat clamp holds the seat post. Identify the centre of the bottom bracket (it's the axle that holds the crank arms together). Measure the distance between the two points- this is the length of the seat tube.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

In the spring, perennial plant shoots are the new growth that grows from the ground in herbaceous plants or the new stem and/or flower growth that grows on woody plants.
