name: Shackle Clearance
definition: Usable clearance the area between the shackles that allows to pass them through a hasp or hole, around a bar or, indeed, onto a cable. A shackle is a metal link, typically U-shaped, closed by a bolt, used to secure a chain or rope to something.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shackle Diameter
definition: Shackle sizes are measured by the diameter of the bow, not the pin.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shackle Length
definition: Is measured from the top of the lock body to the inside of the shackle.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shank Size
definition: The shank is the end of a drill bit grasped by the chuck of a drill.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sheet Depth
definition: Measurement of height of a sheet from the elastic band to the top of the mattress.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sheets Per Item
definition: The number of sheets when attached within an item examples Pads of paper, Sticky Notes, etc.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shelf Depth
definition: The depth from the front to the back of the shelf.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Shower Head Diameter
definition: The diameter of the shower head.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Side Burner Area
definition: The area that can be used for cooking stove top, grill, on the side burner, off the main cook top, etc.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Side View Depth
definition: Indicates the side view depth. See: http://www.hifi-regler.de/images_c/media/gallery/z_tiefe_sharp-lc-40-le-705-e_100003140.p800x600.jpg.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Single Stair Width
definition: Indicates the width of a single stair.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sleeve
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Splitting Length
definition: The splitting length, e.g. wood splitter
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Spout Height
definition: Spout height is measured from the sink/countertop surface vertically up to the highest point..
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Spout Reach
definition: Spout reach is measured from the centre of the spout base horizontally out to the water stream.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Staircase Width
definition: The width of stairs for example loft stairs or spiral staircase.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Standing Height
definition: The maximum height at which the user can stand, e.g. on a steel work platform.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stick Diameter Maximum
definition: Indicates the maximum diameter of a stick, e.g. broom stick or telescopic stick.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stick Diameter Minimum
definition: Indicates the minimum diameter of a stick, e.g. broom stick or telescopic stick.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stick Length Maximum
definition: Indicates the maximum length of a stick, e.g. broom stick or telescopic stick.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stick Length Minimum
definition: Indicates the minimum length of a stick, e.g. broom stick or telescopic stick.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Storage Length
definition: The length of the product in its storage state.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Storey Height
definition: Indicates the height of storey. A storey (or story in American English) is any level part of a building that could be used by people (for living, work, storage, recreation, etc.). The terms "floor", "level", or "deck" can also be used in this sense.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stove Pipe Diameter
definition: Indicates the diameter of a stove pipe of e.g. a pellet stove, wood stove or a wood furnace.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Stroke Length
definition: Is back-and-forth motion. Each cycle of reciprocation consists of two opposite motions: there is a motion in one direction, and then a motion back in the opposite direction. Each of these is called a stroke. The term is also used to mean the length of the stroke.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Supply Line Length to Illuminant
definition: The supply line length until the first illuminant for example for length of cord until the first light on Christmas lights.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Table Size Maximum
definition: Indicates the maximum size of the table top for example the table top of a table saw.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Take-off Maximum
definition: Indicates the maximum take-off, e.g. jointer or planer.  Take-off is defined as the amount of material removed in a single pass.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tank Size
definition: The measurement  large receptacle or storage chamber, especially for liquid or gas. This is usually a volume.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Thickness
definition: Indicates the measurement from top to bottom or front to back. Example: Mattress, pillows, cushions, etc.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Thread Cutting Width
definition: Indicates the width of a cutting thread/line for example the cutting line of string trimmer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tire Width
definition: Indicates the tire width.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Torso Length
definition: Measurement of torsos length from the neck line to the bottom hem
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Total Height Workbench
definition: Indicates the total height of the work surface of a workbench.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Total Stone karat
definition: The number of karats of the stones in the item as related to the descriptiveSizeDimension.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Total Strength Product
definition: Indicates the total strength of a product.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Total Width Workbench
definition: Indicates the total width of the work surface of a workbench.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Towing Capacity
definition: the capacity measurement of that the trade item was designed to be able to pull or tow.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tread Depth
definition: The measurement between the top of the tread rubber to the bottom of the tire's deepest grooves. Because it is difficult to accurately measure tread depth with a ruler, tread depth is best measured with a tire tread depth gauge.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tread Width
definition: The measurement between the outboard and inboard edges of a new tire's tread design. Ideally it approximates the width of the tread that comes into contact with the road.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tree Height  Stand Max
definition: Indicates the maximum tree height that is suitable for a stand such as a Christmas tree stand.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Turntable Diameter
definition: The diameter of the product’s turntable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tyre Rim Size
definition: The rim of a tyre carries different measures both width and depth to make a rim size. The calculation fits into a rim size that would be stated here, Examples 30c, 2.2, 3.0, 2.5
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tyre Size
definition: The size of the tyre there are various ways US, EU, ISO, Auto, Bicycle etc. For Example A bicycle tyre sequence: "28-622, 700 x 28C, 28 x 1 5/8 x 1 1/8" you at least have a useful deciphering reference. The rim diameter is 622mm and tyre outer diameter is around 700mm (the actual outer diameter will depend on the tyre's height). The tyre width is 28mm.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Usable Depth
definition: Indicates the measurement of the usable depth of the product's inner rims when it is  placed in contact with the floor, table or other surface. Example: The inner depth of a food storage container.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Usable Diameter
definition: Indicates the measurement of the usable diameter of the product's inner rims when it is  placed in contact with the floor, table or other surface. Example: An inner section of a bowl or inner diameter of a flower pot.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Usable Height
definition: Indicates the measurement of the usable height of the product's inner rim to the inner base when it is  placed in contact with the floor, table or other surface. Example: The inner height of a food storage container.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Usable Length
definition: Total length of the product minus the length of additional elements for its usage. Example: The length of a nail file rocky surface. Note: There are specific sizeTypeCodes for specific type of product lengths.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Usable Width
definition: Indicates the measurement of the usable width of the product's inner rims when it is  placed in contact with the floor, table or other surface. Example: The inner width of a food storage container.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vehicle Dry Weight
definition: Is the weight of a vehicle without any consumables, passengers, or cargo.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Volume Capacity
definition: The capacity measurement that the trade item was designed to hold. Example Toilets, Plumping, storage bins all have an amount of volume capacity. 4 Cubic Metres
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Waist
definition: NOT AVAILABLE
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Waist Width
definition: Measurement of width at the narrowest part of the item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Watch Case Depth
definition: Measurement of the watch case as measured from the top of the bezel to the watch back.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Watch Case Height
definition: Measurement of the watch case as measured from the top most point (above the 12) to the lowest most point (below the 6).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Watch Case Width
definition: Measurement of the watch case as measured from the left most point (left of the9) to the right most point (right of the 3).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Watch Strap Length
definition: Measurement of the watch band/strap from tip to tip as laid flat.  If the band/strap is one piece, this is also known as the watch strap/band circumference.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Watch Strap Width
definition: Measurement of the watch band/strap width from side to side as laid flat.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Wheel Depth
definition: Measurement of depth of the wheel across the tread from left to right.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Wheel Diameter
definition: Measurement of the wheel across its face.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Wheelbase
definition: Measurement of the distance between axles as measured from wheel to wheel.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Width maximum
definition: Indicates the maximum width.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Window Drop Distance
definition: A method for controlling movement of a window glass in a vehicle using an electric motor associated with a drive mechanism through a cable.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Tool Table Length
definition: The length of a workbench.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Working Platform Length
definition: The length of the working platform.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Worktop Depth
definition: The depth of the worktop, countertop, tool table or head of  the product or integrated in the product (without accessories or attachments, e.g. rake ).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: A trade item delivered from a manufacturer to the retail selling floor that is not considered inventory and has no retail value.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: The trade item is a unit which is designed to demonstrate the product to the end user or consumer.  For example a perfume tester, a lotion dispenser, or an air freshener sprayer/atomizer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Dynamic assortment
definition: A trade item that comprises two or more different trade items, with a fixed total count, where the count of each trade item contained may change. Refer to the GS1 General Specification Section 2.1.1.7 for more information.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Eco Chèques
definition: Eco-chèques are an extra-legal benefit that employers can give to their employees and are intended to support the green economy by promoting the purchase of environmentally friendly, eco-designed and/or sustainable products.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Employee Meal Vouchers
definition: Employee meal-vouchers are an extra-legal benefit that employers can give to their employees that are intended for meals or food purchases in restaurants, grocery and convenience stores.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: FSA Eligible
definition: The trade item is eligible to be sold to someone with a Flexible Spending Account (FSA).  FSAs are special accounts you put money into to pay for certain out-of-pocket health care costs.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Gift_With Purchase
definition: A trade item given to a consumer as part of a promotional event, contin-gent on the consumer making a purchase of another item or items. A Gift with Purchase is considered inventory and has no retail value.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: HSA Eligible
definition: The trade item is eligible to be sold to someone with a Health Savings Account (HSA).  HSAs are special accounts a consumer puts money into to pay for certain out-of-pocket health care costs.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Limited Production Run by the Manufacturer/Supplier. This does not mean that retailers will order only once (not a one time buy product), retailers can order until the supplier runs out of stock. Those products are typically called one shot , limited edition.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Nonfunctioning_Display Unit
definition: Indicates that a trade item is a non-functioning Trade Item, used for display purposes only. Typically it is the shell of the trade item that it represents. Relevant to when the non-functioning Trade Item has to actually be ordered from the supplier.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Trade items purchased by a retailer for internal use only, not for sale to consumers.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Purchase_With Purchase
definition: A trade item sold to a consumer at a special price as part of a promotional event, contingent on the consumer purchasing another item or items. A Purchase with Purchase is considered inventory and has a retail value.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: SNAP Eligible
definition: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) - SNAP offers nutrition assistance to millions of eligible, low-income individuals and families and provides economic benefits to communities. SNAP is the largest program in the US hunger safety net. The Food and Nutrition Service works with State agencies, nutrition educators, and neighbourhood and faith-based organisations to ensure that those eligible for nutrition assistance can make informed decisions about applying for the program and can access benefits. Products are set to be SNAP eligible.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Travel Size
definition: The item is specifically designed in size to be convenient for traveling.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Value Pack
definition: A trade item which is marketed as a value pack to the consumer by special markings on the package for example by printed wording "value pack". A value pack is a package containing multiple items (for example, tubes of toothpaste) that is less expensive than the same number of the items purchased singly or a trade item containing more net content for the same price than the original item. These items are not promotional products nor gadgets but are sold regularly.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: WIC Eligible
definition: WIC - Women, Infants & Children WIC is administered by the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA). WIC gives access to healthy food, nutrition education and breastfeeding guidance. Pregnant, a caregiver, or a mom with a child under 5, can get the right personalized support for their family from products eligible to the WIC program.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Autoclave
definition: Autoclave (Steam) is a method of sterilisation that utilizes pressure and heat to achieve a sterile environment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Beta particles are able to penetrate living matter to a certain extent (radiation intensity from a small source of radioactive material decreases as one over the distance squared) and can change the structure of struck molecules.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Gaseous chlorine dioxide systems for sterilization of healthcare products are not mutagenic or carcinogenic in humans. As the chlorine dioxide concentration increases, the time required to achieve sterilization becomes progressively shorter.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: This method should be used only for materials that might be damaged by moist heat or that are impenetrable to moist heat (e.g., powders, petroleum products, sharp instruments). There are two types of dry-heat sterilizers: the static-air type and the forced-air type.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Electron_Beam Irradiation
definition: A commercially successful technology for sterilizing a variety of disposable medical devices with a wide range of densities. The e-beam inactivates micro-organisms either by causing microbial death as a direct effect of the destruction of a vital molecule or by an indirect chemical reaction. This is the same mechanism as in gamma irradiation, and the dose required is the same.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ethanol
definition: A chemical sterilisation method that utilizes ethanol as the sterilisation method.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Eto_Ethylene Oxide
definition: A gas that is commonly used to sterilize objects sensitive to temperatures greater than 60 °C such as plastics, optics and electrics. Ethylene oxide treatment is generally carried out between 30 °C and 60 °C with relative humidity above 30% and a gas concentration between 200 and 800 mg/L for at least three hours. Ethylene oxide penetrates well, moving through paper, cloth, and some plastic films and is highly effective.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Formaldehyde
definition: A chemical sterilisation agent used to provide sterilisation. Items being sterilized are usually immersed in the formaldehyde for a pre determined time period.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Gamma rays are very penetrating and are commonly used for sterilisation of disposable medical equipment, such as syringes, needles, cannulas and IV sets. Gamma radiation requires bulky shielding for the safety of the operators; they also require storage of a radioisotope (usually Cobalt- 60), which continuously emits gamma rays (it cannot be turned off, and therefore always presents a hazard in the area of the facility).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Glutaraldehyde
definition: A colourless liquid with a pungent odour used to sterilize medical and dental equipment. It is also used for industrial water treatment and as a chemical preservative. Glutaraldehyde is an oily liquid at room temperature (density 1.06 g/mL), and miscible with water, alcohol, and benzene.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Pulsed light is a non-thermal sterilization method that uses brief intense pulses or flashes of white light to kill micro-organisms.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High_Level Disinfectant
definition: A germicide that inactivates all microbial pathogens, except small numbers of bacterial endospores.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Another chemical sterilizing agent. It is relatively non-toxic once diluted to low concentrations (although a dangerous oxidizer at high concentrations), and leaves no residue.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: A sterilization process that uses liquid chemical as its sterilant to kill microorganisms.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Microwaves are used in medicine for disinfection of soft contact lenses, dental instruments, dentures, milk, and urinary catheters for intermittent self-catheterization. However, microwaves must only be used with products that are compatible (e.g., do not melt). Microwaves are radio-frequency waves, which are usually used at a frequency of 2450 MHz.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: A sterilization process that uses nitrogen dioxide radicals that are formed from dinitrogen tetroxide dimers to kill microorganisms.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ozone
definition: Is a method often times used in industrial settings to sterilize water and air, as well as a disinfectant for surfaces. It has the benefit of being able to oxidize most organic matter. It is a toxic and unstable gas that must be produced on-site, so it is not practical to use in many settings.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: A chemical in the organic peroxide family. It is a bright, colorless liquid with a characteristic acrid acetic acid type odor. It has a strong oxidizing potential, is highly corrosive, and can explode at temperatures exceeding 110 °C.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Plasma
definition: A method of sterilisation that utilizes hydrogen peroxide vapour to sterilize heat sensitive equipment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Sound waves of frequency >20,000 cycle/second kills bacteria and some viruses on exposing for one hour. High frequency sound waves disrupt cells. They are used to clean and disinfect instruments as well as to reduce microbial load.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Supercritical_Carbon Dioxide
definition: A sterilization process that uses supercritical carbon dioxide in combination with a small percentage of additive to kill microorganisms.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Unspecified
definition: Trade Item Manufacturer has not specified the sterilisation method(s) of the trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

definition: Useful for sterilisation of surfaces and some transparent objects. Many objects that are transparent to visible light absorb UV. UV irradiation is routinely used to sterilize the interiors of biological safety cabinets between uses.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

Brie and Camembert, the most famous of these cheeses.

name: Oxo-degradable

Oxo-degradable plastics quickly fragment into smaller and smaller pieces, called microplastics, but don’t break down at the molecular or polymer level. The resulting microplastics are left in the environment indefinitely until they eventually fully break down.

name: Amphibian
definition: Includes animals that may be described/observed as cold-blooded vertebrate typically living on land but breeding in water. Includes animals such as frogs, toads and salamanders.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Anoles
definition: Any of a genus (Anolis) of arboreal American lizards that have a brightly colored dewlap and some with the ability to change colour.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Arachnid
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as invertebrates having jointed limbs and a segmented body with an exoskeleton made of chitin. These animals are mainly predatory. Includes animals such as spiders and scorpions.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Bearded Dragons
definition: Any of various Australian agamid lizards (genus Pogona synonym Amphibolurus) having spiny scales and an expandable pouch below the throat.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Bird
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as vertebrate animals characterized primarily by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings. Includes animals such as chicken, geese and emus.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Bovine
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as dull and slow-moving, stolid mammals. These animals are usually raised as livestock for meat, dairy and leather purposes.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Cat
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as an animal  of the feline species which are small to medium sized cats compared to the big cats or genus Panthera, which refers to Tigers, Lions, Jaguars and Leopards. Cats are carnivorous animals. These animals have evolved into hundreds of different breeds and are a very common domesticated pet around the world. Includes felines such as the Domestic cat and Manx cat.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Cetacean
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as any of various aquatic, chiefly marine mammals of the order Cetacea, characterized by a nearly hairless body, anterior limbs modified into broad flippers, vestigial posterior limbs, and a flat notched tail.  Includes whales, dolphins and porpoises.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Chameleons
definition: A small slow-moving Old World lizard with a prehensile tail, long extensible tongue, protruding eyes that rotate independently, and a highly developed ability to change color.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Chinchilla
definition: Either of two small South American rodents (Chinchilla laniger and C. brevicaudata of the family Chinchillidae) of the high Andes that are the size of large squirrels and have very soft pearly-gray fur.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Crustacean
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as invertebrates that have a segmented body, a hard external skeleton (exoskeleton), two sets of antennae and one pair of legs per body segment. These animas live in marine coastal environment. Includes animals such as shrimp, lobster and crabs.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Dog
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as any of various fissiped mammals with nonretractile claws and typically long muzzles. These animals have evolved into hundreds of different breeds and are a very common domesticated pet around the world. Includes animals such as the Alsatian as well as the Pitbull Terrier.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Equine
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as hoofed mammals having slender legs and a flat coat with a narrow mane along the back of the neck. Includes such animals as zebras, stallions and mules.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Fish
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as gill breathing aquatic vertebrate, generally with fins, which are apt for locomotion and sustentation in the water. Includes animals such as the blue shark as well as all colourful tropical fish.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Geckos
definition: Any of numerous small chiefly tropical and nocturnal lizard that has adhesive pads on the feet to assist in climbing on smooth surfaces.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Gerbil
definition: Any of numerous Old World burrowing desert rodents (Gerbillus and related genera) with long hind legs adapted for leaping.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Goat
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as being or pertaining to or resembling a goat or goats. These can include any of numerous agile ruminants related to sheep but having a beard and straight horns. Includes mountain goats.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Guinea Pig
definition: A small stout-bodied short-eared tailless domesticated rodent (Cavia porcellus) of South American origin often kept as a pet and widely used in biological research.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Hamster
definition: Any of a subfamily (Cricetinae) of small Old World rodents having very large cheek pouches.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Human
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as large-brained, with three-dimensional colour vision and grasping hands. Humans are distinguished from other primates by their bipedal locomotion, and especially by their relatively larger brain with its particularly well developed neocortex, prefrontal cortex and temporal lobes, which enable high levels of abstract reasoning, language, problem solving, and culture through social learning.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Iguanas
definition: Any of various large chiefly herbivorous usually green or brownish tropical American lizards (family Iguanidae, the iguana family) that have a serrated dorsal crest and large dewlap.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Insect
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as small air-breathing arthropods with three pairs of legs and jaws. These animals have an exoskeleton and thrive in all environments. Includes animals such as ants, beetles and the butterfly.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Mouse
definition: Any of numerous small rodents (as of the genus Mus) with pointed snout, rather small ears, elongated body, and slender tail.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Pig
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as any of omnivorous, even-toed animals the family Suidae, which typically have a stout body, thick skin, a short neck, and a movable snout. Includes such animals as pigs, hogs and boars.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Primate
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as large-brained, mostly tree-dwelling mammals with three-dimensional colour vision and grasping hands. Includes animals such as monkeys and lemurs. Excludes humans.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Rabbit
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as any of various herbivorous mammals having fully furred feet and two pairs of upper incisors and belonging to the order Lagomorpha. Includes rabbits, hares, and pikas.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Rat
definition: Any of numerous rodents (Rattus and related genera) differing from the related mice especially by considerably larger size.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Reptile
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as any of various cold-blooded, usually egg-laying vertebrates of the class Reptilia, having an external covering of scales or horny plates and breathing by means of lungs.  Includes snakes, lizards, crocodiles and turtles.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Rodent
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as warm-blooded animals that have two incisors in the upper and lower jaw that grow continuously and must be kept worn down by gnawing. Includes animals such as rats, mice, squirrels and beavers.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Sheep
definition: Includes any animals that may be described/observed as any of usually horned ruminant animals of the genus Ovis in the family Bovidae. Includes both wild and domesticated species.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Snail
definition: A common name that is applied most often to land snails, terrestrial pulmonate gastropod molluscs. However, the common name "snail" is also applied to most of the members of the molluscan class Gastropoda that have a coiled shell that is large enough for the animal to retract completely into. When the word "snail" is used in this most general sense, it includes not just land snails but also thousands of species of sea snails and freshwater snails.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Turtles
definition: Any reptile of the order Testudines, comprising aquatic and terrestrial species having the trunk enclosed in a shell consisting of a dorsal carapace and a ventral plastron.
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Unclassified
definition: This term is used to describe those animal attributes that are unable to be classified within their specific market
codeListDefinition: The type of animal this food is intended to be consumed by for example RABBIT.

name: Applicable
definition: Tax applies to the item or service within the target market at the tax rate or tax amount.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Domestic Reverse Charge
definition: Code specifying that the rate is based upon the domestic reverse charge VAT treatment. This code value is particularly pertinent to the UK context.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Exempt
definition: The item or service has no taxation requirements nor any requirements related to invoicing or reporting.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Free Export Item
definition: Code specifying that the item is free export and taxes are not charged.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: High
definition: The Trade Item is taxed at a tax rate that is higher than any other rate of taxation for trade items. The classification of High is subject to Target Market rules and can change based on regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Low
definition: The item or service is taxed at a tax rate that is lower than any other rate of taxation for trade items (except zero). The classification of low is subject to Target Market rules and can change based on regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Medium
definition: The item or service is taxed at a tax rate that is considered to be intermediate between the lower and higher rates of taxation for trade items. The classification of medium is subject to Target Market rules and can change based on regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mixed
definition: Code specifying that the rate is based on mixed tax. Transaction includes item taxed at different rates.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Not applicable
definition: Tax does not apply to the item or service within the target market.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Prepaid
definition: The tax, fee or duty has been paid by the supplier of the trade item.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Reduction In Base
definition: A benefit provided under the law that allows one to apply a reduction in the tax basis for calculating. In general, exceptions to the basis for tax calculation are the value of an operation. However, to reduce the tax, the benefit is granted to a reduction in the value of this base. This code value is particularly pertinent to the Brazilian (BR) tax structure.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Reduction In Tax Rate
definition: A reduction in the tax rate. Generally, reduced tax rates are arranged in a more objective way according to the law. This code value is particularly pertinent to the BR tax structure.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Services Outside Scope of Tax
definition: Code specifying that taxes are not applicable to the services.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Standard
definition: Tax rate used or accepted as normal or average. The classification of standard is subject to Target Market rules and can change based on regulation.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Value Added
definition: A fixed amount of tax for each product, based on criteria established by legislation rather than the conventional method which is the application of a percentage over the value of the product or operation. This code value is particularly pertinent to the Brazilian (BR) tax structure.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Value Added Margin
definition: A percentage defined by the Tax Authorities that is applied on (the value of the goods+ Federal VAT+ freight+ other expenses) aiming at obtaining a basis for calculating the substitution for the State VAT. The goal of the Value Added Margin is to calculate the State VAT according to the basis that would be applied in the last step of the production chain; in this case, it could be the final resale. Example: Final Price to Retailer = Suggested Price + Expenses + % MVA. This code value is particularly pertinent to the Brazilian (BR) tax structure.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Value Added Tax Not Now Due For Payment
definition: A code to indicate that the Value Added Tax (VAT) amount which is due on the current invoice is to be paid on receipt of a separate VAT payment request. The value added tax is not due for payment now.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: VAT Reverse Charge
definition: Code specifying that the rate is based upon the domestic reverse charge VAT treatment.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Zero
definition: The item or service has a tax rate or amount equal to zero but still has requirements for invoicing and may have a rate that can be modified by the government at any given time.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: 14+ – Over 14 Years
definition:
Programming with this classification contains themes or content elements which might not be suitable for viewers under the age of 14. Parents are strongly cautioned to exercise discretion in permitting viewing by pre-teens and early teens without parent/guardian supervision, as programming with this classification could deal with mature themes and societal issues in a realistic fashion.

Violence Guidelines

while violence could be one of the dominant elements of the storyline, it must be integral to the development of plot or character
might contain intense scenes of violence
Other Content Guidelines

Language: could possibly include strong or frequent use of profanity
Sex/Nudity: might include scenes of nudity and/or sexual activity within the context of narrative or theme
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: 18 Plus Adults
definition:
Intended for viewers 18 years and older.
This classification applies to programming which could contain any or all of the following content elements which would make the program unsuitable for viewers under the age of 18.

Violence Guidelines

might contain depictions of violence, which while integral to the development of plot, character or themes, are intended for adult viewing, and thus are not suitable for audiences under 18 years of age.
Other Content Guidelines

Language: might contain graphic language
Sex/Nudity: might contain explicit portrayals of sex and/or nudity
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: C – Children
definition:
Programming intended for children with this designation must adhere to the provisions of the Children’s section of the Canadian Association of Broadcasters’ (CAB) Violence Code.

As this programming is intended for younger children under the age of 8 years, it will pay careful attention to themes which could threaten their sense of security and well-being. As programming for children requires particular caution in the depiction of violence, there will be no realistic scenes of violence. Depictions of aggressive behaviour will be infrequent and limited to portrayals that are clearly imaginary and unrealistic in nature.

Violence Guidelines

might contain occasional comedic, unrealistic depictions
Other Content Guidelines

Language: no offensive language
Sex/Nudity: none
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: C8 – Children Over 8 Years
definition:
This classification is applied to children’s programming that is generally considered acceptable for youngsters 8 years and over to view on their own. It is suggested that a parent/guardian co-view programming assigned this classification with younger children under the age of 8.

Programming with this designation adheres to the provisions of the Children’s section of the Canadian Association of Broadcasters’ (CAB) Violence Code. These include not portraying violence as the preferred, acceptable, or only way to resolve conflict; or encouraging children to imitate dangerous acts which they may see on the screen.

Programming within this classification might deal with themes which could be unsuitable for younger children. References to any such controversial themes shall be discreet and sensitive to the 8-12 year age range of this viewing group.

Violence Guidelines

any realistic depictions will be infrequent, discreet, of low intensity, and shall portray the consequences of violence
violence portrayed must be within the context of the storyline or character development
might include mild physical violence, comedic violence, comic horror, special effects; fantasy, supernatural, or animated violence
Other Content Guidelines

Language: no profanity; might have infrequent use of language which may be considered by some to be socially offensive or discriminatory, and then only if employed within the context of storyline or character development.
Sex/Nudity: none
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: E – Exempt
definition:
Exempt programming includes: news, sports, documentaries and other information programming; talk shows, music videos, and variety programming.

Exempt programming does not require an on-screen classification icon and broadcasters are not required to encode a rating into the broadcast signal.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: G  General
definition:
Considered acceptable for all age groups. Appropriate viewing for the entire family.

This programming is intended for a broad, general audience. While not designed specifically for children, it is understood that younger viewers may be part of the audience. Therefore programming within this classification shall contain very little violence, either physical, verbal or emotional.

It will be sensitive to themes which could threaten a younger child’s sense of security, and will depict no realistic scenes of violence which minimize or gloss over the effects of violent acts.

Violence Guidelines

minimal, infrequent
may contain comedic, unrealistic depictions
contains no frightening special effects not required by storyline
Other Content Guidelines

Language: may contain offensive slang; no profanity
Sex/Nudity: none
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: PG – Parental Guidance
definition:
This programming, while intended for a general audience, may not be suitable for younger children (under the age of 8). Parents/guardians should be aware that there might be content elements which some could consider inappropriate for unsupervised viewing by children in the 8-13 age range.

Programming within this classification might address controversial themes or issues. Cognizant that pre-teens and early teens could be part of this viewing group, particular care must be taken not to encourage imitational behaviour, and consequences of violent actions shall not be minimized.

Violence Guidelines

any depiction of conflict and/or aggression will be limited and moderate; it might include physical, fantasy, or supernatural violence
any such depictions should not be pervasive, and must be justified within the context of theme, storyline or character development
Other Content Guidelines

Language:     might contain infrequent and mild profanity; might contain mildly suggestive language
Sex/Nudity:   could possibly contain brief scenes of nudity; might have limited and discreet sexual references or content when appropriate to the storyline or theme
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Agriculture
definition: Specifies a trade channel for sale of products to agricultural holdings and farms, horticulture, home and garden.

name: Cash And Carry
definition: Cash and carry is a form of trade in which goods are sold from a wholesale warehouse operated either on a self-service basis, or on the basis of samples or a combination of the two. This is sometimes referred to as club in some markets.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Child nutrition food programs
definition: Trade channel where food products are approved for sale as part of a child nutrition program (for schools, nurseries, daycare, etc.) such as the USDA Food and Nutrition Service (USDA FNS).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Consignment
definition: Consignment is a form of trade where a product is offered for sale by the retailer, but owned by the supplier, whereby the retailer doesn’t buy the product from the supplier until it is sold to the consumer.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Convenience
definition: Small format retail store often outside or annexed to a gas/fuel station.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Drug
definition: Organisations or departments engaged in retailing prescription or nonprescription drugs and medicines. This is otherwise known as Retail Pharmacy.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Drugstore
definition: Establishment that offers personal care goods, toiletries and non-controlled drugs which can be obtained without a prescription. Within the Netherlands this establishment is a different than a retail pharmacy (referred to in the code list as DRUG).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Duty Free
definition: Duty-free shops (or stores) are retail outlets that are exempt from the payment of certain local or national taxes and duties, on the requirement that the goods sold will be sold to travellers who will take them out of the country.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Food Service
definition: Trade channel that sells prepared food, for example restaurants, hotels, clubs.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Grocery
definition: Organisations or departments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of food products.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hard Lines
definition: Organisations or departments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of hardware items, such as tools and builders' hardware.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Healthcare
definition: Trade channel where products such as medicines, medical devices and healthcare consumables are used for the direct delivery of healthcare services. It specifically excludes products such as stationery, detergents, carrier bags etc. that may be sold to hospitals.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Home Goods
definition: Organisations or departments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of domestic goods, such as furniture and furnishings, home décor, home accessories.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hospital
definition: The distribution and use of this trade item is "intramural" (within the walls of a clinic or hospital). These products may not be always supplied through a hospital pharmacy and may be used directly at the clinic.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hospital Pharmacy
definition: Drug or medical device can be dispensed from a hospital pharmacy. Can be related to government funded/subsidized reimbursement list/agency. Can also apply to orphan drugs, special drugs.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Industrial
definition: A marketing intermediary, roughly equivalent to a wholesaler in consumer markets, who purchases industrial products in bulk from manufacturers for resale to other industrial users
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Institutional
definition: Trade channel where the trade item is sold to  institutions, such as, education departments, colleges, schools, research  centres, etc.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Mass Merchandising
definition: Trade channel, which is a huge retail store offering a very wide range of product categories such as accessories, appliances, clothing, furniture, office equipment and stationery, and shoes. Large retail organized into separate departments. All departments are housed under the same roof to facilitate buying, customer service, merchandising, and control.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Military
definition: Sale of items to the military.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Online
definition: A trade channel where the trade item is sold through the internet. The consumer purchases the trade item online and the trade item is shipped either directly to the consumer or to a designated pick-up location.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Specialty Retail
definition: Retailer concentrating on selling one merchandise line of goods for a particular and usually selective clientele. Examples are stores selling electronics, bagels, leather goods, organic foods, imported china, cosmetics, etc. Specialty retailers have a narrow but deep selection in their specialty.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Unspecified
definition: Trade Channel unknown or not relevant.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vending
definition: The retailing merchandise through vending machines.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Vendor Leased Space
definition: A trade channel where the trade item is sold through a retailer within a retailer for example a rack jobber.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cut For Sale
definition: Identifies food (e.g. meat, cold cut, cheese) or non-food product (e.g. chain, textile) that have been already cut, sliced or chopped for sale by the time they reach the retailer. Example: loin or chuck transported as steaks into the shop where these are sold as products.

name: Baked For Date
definition: The baked-for date indicates the date not later than 12 hours after the time the bread product was baked. The baked-for date indicates the date the bread is being baked for. May be included on the label on a package of bread product instead of a best-before date if the bread product has a shelf life of less than 7 days (or otherwise specified according to local target market regulations).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Baked On Date
definition: The baked-on date indicates the date on which the bread product was baked. May be included on the label on a package of bread product instead of a best-before date if the bread product has a shelf life of less than 7 days (or otherwise specified according to local target market regulations).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Best before date
definition: The “Best before” date or a derivation of best before (i.e. "Best if used before") indicates the ideal consumption or best effective use date of a product. It is a statement about quality. The dates come in various formats such as a specific day including month and day or by month, day and year. Best before date can also be a period of time represented by a month and year. It is defined by local requirements about the appropriate date term and the definition. These may vary by regulation and/or market conventions.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Display Until Date
definition: The date in which the trade item is displayed on shelf until date is reached. This is applicable to such items as periodicals, promotional trade items and materials supporting. This is normally not for regulatory, expiration, or quality type dates.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Expiration date
definition: The expiration date is the date that determines the limit of consumption or use of a product. Its meaning is determined based on the trade item context e.g., for food, the date will indicate the possibility of a direct health risk resulting from use of the product after the date, for pharmaceutical products, it will indicate the possibility of an indirect health risk resulting from the ineffectiveness of the product after the date.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Freeze By
definition: Indicates that the product if not consumed by the date listed on the package, it can be frozen to extend the life if done by this date.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Last Sale Date
definition: The trade item is marked with a date that specifies the last date a trade item may be sold to a consumer. The difference between Last Sale date, Best before, and Expiration is that Best Before is used for quality of product may deteriorate, Expiration is the maximum date of quality, last sale is the date the item can no longer be sold. These support different business purposes.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: No Date Marked
definition: No date is marked on the product or packaging.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Packaging Date
definition: The packaging date is the date when the goods were packed as determined by the packager. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Production Date
definition: The production date is the production or assembly date determined by the manufacturer. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pointed

codeListDefinition: A code representation of the form of the actual trade item, not the packaging for example OBLONG.

name: Ribbed

name: Donation Notification Number
definition: Indicates the device is managed by a Donation Identification Number. This number can be found on the device label or packaging. The Donation Identification Number is applicable to devices that are also regulated as HCT/Ps and is a number that is assigned to each donation.

name: Nutrition Packaging
definition: The proprietary nutrition packaging code or number marked on the package which appears next to the nutrition facts
codeListDefinition: A code determining whether the item and/or its packaging is marked with a specific identification.

name: Vendor Packaging

codeListDefinition: A code determining whether the item and/or its packaging is marked with a specific identification.

name: Bristle
definition: A bristle is a stiff hair, feather, or fiber (natural or artificial), either on an animal, such as a pig, a plant, or on a tool such as a brush or broom.

name: Bulk Price
definition: The amount of money for which the trade item is bought or sold when buying or selling a standard configuration.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Inpatient Regulatory Reimbursement Price
definition: Price defined by the authority in charge (e.g. the Ministry of Health)  as reimbursement for a product only sold by hospitals to an inpatient. This price is unique for all hospitals.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Loose Price
definition: The amount of money for which the trade item is bought or sold when buying or selling individual units that are not in a standard configuration.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Minimum Advertised Price
definition: The minimum consumer price (amount) at which the trade item may be advertised.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Outpatient Regulatory Reimbursement Price
definition: Price defined by the authority in charge of reimbursement for a product (e.g. the Ministry of Health) as only sold by hospitals to an outpatient. This price is unique for all hospitals.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Retail Price on Trade Item
definition: The retail price as marked on the trade item package
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Unilateral Minimum Retail Price
definition: Under a Unilateral Policy (or "Colgate Policy" or "Unilateral Minimum Retail Price Policy") a manufacturer, without any agreement with the reseller, announces a minimum resale price and refuses to make further sales to any reseller that sells below the announced price.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Ambient
definition: The product is stored outside of a refrigerator in an ambient temperature that is the temperature of the air surrounding the product. Please refer to local regulations for temperature range.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Chilled
definition: The product is stored inside a refrigerator (not in the freezer) at a temperature created by the refrigerator. Please refer to local regulations for temperature range.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Deep Frozen
definition: The product is stored inside of a "deep" freezer (not in a refrigerator) at a temperature which maintains a deep-frozen state, but is not above -18°C/0°F. Please refer to local regulations for temperature range.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Fresh
definition: The product has not been frozen.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Frozen

codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Thawed
definition: The product was previously frozen but is presented in an unfrozen state.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Base Unit or Each
definition: The lowest level of the item hierarchy intended or labeled for individual resale.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Case
definition: A standard trade item shipping unit that contains a single or multiple GTINs. Includes an ½ or ¼ pallet and an ½ or ¼ box pallet.

name: Display Shipper
definition: A display or shipper is a special case item that includes both consumer units and packaging materials to be assembled and used to display the product for sale. May contain cases or consumer units. It  may be the orderable or dispatchable unit and may be shipped on a pallet.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Display Ready Pallet
definition: Special pallet item sold as a single unit that is not intended to be broken down to sell the cases individually. It is intended to be displayed directly on the selling floor and shoppable for the consumer and may contain additional packaging materials used to further display the product. It may contain single or multiple GTINs and may be the orderable unit.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pack or Inner Pack
definition: A logistical unit between case and each. This may be a consumable innerpack (i.e. Carton of Cigarettes) or it may be simply a logistical pack (i.e. Dozes of toothbrushes).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pallet
definition: A unit load that contains a single or multiple GTINs Includes box pallet
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Transport Load
definition: Trade item above the pallet level used for transporting trade items. For example truck load, container, rail car, ship, etc.

name: Chemical waste
definition: Waste from chemicals or use of chemicals. Such wastes ranges from harmless to toxic chemicals. Chemical waste is released directly or indirectly when chemicals are used. Examples are salts, acids and bases, heavy metals, cyanides, oxidants and reductants, volatile substances, ceramic, and contaminated glassware.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Hazardous medical waste
definition: Hazardous waste that is released in healthcare institutions and requires special processing due to possible contamination or due to processing problems. This often concerns infectious waste, genetically modified waste and human parts, such as blood, tissue, bone, OR gauze, drainage canister and so on.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Recyclable waste
definition: Waste that can be collected and recycled/melted into reusable raw materials, such as recycling plastic covering material into plastic granules or remelting disposable instruments into reusable steel.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Residual waste
definition: Waste that remains after the specific wastes as required by local regulation (e.g. glass, cans, metal, paper and cardboard, vegetable, fruit and garden waste) has been removed.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Sharp medical objects
definition: Waste that creates a risk of skin puncture accidents in healthcare institutions. Sharp objects such as (hypodermic) needles, used scalpel blades, scissors, tweezers, bone drills and so on.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Loose
definition: A trade item which is without packaging at the retail level and whose quantity (the individual pieces, amount, or volume) is selected by the consumer and can be either bagged and bar coded by the consumer or bagged and key-entered or scanned at the point of sale. NOTE: In some industries these types of trade items are commonly referred to as BULK. Examples: cold meats and cheese sold in butchers and delicatessens, fudge cut from bars, loose fruit and vegetables, grains, candy, fresh produce, fabric bolts, spooled chain or rope, nails or snacks. A fixed-measure reel of 100 metres of wire is sold from the supplier to the retailer. At the retailer, the consumer may either buy the entire 100-metre reel at a fixed price for the whole reel, or may request a length of wire to be cut to his requirement at a price per metre. A 10 pound case of candy sold to the retailer. The retailer puts this in bins and prices.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Pre-packed
definition: A variable-measure trade item which is provided with packaging that is assembled or produced by the supplier or by the retailer in advance of sale to the consumer. Examples: cheese and deli meats pre-packed and priced by the retailer, chicken breast pre-packed and priced by the supplier before delivery to the retailer, pre-packed fruit and vegetables sold by weight or count (not a fixed price per pack).
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Beans Peas Legumes
definition: Foods can be found in the Bean/Pea (Legume) Subgroup Section of the Food Buying Guide. Bean/Pea (Legume) Vegetables are fresh, frozen, or canned vegetables and full-strength vegetable juice may contribute toward the Bean/Peas (Legume) vegetable requirement. The minimum creditable serving size for any single vegetable is 1/8 cup. The vegetable component is credited on a volume measure.  The unit of measure is “cup”.  Crediting for vegetable is expressed by rounding down to the nearest 1/8 cup. Over the course of the week, schools must offer vegetables from specific subgroups established by the Dietary Guidelines for Americans. The “additional” vegetable requirement may be met with vegetables from any subgroup. Examples of Bean/Pea (Legume) vegetables include: turtle beans, garbanzo beans or chickpeas, black eyed beans (or peas), great northern beans, kidney beans, lima beans, mung beans, navy or pea beans, pink beans, pinto beans, refried beans, red beans, soybeans, green peas.
codeListDefinition: A qualifier to specify the type of creditable vegetable ingredient subgroup applicable to the item as specified on the Product Formulation Statement and defined by the requirements, rules and regulations set forth by the applicable product formulation sta

codeListDefinition: A code depicting the type of zoom the device or lens has fpr example DIGITAL or OPTICAL.

name: Sailab Fennica
definition: Finland National Medical Products Administration
Lithium-Ion rechargeable battery/cell, cylindrical, with a diameter of approximately 18 millimetres and a length of approximately 65 millimetres. Other common names: 168A, 1865.

name: Biodegradable material
definition: Biodegradable refers to the ability of things to get disintegrated (decomposed) by the action of micro-organisms such as bacteria or fungi biological (with or without oxygen) while getting assimilated into the natural environment.

name: Biogas
definition: Biogas is a naturally occurring and renewable source of energy, resulting from the breakdown of organic matter.

name: Quinine
definition: A bitter crystalline compound present in cinchona bark.

name: Recycled material
definition: A renewable resource material is an organic natural resource which can replenish to overcome usage and consumption, either through biological reproduction or other naturally reoccurring processes in a finite amount of time, for example wood.

name: Recycled material, Mass balance
definition: Recycled material and feedstock are combined with virgin raw materials in the production process, resulting in a final product that contains both virgin and recycled content. Mass balance involves mixing fossil and recycled/renewable materials to meet this objective. It's important to note that individual trade items may not necessarily include recycled material, but the plastic material producer is certified for mass balance and incorporates a specific percentage of recycled materials in their feedstock. Refer to local regulations.

name: Renewable material
definition: A renewable material is a material made of natural resources that can be replenished, generation after generation.

name: Renewable material, Mass balance
definition: Renewable material and renewable feedstock (raw material used in industrial process or as fuel) with virgin raw materials in the production process. This creates a final product that is a mixture of virgin and renewable content. Mass balance is about mixing fossil and renewable/recycled materials.  It's important to note that individual trade items may not necessarily include renewable material, but the plastic material producer is certified for mass balance and incorporates a specific percentage of renewable materials in their feedstock. Refer to local regulations.

name: Wind power
definition: Wind power or wind energy is mostly the use of wind turbines to generate electricity. Wind power is a popular, sustainable, renewable energy source that has a much smaller impact on the environment than burning fossil fuels.

name: Naturally vegan
definition: Products that are aligned to the definition of vegan, but in addition are made from a single natural product without additional ingredients or additives. Local regulations, where they exist, prevail since a vegan or vegetarian declaration for naturally vegan or vegetarian products could be objected to by the authorities as advertising with self-evident facts, especially for mono-products.

name: Partially made with from
definition: A claim that the item is partially made with/from specific ingredient/nutrition/etc. and any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer. Please refer to any local regulations that determine containment levels for the claim.

name: Aeroponics
definition: Growing plants in the air or mist environment without soil or an aggregate medium.

name: Aquaponics
definition: A system of aquaculture in which the waste produced by aquatic animals supplies nutrients for plants grown hydroponically.

name: Coco fibre
definition: A natural fibre extracted from the outer husk of coconut and It is made from fibrous coconut husks that have been compressed into blocks. Also knows as "Coco Coir".

name: Coconut husk
definition: A thick-walled, usually lignified cells which form the outer protective covering of coconut.

name: Hybrid greenhouse
definition: A hybrid greenhouse utilizes the design concept of a Positive Pressure Greenhouse with addition of air and humidity control.

name: Indoor
definition: Product(s) grown or cultivated indoor (e.g., plant).

name: Other
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

name: Rockwool
definition: A lightweight hydroponic substrate is made from spinning molten basaltic rock into fin fibres which are then formed into a range of cubes, blocks and growing slabs.

name: Soil
definition: A mixture of organic matter, mineral, gases, liquids, and organisms that together support life.

name: Soil substitute
definition: Soil alternatives are made from a variety of blended materials including and not limited to mosses like peat or sphagnum moss, rocks and minerals like calcined clay.

name: Suspended hydroponics
definition: Plants grow in a small amount of substrate held by a perforated container which is supported by a fixed cover over a tank.

name: Litre per minute
definition: Litre per minute [L/min] (Unified code)

name: Echinacea root/leaf extract
definition: GS1 Tagname Description: An extract made from Echinacea root/leaf. Echinacea is a genus of herbaceous flowering plants in the daisy family. - UOM for Nutrient Panel: mg - GS1 Notes, Keywords, and Examples: - GS1 Comment: GS1 temporary code - GS1 Synonyms: Echinacea angustifolia, Echinacea purpurea, CAS Number: 84696-11-7

name: Plant-based cork
definition: Cork made of plant-based materials. Also known as Bio-based cork.

name: Hermetically sealed
definition: The packaging which is designed and intended to be secure against the entry of microorganisms and to maintain the safety and quality of its contents after processing.

name: Sealed
definition: An unopened package which cannot be opened without breaking or damaging such package or any seal, adhesive label or other part of or attachment to such package. Most commonly a sealed package is not air tight.

name: Allergy UK Seal of Approval
definition: Allergy UK Seal of Approval is a globally recognised product endorsement. This Seal of Approval is an endorsement of products which have been independently scientifically tested and proven to reduce or remove allergens from the indoor environment.

name: Bio Slovakia label
definition: National BIO mark of the Slovak Republic (Naturalis SK). The main subjects of business are control and certification in organic agricultural production (EPV).

name: Eco Slovakia label
definition: The national environmental labelling scheme, the Ministry of the Environment of the Slovak Republic awards the national environmental label "Environmentally suitable product" (EVP) to products and services that have met strict environmental criteria.

name: ECOSMETICA Natural
definition: ECOSMETICA QUALITY certifications protect consumers concernes about safety and efficacy of cosmetics products. The Standard sets criteria for companies to ensure the use of vegetable substances and natural processes to create “natural” cosmetics. The certification confirms adherence to these criteria and and that the cosmetic is compliant following control from Ecogruppo Italia.

name: ECOSMETICA Organic
definition: ECOSMETICA QUALITY certifications protect consumers concernes about safety and efficacy of cosmetics products. The Standard sets criteria for companies to ensure the use of vegetable substances and natural processes to create “organic” cosmetics. The certification confirms adherence to these criteria and and that the cosmetic is compliant following control from Ecogruppo Italia.

name: EcoSun Pass approved
definition: Based on a sense of environmental responsibility, scientific discipline and sensitivity to consumer wishes, BASF has introduced a methodology to assess the environmental impact of sunscreen formulations. The environmental impact of the selected combination of UV-filters (ultra-violet filters) is calculated by EcoSun Pass’ evaluation parameters. No UV-filters known to harm coral reefs or on EU’s priority list for potential endocrine disrupters are allowed.

name: V Label naturally vegan
definition: The vegan V-Label with the additional statement “von Natur aus” (naturally vegan / vegan by nature) is a recognised, registered label which can be applied to vegan products that are not or only minimally processed and are vegan due to their natural properties.

name: GGN (GLOBALG.A.P. Number)
definition: The GlobalG.A.P. Number (GGN) can only be used on consumer labels for GlobalG.A.P. certified products under the Integrated Farm Assurance (IFA) Standards for: aquaculture; flowers and ornamental plants (floriculture); fruit and vegetables.

name: Green Experience Italy
definition: Green Experience is a Coldiretti Cuneo project, aimed at creating a network of Piedmontese producers who practice green, rethought and sustainable viticulture. It is presented to consumers with two specifications and two respective alternative brands (blue butterfly, for integrated production, and gold butterfly, for organic), 10 rules to follow and a unique future-oriented collaboration project.

name: Islamic Cultural Center Halal of Scandinavia
definition: Halal certification of Islamic Cultural Center of Scandinavia.

name: Islamic Services of America (ISA)
definition: ISA (Islamic Services of America) is a recognized global leader in Halal Certification and Auditing Services with a team of regional offices, professionals, and industry leaders throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico. ISA confidently provides any organization from multinationals, SME’s, and even startups, a level of integrity and service in Halal certification ensuring a comprehensive approach and plan for all your Halal needs.

name: KVH Kosher Certification
definition: KVH (Kashrus Vaad Harabonim) Kosher, a premier authority on Kashrus, brings together consumers, retailers and manufacturers, to make Kosher accessible in the Greater Boston area, the New England region and across the globe.

name: Made in Slovakia
definition: The "Made in Slovakia" logo can only be used by companies that carry out production activities on the territory of the Slovak Republic, are registered in the GS1 Slovakia association and have an application for the use of the logo on specific products approved by the association. The "Made in Slovakia" logo is protected by copyright law.

name: Manchester beis din Kosher
