name: Chop
definition: Refers to the action of cutting or dividing something, usually food, into smaller pieces.

name: Form/Shape
definition: Refers to food items that have been processed, shaped, or manufactured into specific shapes, sizes, or forms.

name: Gas oven
definition: A cooking method which utilizes an oven heated by gas.

name: Grind
definition: Refers to the process of reducing something into smaller particles or fragments by crushing, pounding, or mechanically breaking it down.

name: High-speed oven
definition: A cooking method which utilizes a high-speed oven, also known as a rapid cook oven or speed oven, which is a compact appliance that combines microwave technology with vertical hot air impingement and convection to cook food at a faster speed compared to a traditional oven or grill.

name: Pressure steam
definition: A cooking method which utilizes steam generated from a small amount of water in a sealed vessel. The food itself is not in direct contact with the water. Instead, the food is placed on a rack or basket above the water level.

name: Pulled
definition: Refers to a method of preparing meat where it's slow-cooked until tender enough to be easily pulled apart into shreds or chunks.

name: Wood oven
definition: A cooking method which utilizes an oven heated by wood. Similar terms: Wood oven cooked/baked, wood fired.

name: Video website
definition: Link to a product-related video that can be played online. Such video links are usually hosted on special platforms, such as YouTube, Vimeo and TikTok.

name: Plastic directive
definition: Directive on the reduction of the impact of certain plastic products on the environment (e.g., directive (EU) 2019/904).

name: Lens dioptre
definition: The dioptre of the optical lens. Dioptre is defined as the inverse of the focal length. It is mostly used in optics, typically to indicate strength of prescription eyeglasses.

name: Ball
definition: Refers to small, round or sometimes slightly flattened ball made from ground material(s). Example: meatball food item, typically made with beef, pork, veal, vegetables or a combination of ingredients.

name: Chub/Log
definition: Refers to a cylindrical-shaped item that is typically wrapped in packaging.

name: Cube
definition: Refers to a piece or cube-shaped portion that has been cut or formed into a cube shape.

name: Link
definition: Refers to an item that is processed, typically ground or minced and then encased in a casing.

name: Loaf
definition: Refers to an item made by combining various ingredients or materials, often minced or ground, and then shaping them into a loaf-like form.

name: Nugget
definition: Refers to a small, bite-sized portion of an item that has been shaped or formed into a nugget-like shape.

name: Other
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

name: Patty
definition: Refers to a flattened, usually round portion of an item that's typically made by compressing or forming ingredients.

name: Ring
definition: Refers to an item shaped like a ring.

name: Roll
definition: Refers to an item wrapped or rolled into a cylindrical or flat shape.

name: Rope
definition: Refers to items or preparations that have a rope-like appearance or texture.

name: Shredded
definition: Refers to the process of cutting or tearing an item into long, thin strips or pieces.

name: Slab
definition: Refers to a solid, flat piece or portion of an item.

name: Slice
definition: Refers to cutting it into thin, flat pieces or sections.

name: Strip
definition: Refers to long, thin pieces or strips of an item.

name: Unformed
definition: Refers to something that hasn't been given a specific form, structure, or defined shape.

name: 1366 x 768
definition: The display of the product has a resolution of 1366 x 768.

name: Soft
definition: Soft bristles, e.g., for toothbrushes, for both children and adults, that are able to brush close to the gum without irritation.

name: Ultra soft
definition: Ultra soft bristles, e.g., for toothbrushes for people with dentine hypersensitivity, dental erosion or those applying too much pressure when brushing.

name: Super soft
definition: Super soft bristles, e.g., for toothbrushes for people with sensitive teeth, gums, or conditions like gingivitis, preventing enamel erosion, and providing gentle cleaning without causing injury or discomfort.

name: Extra soft
definition: Extra soft bristles, e.g., for toothbrushes for people with sensitive teeth, gums, or conditions like gingivitis, removing plaque without irritation, and preventing enamel erosion.

name: Hard
definition: Hard bristles, e.g., for toothbrushes not recommended for everyday use on natural teeth because it can be too hard on gums and tooth enamel.

name: Medium
definition: Medium bristles, e.g., for toothbrushes not recommended for everyday use on natural teeth because it can be too hard on gums and tooth enamel.

name: Attributional
definition: An attributional life cycle assessment (ALCA) is focusing on describing, assessing and quantifying environmentally relevant physical flows of specific life cycle(s) and its subsystems. An ALCA gives an estimate of what part of the global environmental burdens belongs to the study object. An ALCA does not include environmental benefits or other indirect consequences that arise outside the life cycle of the investigated product.

name: Consequential
definition: A consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) is focusing on describing, assessing and quantifying environmentally relevant flows and how they will change in response to possible decisions. A CLCA gives an estimate of how the production and use of the study object affect the global environmental burdens. For example, an increased use of a material in the studied system can lead to less material being used in other systems.

name: Transport of final product
definition: The emissions resulting from the distribution of the product to the retail network or to downstream stakeholders. This stage includes transport of the final product and its packaging, storage and warehousing.

name: Cradle to gate
definition: Total amount of CO2 emission from a life cycle assessment (LCA) model that assesses a product’s environmental footprint from raw materials extraction until it leaves the factory gate.

name: Cradle to grave
definition: Total amount of CO2 emission from a life cycle assessment (LCA) model that assesses a product’s environmental footprint from raw materials extraction until its disposal, including manufacturing, transportation, product use.

name: Raw materials
definition: The emissions resulting from the production/extraction, packaging, storage, warehousing and transportation of raw materials.

name: End of life
definition: The emission of the product when it is disposed, recycled, recovered after use.

name: Manufacturing
definition: The emissions resulting from the manufacturing/production of the product.

name: Use
definition: The emissions of the product when used by the consumer.

name: Cradle to consumption
definition: Total amount of CO2 emission from a life cycle assessment (LCA) model that assesses a product’s environmental footprint from raw materials extraction until it is consumed. (PEF guidance, the European Commission 2021b)

name: PCR EDF
definition: Product-specific value, based on Product Category Rule (PCR) of an Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) system.

name: PCR
definition: Product Category Rules.

name: ReCiPe
definition: Based on National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), Institute of Environmental Sciences (CML), Product Category Rule (PCR).

name: PEF
definition: The Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) methodology is performed following the PEF guidelines published by the European Commission and, if available, specific category rules (PEFCRs).

name: Not classified
definition: A standard calculation method, not classified in the codelist.

name: ISO 14064
definition: ISO 14064 specifies requirements for selecting Greenhouse Gas (GHG) validators/verifiers, establishing the level of assurance, objectives, criteria and scope, determining the validation/verification approach, assessing GHG data, information, information systems and controls, evaluating GHG assertions and preparing validation/verification statements.

name: ENVIMAT
definition: Value for the product-group from an input-output study, based on ENVIMAT in Finland (Nissinen et al. 2019, SYKEra 15/2019).

name: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol
definition: The Product Life Cycle Accounting and Reporting Standard can be used to understand the full life cycle emissions of a product and focus efforts on the greatest Greenhouse Gas (GHG) reduction opportunities.

name: EPD
definition: Environmental Product Declaration (EPD).

name: Carbon footprint standard
definition: Product-specific value, based on carbon footprint standard (ISO 14067).

name: External verification
definition: The values have been verified by an external party.

name: Peer reviewed
definition: The values and methodology have been reviewed internally or by 3rd party.

name: Not verified
definition: The values have been calculated according to the reported calculation method, but have not been verified.

name: Tallow
definition: Refers to a type of rendered and clarified fat that is obtained from the suet or hard fat of animals.

name: Lard
definition: Refers to the fat tissues found in the abdominal area of pigs. It is obtained by rendering (melting and clarifying) the fat to separate the liquid fat from any solid impurities.

name: Dripping
definition: Refers to the fat and juices that are rendered from meat during the cooking process. When meat is cooked, especially when it is roasted or grilled, the fat present in the meat starts to melt and liquefy, along with the natural juices released from the meat.

name: Shortening
definition: Refers to a type of solid fat used in cooking and baking. It is typically made from vegetable oils, such as soybean, cottonseed, or palm oil, that have been hydrogenated to solidify them.

name: Suet
definition: Refers to the hard, white fat found around the kidneys of animals.

name: Other
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

name: UNECE (United Nations Economic Commission for Europe)
definition: The United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE) is one of the five regional commissions under the jurisdiction of the United Nations Economic and Social Council. It was established in order to promote economic cooperation and integration among its member states.

name: Feeding system
definition: Refers to the feeding system according to regulation of the importing country. If no regulation exists then the exporting country regulation.

name: Refrigeration
definition: Refers to the refrigeration method used, tolerances for product weight to be agreed between buyer and seller.

name: Animal detail category
definition: Refers to the detail of the animal that may be age, gender, or specific type of animal.

name: Production system
definition: Refers to the production system according to regulation of the importing country. If no regulation exists then the exporting country regulation.

name: Quality level
definition: Refers to the quality level of the product based upon some classification of quality.

name: Cut
definition: Refers to the cut/anatomical form or such of the animal based on the standard.

name: Per kilogram
definition: Per kilogram

name: Per pound
definition: Per pound

name: Per ounce
definition: Per ounce

name: Per gram
definition: Per gram

name: Maximum fixation
definition: Describes a product that ensures maximum fixation of the hairstyle. It is suitable for use for social event hairstyles that require long-term fixation of not only fine but also very stiff (unyielding) hair.

name: High fixation
definition: Describes a product that has high effect on the hair. It is suitable for strong and stubborn hair with a tendency to frizz.

name: Light fixation
definition: Describes a product that has very little effect on the hair. It is mostly suitable for fixing fine hair.

name: Medium fixation
definition: Describes a product that has little effect on the hair. It is mostly suitable for fixing fine hair.

name: Very high fixation
definition: Describes a product that has very high effect on the hair. It is suitable for strong and stubborn hair with a tendency to frizz.

name: Ultra fixation
definition: Describes a product that provides ultra fixation of the hairstyle (e.g., hair gel).

name: Mono material
definition: Layers are made of the same material type.

name: Multi material
definition: Layers are made of different material types.

name: Supplemented with
definition: The element is added to the product to improve the nutritional profile or to provide other benefits.

name: Lower back
definition: Refers to a specific part of the bird's anatomy. The lower back, also known as the lumbar region, is the area located on the back of the bird, just above the tail and towards the hindquarters.

name: Boneless
definition: Refers to a specific poultry cut that has been prepared by removing the bones from the piece of meat.

name: Breast
definition: Refers to a specific poultry cut taken from the front chest area of an animal.

name: Cap off/Cap removed
definition: Refers to a boneless, skinless cut of poultry where the top part, also known as the cap, has been removed. The cap is typically the upper portion of the breast meat that is attached to the skin.

name: Cap /Cap on
definition: Refers to a boneless, skinless cut of poultry where the top part, also known as the cap, is left attached to the breast meat. In other words, the skin and the uppermost portion of the breast are not removed, and the cut maintains its natural shape.

name: Fat
definition: Refers to the adipose tissue found in and around various cuts of meat. Additionally, there is also external fat, often referred to as "trimmable fat" or "fat cap," which is found on the surface of certain cuts of meat.

name: Filleted
definition: Cut or prepared as a fillet.

name: Gizzard
definition: Refers to a muscular pouch that helps birds grind and digest food by using small stones (grit) they ingest.

name: Half
definition: Refers to half of an animal.

name: Hindquarter/Back half
definition: Refers to the back half of an animal's carcass, specifically the rear portion of the body. It includes the hind legs or limbs, hip, and associated cuts of meat.

name: Long/Long cut
definition: Refers to a specific type of meat cut that involves slicing the meat parallel to its natural grain or muscle fibers. This results in longer, more elongated pieces of meat.

name: Neck
definition: Refers to the portion of meat from the animal's body located between the head and the shoulders.

name: Sliced
definition: Cut into slices.

name: Stripped
definition: Refers to poultry meat that has been removed or separated from the bone, skin, or other connective tissues. This process of removing the meat from the bones and other parts is commonly referred to as "deboning" or "stripping" the poultry.

name: Tenderloins/Tender/Inner fillet
definition: Refers to a specific cut of poultry meat known for its tenderness and are located on the underside of the chicken breast. These tenderloins are thin, long strips of meat that run parallel to the breastbone. Poultry tenders are distinct from the rest of the breast meat as they are not connected to the breastbone and do not have any tough connective tissues or bones.

name: Testicles/Testes
definition: Refers to the male reproductive organs of animals. In some culinary traditions and cultures, testicles are considered a type of offal or "variety meat" and are consumed as food. They are often referred to by specific names based on the animal they come from.

name: Thigh
definition: Refers to the lower part of the bird's leg, specifically the upper portion of the leg that is closer to the body.

name: Wing drumette (1st segment)
definition: Refers to the upper part of the wing, closest to the bird's body. It is meatier and resembles a small drumstick.

name: Wing flat (2nd segment)/Wingette
definition: Refers to the middle portion of the wing. It contains two bones and is flatter in shape. Also known as the mid-wing, wingette or flat.

name: Upper back
definition: Refers to the section located closer to the neck and is generally considered part of the poultry's breast.  The upper back is often referred to as the back half of the breast.

name: Bone or Bone in
definition: Refers to the bone(s) with or without the meat.

name: Partial boneless
definition: Refers to a type of poultry meat preparation where some bones have been removed, leaving only certain bone-in portions intact. In this context, "partial" indicates that not all bones have been taken out, and the meat still retains some of its natural bone structure. Each cut may vary in the bones removed.

name: Cutlet
definition: Refers to a thin, boneless piece of meat that is sometimes breaded and/or fried. The meat used for cutlets can come from various sources.

name: Dark meat
definition: Refers to the meat from certain parts of the bird that is darker in colour compared to white meat. Dark meat is found in areas of the bird that are more active and used for sustained movement, such as walking or flying.

name: Drumstick
definition: Refers to the lower portion of the bird's leg, specifically the part between the knee joint and the ankle joint.

name: Drumstick incision
definition: Refers to making small cuts or slits in the flesh of the drumstick.

name: Rib meat
definition: Refers to the meat found along the ribs of a bird. The rib meat is located on the underside of the bird's body, where the ribs are attached to the breast meat.

name: Rib meat removed
definition: Refers to the removal of the meat found along the ribs of a bird. The rib meat is located on the underside of the bird's body, where the ribs are attached to the breast meat.

name: Ribs
definition: Refer to the bones and meat found along the ribcage of a bird. While poultry ribs are smaller and more delicate compared to traditional pork or beef ribs, they still offer a flavorful and tender eating experience. The ribcage of a bird contains a combination of bones, cartilage, and intercostal muscles that contribute to the rib meat.

name: Short/Short cut
definition: Refers to a specific type of meat cut that involves slicing the meat perpendicular to its grain, resulting in shorter and more compact pieces.

name: Tail removed
definition: The animal with tail removed / without tail.

name: Tail on
definition: The animal with its tail on / with its tail.

name: Abdominal fat
definition: Refers to the fat deposits found in the abdominal cavity of poultry birds raised for meat production. This type of fat is distinct from subcutaneous fat, which is found directly under the skin, as it accumulates within the abdominal cavity surrounding the internal organs. Also known as abdominal fat pad or abdominal adipose tissue.

name: Assorted
definition: Refers to a description of a collection or group of various different items or things that are mixed together. It is often used to refer to a selection of different types or varieties of something, typically presented as a single package or set.

name: Back removed
definition: Refers to a specific preparation of poultry meat where the back portion has been removed from the bird before further processing or cooking. This process is commonly done to create specific cuts or to modify the bird's shape for various culinary purposes.

name: Brain
definition: Refers to the organ that is a part of the central nervous system found in the heads of animals. In culinary terms, "brain" specifically refers to the brain of certain animals, usually those that are commonly consumed for food.

name: Split breast
definition: Refers to a specific cut of poultry meat where the breast section of the bird is split into two halves, creating two separate pieces.

name: Butterfly cut/V-style cut
definition: Refers to a specific method of preparing poultry by removing the backbone and flattening the bird to create a more even thickness. This technique involves cutting along the backbone and then spreading the bird open like a book, resulting in a butterfly-like appearance. also known as spatchcocking or butterflying.

name: Crest
definition: Refers to a distinctive tuft or fleshy protuberance of feathers found on the top of the bird's head.

name: Removed fat
definition: Refers to the process of removing the fat from meat. Fat is adipose tissue found in and around various cuts of meat. Additionally, there is also external fat, often referred to as "trimmable fat" or "fat cap," which is found on the surface of certain cuts of meat.

name: Giblet
definition: Refers to a set of internal organs commonly found in birds raised for meat consumption.The typical poultry giblets include liver, heart,  gizzard, and/or neck.

name: Giblets removed
definition: Refers to the removal of  a set of internal organs commonly found in birds raised for meat consumption.The typical poultry giblets include liver, heart,  gizzard, and/or neck.

name: Head
definition: Refers to the entire head of an animal. The head contains various parts, including the skull, brain, eyes, ears, snout, tongue, and sometimes the cheeks and jowls. Different cultures have varying culinary traditions and uses for the head of the animal.

name: Heart
definition: Refers to the muscular organ that pumps blood throughout the circulatory system of an animal. The heart is a vital organ and an edible part of the animal that is used for culinary purposes in various cuisines around the world.

name: Kidney
definition: Refers to the organ found in the abdominal cavity that are part of the animal's urinary system and play a crucial role in filtering waste products and excess water from the blood to produce urine. Animal kidneys are also considered a type of offal or organ meat, and they have been a part of traditional diets in many cultures for centuries.

name: Leg whole/Leg
definition: Refers to the entire leg of a bird, which includes both the drumstick and the thigh in one piece. This cut is not separated at the joint, and the leg remains intact, preserving the natural connection between the thigh and the drumstick.

name: Mixed parts
definition: Refers to a combination of different cuts of meat and pieces obtained from an animal during the butchering process.

name: Neck half
definition: Refers to a specific cut of poultry that includes half of the bird's neck. A poultry neck half is obtained by cutting the neck in half lengthwise, dividing it into two roughly equal parts. Each half of the neck includes both the bone and the meat.

name: Ribs removed
definition: Refers to a specific cut of poultry meat where the rib bones have been removed from the bird, leaving the rib meat without the bones. This is a preparation method commonly used to create boneless poultry meat cuts.

name: Skin on
definition: The animal with its skin on / with skin on.

name: Slant cut
definition: Refers to the process of cutting the meat at a between 15 to 30 degree angle.

name: Tenderloins removed
definition: Refers to the removal of the tenderloins. The tenderloins are thin, long strips of meat that run parallel to the breastbone. Poultry tenders are distinct from the rest of the breast meat as they are not connected to the breastbone and do not have any tough connective tissues or bones.

name: Tendon Clipped (Tip off)
definition: Refers to the protruding portion of the tendon is removed.

name: Tendons
definition: Refers to the tough, fibrous connective tissues that connect muscles to bones in an animal's body.

name: Trimmed
definition: Refers to the process of removing excess fat, connective tissue, and any undesirable or inedible portions from a meat cut. When a cut of meat is "trimmed," it is prepared to have a more uniform appearance, improve its presentation, and enhance its cooking qualities.

name: Whole
definition: Refers to the animal as a whole.

name: Wing 2 joint (2nd and 3rd segment)
definition: Refers to a specific cut of the bird's wing, which has been divided into two distinct joints. The tip is usually removed, and the wing is separated into two sections: the drumette and the wingette (mid-wing). The two joints created by this cut are the connection points between the drumette and the wingette.

name: Non-traditional cut
definition: Refers to less common or unconventional ways of portioning the bird. These cuts are not typically found in standard culinary practices but can offer unique and creative ways to use different parts of the bird. Examples: Oyster, Cushion, Roulade, etc.

name: Back portion
definition: Refers to the section of the bird's body located between the neck and the tail. This area includes the backbone, ribs, and surrounding meat.

name: Whole back
definition: Refers to the entire back portion of a bird, including the backbone, ribs, and surrounding meat, remains intact without any specific preparation or removal. This would typically include the upper back (closer to the neck) and the lower back (towards the tail).

name: Belly
definition: Refers to a specific cut of poultry that comes from the underside or abdominal area of an animal.

name: Blood
definition: Refers to the process of slaughtering an animal, some blood can be collected for various purposes, such as further processing into blood-based products or used in specific culinary applications.

name: Whole breast
definition: Refers to the entire breast portion of a bird that includes both the left and right sides, with bones and skin intact. Also known as a full breast.

name: Carcass
definition: Refers to the edible flesh or muscle tissue obtained from the body of an animal after it has been slaughtered and processed for consumption. When an animal is slaughtered, the body is typically referred to as a carcass until it is broken down into different cuts of meat.

name: Feet (Paws, Claws)
definition: Refer to the edible parts of an animal's limbs, particularly the feet or hooves. The feet from various animals, can be consumed in certain cuisines and culinary traditions around the world.

name: Forequarter/Front half
definition: Refers to the front portion of an animal's carcass, specifically the front half of the body. It includes the front legs or limbs, shoulder, and associated cuts of meat.

name: Intestines/Chitterlings
definition: Refers to the small intestines of birds raised for meat consumption. Like other animals, poultry have a digestive system that includes a long tube-like structure called the intestines, responsible for the absorption of nutrients from their food. also known as chitterlings or chitlins.

name: Leg quarter
definition: Refers to a specific cut of poultry that includes both the leg and thigh portions of the bird.

name: Liver
definition: Refers to the large organ found in the abdominal cavity of animals, including livestock and game animals. The liver is responsible for performing essential functions such as filtering and detoxifying blood, producing bile to aid in digestion, storing certain nutrients, and metabolizing various substances in the body. the liver is considered an organ meat or offal, and it is highly valued for its nutritional richness and distinct flavour.

name: Other
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

name: Part piece
definition: Refers to a specific portion or cut of poultry meat, such as a chicken breast or turkey thigh.

name: Quartered
definition: Refers to a specific preparation method where a whole bird is cut into four quarters by dividing it into four parts. Each quarter typically consists of a combination of the leg and thigh on one side and the wing and breast on the other side of the bird.

name: Scapula meat
definition: Refers to the meat removed from the scapula bone (shoulder blade).

name: Special trim
definition: Refers to a specific request or custom preparation of meat made by a customer or chef to meet their specific requirements or preferences. It involves trimming or cutting the meat in a particular way that differs from the standard or conventional cuts typically offered by the butcher.

name: Square cut/Squared
definition: Refers to a specific cutting technique used to prepare meat or poultry. When a piece of meat is square cut, it means that the butcher has made straight, even cuts across the meat, resulting in a block-like or square shape.

name: Stomach
definition: Refers to the organ that forms a part of the digestive system of animals. The stomach is responsible for breaking down and digesting food through the action of digestive juices and acids. In certain culinary traditions and cultures, the stomach is considered an edible part and used in various dishes.

name: Tendon removed
definition: Refers to poultry meat from which the tendons or tough connective tissues have been removed. Tendons are fibrous tissues that connect muscles to bones, and they can be tough and chewy when not properly cooked or removed.

name: Tendon partially removed
definition: Refers to poultry meat from which some, but not all, of the tendons or tough connective tissues have been removed. In this case, the meat may still contain some small pieces of tendon or connective tissue that have not been fully trimmed away.

name: Trimmings
definition: Refers to the leftover pieces, scraps, or excess parts of poultry that are removed during the butchering and processing of the bird. These trimmings can include various parts, such as skin, fat, small bits of meat, connective tissues, bones, and other offcuts.

name: V wing  (1st and 2nd segment)
definition: Refers to the process of dislocating the joint between the wingette and drumette, so that the two portions form an upright "V" shape.

name: White meat
definition: Refers to the lighter-coloured meat found in birds. It is typically located in the breast and wing portions of the bird. The primary difference between white meat and dark meat in poultry is the muscle type and function in the bird. White meat comes from fast-twitch muscles, which are used for short bursts of activity and are less active.

name: Wing tip (3rd segment)
definition: Refers to the pointed end of the wing. It is mostly skin and cartilage and has little meat. Also know as the flapper.

name: Whole wing/Wing
definition: Refers to a specific part of the bird's anatomy. The wings are located on the upper part of the bird's body, and they are essential for flight in wild birds.

name: Wings removed
definition: Refers to the process of removal of the wings. The wings are located on the upper part of the bird's body, and they are essential for flight in wild birds.

name: Traditional cut
definition: Refers to the standard methods of dividing a whole bird into smaller, more manageable pieces for cooking or serving.

name: 3 way cut
definition: Refers to meat cut in 3 sections. Please refer to the animal to determine the exact parts that are cut.

name: Assorted
definition: Refers to a description of a collection or group of various different items or things that are mixed together. It is often used to refer to a selection of different types or varieties of something, typically presented as a single package or set.

name: Banjo cut
definition: Refers to a meat cut named Banjo Cut and is named due to its oval shape after removal of the scapular and ribs from the square cut shoulder.

name: Blade bone
definition: Refers to the related cartilage, and overlying muscles (in their entirety) and fat shall be removed.

name: Blood
definition: Refers to the process of slaughtering an animal, some blood can be collected for various purposes, such as further processing into blood-based products or used in specific culinary applications.

name: Bolar
definition: Refers to a specific meat cut taken from the shoulder region of a beef carcass. More specifically, it is the triangular-shaped cut located between the blade bone and the neck bone.

name: Butt
definition: Refers to a specific meat cut taken from the upper shoulder or the rear end of an animal, such as a pig (pork butt) or a cattle (beef butt). It is also known as "pork shoulder" or "pork butt" when sourced from a pig and "beef shoulder" or "beef butt" when sourced from cattle.

name: Cap /Cap on
definition: Refers to the meat cut still has a layer of fat (the "cap") covering one side of the meat.

name: Cap off/Cap removed
definition: Refers to the meat cut has been trimmed to remove the layer of fat covering one side of the meat.

name: Carcass
definition: Refers to the edible flesh or muscle tissue obtained from the body of an animal after it has been slaughtered and processed for consumption. When an animal is slaughtered, the body is typically referred to as a carcass until it is broken down into different cuts of meat.

name: Carcass side
definition: Refers to a specific section or portion of meat that is obtained from one side of an animal's carcass after it has been divided lengthwise.

name: Carcass telescoped
definition: Refers to the preparation from a full carcass, that the leg folded or placed into the chest cavity, a cut is made horizontally across the dorsal edge of the carcass at the junction of the 6th lumbar and 1st sacral vertebrae breaking the spine sufficiently to allow the legs to fold into the cavity of the carcass.

name: Chump
definition: Refers to a specific cut that comes from the hindquarters of the animal, specifically the lower back and rump area. The chump is also sometimes called "chump chop" or "chump end".

name: Chump off
definition: Refers to the removal of the Chump by a cut at right angles across the leg at a specified measured distance from the acetabulum.

name: Diaphragm
definition: Refers to a large, dome-shaped muscle that separates the chest cavity (thoracic cavity) from the abdominal cavity in mammals.

name: Esophagus
definition: Refers to a muscular tube that connects the mouth to the stomach. Its primary function is to transport food from the mouth to the stomach through rhythmic contractions known as peristalsis.

name: Eye of round
definition: Refers to a specific portion of meat obtained from the round primal section. The round primal is located on the rear leg of the animal and is known for being one of the leaner and less tender parts of the carcass. The "round eye" specifically comes from the round roast, which is a large, boneless cut that includes the eye of round muscle. The eye of round is a small, elongated, and somewhat cylindrical muscle located within the round roast.

name: Eye of shortloin
definition: Refers to a specific portion of meat obtained from the short loin section. It is also commonly known as the "eye of the short loin."

name: Feet
definition: Refer to the edible parts of an animal's limbs, particularly the feet or hooves. The feet from various animals, can be consumed in certain cuisines and culinary traditions around the world.

name: Flat/Flat iron
definition: Refers to the flat iron steak which is obtained from the chuck primal section of the carcass, specifically from the top blade muscle. It is a rectangular-shaped, well-marbled cut that sits between the shoulder blade and the ribs.

name: Hanging tender
definition: Refers to a long, flat, and somewhat V-shaped muscle that hangs between the last rib and the loin of the animal. It is located in the plate primal section of the carcass, specifically near the diaphragm. Also known as hanger steak, onglet, butcher's steak.

name: Horn
definition: Refers to the pointed, hard, and often curved structures that grow from the heads of certain animals.

name: Intestine large
definition: Refers to the large intestine of an animal, which is a part of the digestive system responsible for absorbing nutrients and water from the ingested food. The large intestine is also known as the colon. In certain culinary traditions, large intestines from certain animals are cleaned thoroughly and prepared as a specialty ingredient in various dishes. In culinary dishes known as chitlins, chitterlings, sausage casing, etc.

name: Intestine small
definition: Refers to the large intestine of an animal, which is a part of the digestive system responsible for absorbing nutrients and water from the ingested food. The large intestine is also known as the colon. In certain culinary traditions, large intestines from certain animals are cleaned thoroughly and prepared as a specialty ingredient in various dishes. In culinary dishes known as tripe, sausage casing, etc.

name: Knuckle
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat that comes from the joint at the end of an animal's leg, particularly in larger animals. The knuckle is located at the lower end of the leg, where it connects to the animal's hoof. It is a part of the round primal cut, which is the rear leg of the animal. Also known as the knuckle bone or round knuckle.

name: Lips
definition: Refers to the soft, fleshy, and often fatty tissues that surround the mouth of certain animals, particularly livestock and game animals.

name: Liver
definition: Refers to the large organ found in the abdominal cavity of animals, including livestock and game animals. The liver is responsible for performing essential functions such as filtering and detoxifying blood, producing bile to aid in digestion, storing certain nutrients, and metabolizing various substances in the body. the liver is considered an organ meat or offal, and it is highly valued for its nutritional richness and distinct flavour.

name: Mock tender
definition: Refers to a specific cut of beef that is also known by several other names, such as Chuck Fillet Steak, Chuck Eye Steak, or Scotch Tender. This cut comes from the chuck primal, which is located in the shoulder region of the animal.

name: Neck
definition: Refers to the portion of meat from the animal's body located between the head and the shoulders.

name: Oyster cut
definition: Refers to a specific portion of meat found in certain animals, particularly in beef and lamb. The term "oyster" is commonly used for this cut due to its shape and location, which bears a resemblance to an oyster shell.

name: Tail removed
definition: The animal with tail removed / without tail.

name: Rib cut
definition: Refers to a specific section of meat that includes a portion of the animal's rib bones. This cut is typically obtained from the rib primal or rib section of the animal.

name: Rib plate
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat that includes both ribs and meat from the lower belly of an animal. The rib plate cut is obtained from the rib section of the animal, and it typically extends downward to include some portions of the belly or "plate" area.

name: Ribeye roll/Cube roll/Rack eye
definition: Refers to a meat cut that is a premium and highly prized cut of meat that comes from the rib primal section of the animal, specifically the ribeye area. Also known as ribeye roll, rack eye, eye of rib, cube roll or scotch fillet.

name: Ribs
definition: Refers to a specific section of an animal's skeletal structure that includes the bones and meat extending from the spine or backbone. Ribs are commonly obtained from various animals.

name: Ribs back/Baby back ribs
definition: Refers to a specific cut of ribs obtained from the upper part of the animal's ribcage.

name: Round
definition: The roundcut comes from the animal's hind legs, thigh, butt, and hams.

name: Shank off
definition: Refers to a specific cutting technique where the shank or leg bone is removed from a cut of meat or a joint. This technique is commonly used to create boneless cuts from portions that originally included the leg bone.

name: Shortloin
definition: Refers to a specific section of meat obtained from the back of an animal, The shortloin is located in the upper part of the animal's back, just behind the rib section and before the sirloin.

name: Shoulder Boston butt upper half
definition: Refers to a specific section of the pork shoulder cut known as the "Boston butt." The "upper half" of the Boston butt refers to a portion of the whole pork shoulder. The pork shoulder is typically divided into two parts: the upper half and the lower half. The upper half of the Boston butt contains more fat and marbling compared to the lower half.

name: Sirloin/Chump sirloin
definition: Refers to the meat cut that comes from the rear of the animal, specifically from the area along the back between the short loin and the round.

name: Skin on
definition: The animal with its skin on / with skin on.

name: Spencer roll
definition: Refers to meat trimmed from the ribs, rolled, and used for short steaks or for a roast.

name: St. Louis style
definition: refers to a specific cut or trimming technique used for spare ribs. St. Louis style ribs are spare ribs that have been trimmed to remove the brisket bone and rib tips. The brisket bone is removed to create a rectangular and more uniform rack of ribs.

name: Stomach
definition: Refers to the organ that forms a part of the digestive system of animals. The stomach is responsible for breaking down and digesting food through the action of digestive juices and acids. In certain culinary traditions and cultures, the stomach is considered an edible part and used in various dishes.

name: Thin
definition: Refers to the measurement or thinness of a meat cut. When the term refers to a cut of meat as "thin," it means that the cut has been sliced or portioned to be thinner and have less depth than thicker cuts.

name: Thymus
definition: Refers to a glandular organ found in the throat or neck region of animals. In culinary terms, the thymus is considered a type of offal or variety meat. It is also known as sweetbread in some regions.

name: Tip
definition: Refers to describe a specific portion or end of a meat cut. Depending on the meat cut, the tip may represent different meanings.

name: Brisket navel plate
definition: Refers to a specific part of the brisket. The navel plate is also known as the "navel end" or the "belly end" of the brisket. The brisket navel plate is the thinner, more pointy end of the brisket that tapers down towards the belly of the animal. It is located opposite to the thicker and more rectangular flat cut of the brisket.

name: Eye of loin
definition:
Refers to a major muscle in the beef rib and loin; lamb rack and loin; and the pork loin. It is
the longest and largest muscle in the back and is exposed when a carcass is ribbed. Also know as Longissimus dorsi, loineye.

name: Eye of rump/Rump eye
definition: Refers to a specific portion of meat obtained from the rump or hindquarters of an animal, particularly from beef or lamb.

name: Jowl
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat from the cheek and jaw region of an animal. For pigs is also known as pork jowl or jowl bacon.

name: Rack
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat that includes a portion of the animal's rib bones, usually from the rib section or rib primal.

name: Aitch-bone removed
definition: Refers to the meat has had the aitch-bone removed. Aitch bone is a cut of meat lying over the aitchbone

name: Rump
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat that comes from the hindquarters of an animal. The rump is located at the rear part of the animal, above the hind legs and just behind the loin.

name: Saddle
definition: Refers to a specific and prestigious cut of meat that includes the back and loin sections of an animal.

name: Shank on
definition: Refers to a specific cutting and preparation technique where the shank or leg bone is intentionally left attached to a cut of meat or a joint. This means that the meat portion includes the leg bone, typically from the lower leg of the animal.

name: Shoulder
definition: Refers to a specific section of meat obtained from the upper part of an animal's front legs.

name: Tripe
definition: Refers to the edible lining of the stomach of animals. Tripe is considered a type of offal or variety meat and is consumed in various culinary traditions around the world.

name: Whole
definition: Refers to the animal as a whole.

name: 5 way cut
definition: Refers to meat cut in 5 sections. Please refer to the animal to determine the exact parts that are cut.

name: Block ready
definition: Refers to a large piece of meat, such as a primal or subprimal cut, before further processing into individual retail cuts.

name: Bones
definition: Refers to the bone(s) with or without the meat.

name: Breast
definition: Refers to a specific meat cut taken from the front chest area of an animal.

name: Brisket point/Point end
definition: Refers to a specific part of the beef brisket. The brisket point is also known as the "point cut" or simply "point." The brisket point is the thicker, more heavily marbled, and triangular-shaped portion of the brisket. It is located on the opposite end of the brisket from the flat cut.

name: Sternum
definition: Refers to the breastbone, which is a bone located in the center of the chest of animals.

name: Centre cut
definition: Refers to a specific portion or section of meat that is obtained from the centre or middle of a larger piece, often a roast or a larger primal cut.

name: Chop
definition: Refers to a specific portion or piece of meat that is cut perpendicular to the backbone of an animal and includes a rib or bone-in portion.

name: Chump on
definition: Refers to the leg prepared from a side by a straight cut through the 6th lumbar vertebrae to a point just clear of the tip of the ilium to the ventral portion of the flap. The lymph node gland (Subiliac) and gland fats situated on the flap are removed.

name: Clod
definition: Refers to a specific section of the animal that comes from the shoulder or forequarter of the animal. The clod is also known as the shoulder clod or simply "beef clod." It is a large, tough, and relatively inexpensive cut of meat that consists of various muscles, connective tissues, and some fat.

name: Crest
definition: Refers to various anatomical features appearing as a raised point or ridge, most prominently those on the head or back of an animal.

name: Cutaneous trunci (rose meat)
definition: Cutaneous Trunci or cutaneous muscle is a relatively thin muscle near the skin in the live animal. It begins on the shoulder and ends in the flank where it is much thicker. The cutaneous trunci on the beef shoulder is commonly called the Shoulder Rose. The flank portion is commonly called Elephant Ears.

name: Easy carve
definition: Refers to the process and skill of easily (low effort) cutting portions of meat, such as roast and poultry, to obtain a maximum or satisfactory number of meat portions.

name: Fat
definition: Refers to the adipose tissue found in and around various cuts of meat. Additionally, there is also external fat, often referred to as "trimmable fat" or "fat cap," which is found on the surface of certain cuts of meat.

name: Flank/Internal flank plate
definition: Refers to a meat cut that comes from the abdominal area of an animal. It is a long, flat, and lean cut of meat that is known for its rich flavor but can be relatively tough if not prepared correctly. Also known as flank plate or flank.

name: Fore feet
definition: Refers to the front limbs or legs of an animal, typically referring to the front feet of larger animals. These front feet are also known as front trotters or front hooves.

name: Forequarter
definition: Refers to the front portion of an animal's carcass, specifically the front half of the body. It includes the front legs or limbs, shoulder, and associated cuts of meat.

name: Foreshank
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat obtained from the front leg or limb of an animal. The foreshank is located in the lower portion of the front leg, just below the shoulder and above the knee joint. Also known as front shank or shin.

name: Frenched
definition: Refers to a specific trimming technique applied to meat, particularly to bone-in cuts like racks of lamb, pork, or beef. When a cut of meat is frenched, the butcher or chef removes the meat and connective tissue from the ends of the bones, exposing them to create a clean and visually appealing presentation. This technique is commonly used to enhance the aesthetics of the dish. Also known as Frenching.

name: Head
definition: Refers to the entire head of an animal. The head contains various parts, including the skull, brain, eyes, ears, snout, tongue, and sometimes the cheeks and jowls. Different cultures have varying culinary traditions and uses for the head of the animal.

name: Head cheek meat
definition: Refers to the meat from the cheeks of an animal's head.

name: Hind feet
definition: Refers to the back limbs or legs of an animal. Also known as hind trotters or hind hooves.

name: Inside
definition: Refers to the internal organs and offal of an animal that are removed during the process of dressing or evisceration. These organs are also commonly referred to as variety meats, organ meats, or offal.

name: Kidney
definition: Refers to the organ found in the abdominal cavity that are part of the animal's urinary system and play a crucial role in filtering waste products and excess water from the blood to produce urine. Animal kidneys are also considered a type of offal or organ meat, and they have been a part of traditional diets in many cultures for centuries.

name: Leg
definition: Refers to a specific primal cut of meat that comes from the hindquarters of an animal. The leg is also known as the hind leg or ham in certain animals.

name: Loin
definition: Refers to a specific section of meat located along the back of an animal, between the ribcage and the pelvis. The exact location of the loin can vary slightly depending on the animal being butchered.

name: Lungs
definition: Refers to the respiratory organs found in the chest cavity of animals, including livestock and game animals. n many regions, laws and regulations govern the handling and disposal of lung tissues to prevent any risk of contamination to the food supply.

name: Middle
definition: Refers to the central portion of an animal's carcass, usually divided along the backbone.

name: Outside
definition: Refers to the outside part of an animal or meat cut.

name: Part piece
definition: Refers to part of an animal or meat cut.

name: Partial bone
definition: Refers to a piece of meat that still has a portion of bone attached to it after it has been partially deboned.

name: Primal
definition: Refers to a large section of an animal carcass that is separated during the initial stages of butchering. Primal cuts are the basic, major divisions of the animal's body that form the foundation for further butchering into individual retail cuts.

name: Blade removed
definition: Refers to the meat has had the blade bone removed. Blade bone is related cartilage, and overlying muscles (in their entirety) and fat shall be removed.

name: Fat removed
definition: Refers to the process of removing the fat from meat. Fat is adipose tissue found in and around various cuts of meat. Additionally, there is also external fat, often referred to as "trimmable fat" or "fat cap," which is found on the surface of certain cuts of meat.

name: Psoas minor removed
definition: Refers to the removal of a smaller, very skinny muscle called the psoas minor, commonly referred to as the chain, runs the length of the tenderloin and is often removed before the tenderloin is sold.

name: Riblets
definition: Refers to small, narrow, and flavorful cuts of meat that come from the ribs of an animal. Riblets are obtained by cutting the rib section into smaller pieces, creating individual portions that contain a portion of the rib bones and surrounding meat.

name: Ribs short/Short ribs
definition: Refers to a specific cut of ribs that comes from the lower portion of the animal's ribcage.

name: Roast cut
definition: Refers to a specific type of meat cut that is intended for roasting. The term "roast cut" does not refer to a specific part of an animal but rather to the way the meat is prepared and cooked.

name: Shank
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat that comes from the lower leg portion of an animal. The shank is located between the knee and the hoof of the animal.

name: Shoulder cushion
definition: Refers to a specific and relatively lesser-known cut of meat that comes from the shoulder area of an animal. The shoulder cushion is sometimes referred to as shoulder tender.

name: Shoulder pectoralis
definition: Refers to the pectoralis muscles are usually included in larger sections of shoulder meat.

name: Shoulder picnic lower half
definition: Refers to a specific portion of the shoulder cut known as the picnic shoulder or picnic ham. The shoulder picnic lower half comes from the lower portion of the front leg closer to the foot or hock area.

name: Shoulder teres major
definition: Refers to a specific and relatively lesser-known cut of meat that comes from the shoulder area of an animal. The teres major muscle is a small, triangular muscle located in the shoulder region, adjacent to the more well-known and larger shoulder tender or petite tender muscle.

name: Side
definition: Refers to one half of a large animal carcass that has been split lengthwise along the backbone. When an animal, is processed for meat, it is usually divided into two sides. Each side contains one half of the animal's carcass.

name: Skirt
definition: Refers to a separate cut of meat that comes from the diaphragm area of the animal. It is a thin, long, and grainy cut. Also known as skirt steak.

name: Special trim
definition: Refers to a specific request or custom preparation of meat made by a customer or chef to meet their specific requirements or preferences. It involves trimming or cutting the meat in a particular way that differs from the standard or conventional cuts typically offered by the butcher.

name: Steak
definition: A steak is a crosswise cut made perpendicular to the spine.

name: Striploin
definition: Refers to a specific and popular cut of meat that comes from the loin primal section of the animal. The striploin is located in the loin primal section, which runs along the back of the animal, just behind the rib section and before the sirloin.

name: Leg long cut style 3
definition:
Refers to a leg cut that is the same as style 2 except that flank muscles (M. rectus
abdominis, M. obliquus internus abdominis, M. obliquus externus abdominis),
vertebrae, hip bone along with overlying lean and fat, lean and fat overlying the
quadriceps (fore cushion), M. psoas major, and M. iliacus shall be removed.

name: Sub-primal
definition: Refers to a large cut of meat that is derived from one of the primary sections of an animal carcass. The primary sections, known as "primal cuts," are large sections that are separated during the initial butchering process. Sub-primals are subsequently derived from these primal cuts and further broken down into retail cuts.

name: Tail on
definition: The animal with its tail on / with its tail.

name: Thick
definition: Refers to the measurement or thickness of a meat cut. When the term refers to a cut of meat as "thick," it means that the cut has been sliced or portioned to be wider and have more depth than thinner cuts.

name: Tongue
definition: Refers to the muscular organ found in the mouth of animals. The tongue is a versatile and unique type of offal or variety meat that is consumed in many cultures and cuisines around the world.

name: Top sirloin
definition: Refers to a specific and popular cut that comes from the sirloin primal section of the animal. The top sirloin is located in the sirloin primal section of the carcass. It is situated above the bottom sirloin and behind the tenderloin.

name: Undercut
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat that is taken from the underside or ventral portion of an animal. The undercut comes from the area of the animal that is located beneath the loin and rib primal sections. It is situated on the ventral side, closer to the belly.

name: Uterus
definition: Refers to the reproductive organ found in female animals. In some culinary traditions, the uterus is considered a type of offal or variety meat and is used as food. It is known by various names, such as womb or matrix.

name: 4 way cut
definition: Refers to meat cut in 4 sections. Please refer to the animal to determine the exact parts that are cut.

name: 6 way cut
definition: Refers to meat cut in 6 sections. Please refer to the animal to determine the exact parts that are cut.

name: Backstrap/Backstrip
definition: Refers to a long, cylindrical muscle that runs along the spine on the inside of the ribs. It is located on the opposite side of the belly or brisket.

name: Belly
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat that comes from the underside or abdominal area of an animal.

name: Boneless
definition: Refers to a specific meat cut that has been prepared by removing the bones from the piece of meat.

name: Bottom/Bottom round
definition: Refers to the upper portion of the rear legs around the hip and rump area. The Bottom round comes from the Round primal.

name: Brain
definition: Refers to the organ that is a part of the central nervous system found in the heads of animals. In culinary terms, "brain" specifically refers to the brain of certain animals, usually those that are commonly consumed for food.

name: Brisket
definition: Refers to a specific meat cut that comes from the breast or lower chest area of an animal.

name: Brisket deckle off
definition: Refers to a specific preparation of the brisket cut where the deckle (also known as the point or deckle point) has been removed.

name: Chuck
definition: Refers to a specific portion of meat that is obtained from the front section of the animal's carcass, particularly from the shoulder and neck area. The chuck is a primal cut, and it contains a mix of muscles, connective tissue, and some bone.

name: Chuck roll
definition: Refers to a specific meat cut that is obtained from the chuck primal of a beef carcass. The chuck roll is a cylindrical piece of meat that runs along the front shoulder area of the animal. It is a boneless cut that consists of several muscles, connective tissue, and some fat.

name: Collar butt
definition: Refers to a unique boneless cut that comes from the inner portions of the shoulder.

name: Cutlet
definition: Refers to a thin, boneless piece of meat that is sometimes breaded and/or fried. The meat used for cutlets can come from various sources.

name: Eye of forequarter
definition: Refers to the preparing the forequarter by removing the eye muscle portion lying along the spinous processes and transverse processes and the thoracic vertebrae. Also know as neck fillet.

name: Filleted
definition: Cut or prepared as a fillet.

name: Flap
definition: Refers to a specific meat cut that comes from the abdominal area of an animal. It is also known as flap meat or flap steak.

name: Half
definition: Refers to half of an animal.

name: Heart
definition: Refers to the muscular organ that pumps blood throughout the circulatory system of an animal. The heart is a vital organ and an edible part of the animal that is used for culinary purposes in various cuisines around the world.

name: Hindquarter
definition: Refers to the back half of an animal's carcass, specifically the rear portion of the body. It includes the hind legs or limbs, hip, and associated cuts of meat.

name: Hindshank
definition: Refers to a specific cut of meat obtained from the lower portion of the hind leg or limb of an animal. The hindshank is located just below the knee joint, where the leg connects to the rest of the carcass.

name: Hock
definition: Refers to the joint or the lower portion of the leg of an animal. In pigs, the hock is specifically known as the pork hock or ham hock.

name: Leg outside eye
definition: Refers to a specific portion of the leg primal cut from an animal. The outside eye is a particular muscle or portion within the leg that has distinct characteristics and culinary uses. In beef, the "leg outside eye" is commonly known as the outside round or bottom round. In pork is found in the ham primal cut. In lamb is located in the leg of lamb cut.

name: Long/Long cut
definition: Refers to a specific type of meat cut that involves slicing the meat parallel to its natural grain or muscle fibers. This results in longer, more elongated pieces of meat.

name: Mixed offal
definition: Refers to a collection of various edible organs and organ meats from an animal, excluding the standard cuts of muscle meat. Offal, also known as variety meats or organ meats, consists of internal organs such as the liver, heart, kidneys, sweetbreads, tongue, brain, tripe (stomach lining), and sometimes even the lungs, spleen, and other lesser-known parts.

name: Mixed parts
definition: Refers to a combination of different cuts of meat and pieces obtained from an animal during the butchering process.

name: Other
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

name: Pair
definition: Refers to a pair of pieces of meat.

name: Pancreas
definition: Refers to an internal organ found in the abdominal cavity of animals, including livestock and game animals. The pancreas is a glandular organ that serves essential functions in the digestive and endocrine systems.

name: Pistola hindquarter
definition: Refers to the preparation from a hindquarter by the removal of the thin flank, lateral portion ribs and portion of the navel end brisket. A cut is made commencing at the superficial inguinal lymph node separating the M. rectus abdominus and following the contour of the hip, running parallel to the bodies of the vertebrae approximately 50mm from the M. longissimus dorsi (eye muscle) to the specified rib.

name: Ribs spare/Spare ribs
definition: Refers to a specific cut of ribs obtained from the lower portion of the animal's ribcage, closer to the belly.

name: Roasting full
definition: Refers to the full animal carcass, suitable for roasting.

name: Roasting split
definition: Refers to a specific method of roasting where a cut of meat is split or opened along its natural seam or bone structure before being cooked.

name: Semiboneless
definition: Refers to a specific type of meat cut where some of the bones have been removed from the meat, but not all of them. It is a term commonly used for cuts of meat that are intended to be easier to handle and cook while still retaining some of the benefits of bone-in meat.

name: Shank end
definition: Refers to a specific portion of a cut of meat or a joint that includes the shank or leg bone.

name: Short/Short cut
definition: Refers to a specific type of meat cut that involves slicing the meat perpendicular to its grain, resulting in shorter and more compact pieces.

name: Silverside
definition: Refers to a specific cut of beef that comes from the hindquarters of the animal. Silverside comes from the hind leg of the carcass, specifically from the outside of the upper leg, just above the knee joint.

name: Square cut/Squared
definition: Refers to a specific cutting technique used to prepare meat or poultry. When a piece of meat is square cut, it means that the butcher has made straight, even cuts across the meat, resulting in a block-like or square shape.

name: Leg long cut style 1
definition: Refers to a leg cut is separated from the split carcass side by a straight cut approximately perpendicular to a line parallel to the vertebral column between the 6th and 7th lumbar vertebrae and passing through a point immediately anterior to the hip bone (ilium) and related cartilage. The hind foot is removed at the tarsal joint.

name: Leg long cut style 2
definition:
Refers to a leg cut that is the same as style 1 except the tail (caudal) vertebrae, flank
muscle (M. rectus abdominis), M. cutaneus trunci, and exposed lymph glands shall
be removed.

name: Tenderloin
definition: Refers to a specific and highly prized cut of meat that comes from the loin primal section of an animal. The tenderloin is located along the backbone, inside the ribcage, in the loin primal section of the animal.

name: Tendons
definition: Refers to the tough, fibrous connective tissues that connect muscles to bones in an animal's body.

name: Testicles/Testes
definition: Refers to the male reproductive organs of animals. In some culinary traditions and cultures, testicles are considered a type of offal or "variety meat" and are consumed as food. They are often referred to by specific names based on the animal they come from.

name: Top butt
definition: Refers to a specific cut that comes from the sirloin primal section of the animal. The top butt is also known by other names, such as top sirloin butt or "op sirloin cap. The top butt is located in the sirloin primal section of the carcass. It is situated above the bottom sirloin and behind the tenderloin.

name: Trimmed
definition: Refers to the process of removing excess fat, connective tissue, and any undesirable or inedible portions from a meat cut. When a cut of meat is "trimmed," it is prepared to have a more uniform appearance, improve its presentation, and enhance its cooking qualities.

name: Trunk
definition: Refers to the main body of an animal, particularly the torso or central part that contains the chest and abdominal cavities.

name: Purple shades
definition: This code indicates that the product is intended to be used to obtain a purple hair colour, e.g., violet, mauve, lavender.

name: Grey shades
definition: This code indicates that the product is intended to be used to obtain a grey hair colour, e.g., platinum, silver, cool grey.

name: Black shades
definition: This code indicates that the product is intended to be used to obtain a black hair colour, e.g., charcoal, ebony, smoky black.

name: Blonde shades
definition: This code indicates that the product is intended to be used to obtain a blonde hair colour, e.g., sandy blonde, warm blonde, champagne blonde.

name: Brown shades
definition: This code indicates that the product is intended to be used to obtain a brown hair colour, e.g., auburn, almond, chocolate.

name: Red shades
definition: This code indicates that the product is intended to be used to obtain a red hair colour, e.g., burgundy, cerise, wine.

name: Other shades
definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

name: Blue shades
definition: This code indicates that the product is intended to be used to obtain a blue hair colour, e.g., azure, cobalt blue, indigo.

definition: The product has ingredient(s) that causes the flavour/scent of acai berry.

name: Czech General Health Insurance Code (VZP)
definition: Classification system of medical devices managed by the General Health Insurance Company of the Czech Republic. It is used to calculate payments between insurance companies and healthcare providers in the Czech Republic. The code consists of seven digits.
codeListDefinition: Code list developed and managed by GS1.

name: Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP) reference
definition: The Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP) is an online database created by the European Union for the implementation of Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, in which cosmetics are registered and documented. Each product is assigned a unique CPNP reference when it is registered.

name: SUKL code (Czech Republic)
definition: The SÚKL code is a unique identifier used by the State Institute for Drug Control (SÚKL) in the Czech Republic. It uniquely identifies a specific medicinal product or medical device in the SÚKL database.

name: National Allowance Pricing Agreement Local Stock Number
definition: National Allowance Pricing Agreement Local Stock Number is a specific identification code used within a national pricing agreement framework to track and manage inventory at a local level.

name: Bee pollen
definition: Definition (includes Common Name): Refers to the presence of bee pollen and its derivatives in the product. - Family/Genus/Species: Pollen - Also known as: Bee bread, ambrosia or perga - Disclaimer: Refers to the presence of the allergen in the product, as listed in the regulations specified by an agency and specification or any local market regulations.

name: Cola nut/kola nut
definition: Definition (includes Common Name): Refers to the presence of cola nut and its derivatives in the product. - Family/Genus/Species: Sterculiaceae - Also known as: Kola nut, cola acuminata and cola nitida - Disclaimer: Refers to the presence of the allergen in the product, as listed in the regulations specified by an agency and specification or any local market regulations.

name: Citric acid
definition: Definition (includes Common Name): Refers to the presence of Citric Acid in the product. - CAS Registry Number: 77-92-9 - Also known as: Aciletten, anhydrous citric acid, beta-hydroxytricarballylic acid, 2-hydroxy-1,2,3-propanetricarboxylic acid, 3-carboxy-3-hydroxypentane-1,5-dioic acid, kyselina citronova - Disclaimer: Refers to the presence of the allergen in the product, as listed in the regulations specified by an agency and specification or any local market regulations.

name: Palm nut
definition: Definition (includes Common Name): Refers to the presence of palm nut and its derivatives in the product. - Family/Genus/Species: Arecaceae/Elaeis - Also known as: Palmae - Disclaimer: Refers to the presence of the allergen in the product, as listed in the regulations specified by an agency and specification or any local market regulations.

name: Propolis
definition: Definition (includes Common Name): Refers to the presence of propolis and its derivatives in the product. - Family/Genus/Species: None - Also known as: Bee glue - Disclaimer: Refers to the presence of the allergen in the product, as listed in the regulations specified by an agency and specification or any local market regulations.

name: Royal jelly
definition: Definition (includes Common Name): Refers to the presence of royal jelly and its derivatives in the product. - Family/Genus/Species: Honey bee - Also known as: Bee saliva, bee spit, gelée royale, honey bee milk, honey bee's milk, jalea real, lait des abeilles, or royal bee jelly - Disclaimer: Refers to the presence of the allergen in the product, as listed in the regulations specified by an agency and specification or any local market regulations.

name: Camphor
definition: White, crystalline substance obtained from the wood of the camphor tree.

name: Chemical
definition: A substance with a distinct molecular composition that is produced by or used in a chemical process.

name: Chlorine
definition: A chemical used as a disinfectant.

name: DEET
definition: DEET, or N,N-diethyl-meta-toluamide, is a synthetic chemical in many insect repellents.

name: Detergent
definition: A cleansing agent, especially synthetic, used for cleaning fabrics, dishes, and other surfaces.

name: Drug
definition: A substance used for medical treatment, particularly one that affects the mind or body.

name: Dye
definition: A substance used to add colour to materials such as fabrics, hair, or food.

name: Estrogen
definition: Primary female sex hormone which regulates the reproductive system and sexual characteristics.

name: Keratin
definition: Structural protein in the outer layer of human skin, hair, and nails, and animal hooves and horns.

name: Lead
definition: A dense metallic element with the symbol Pb, often used in batteries, shielding, and various alloys.

name: Lotion
definition: Preparation with a creamy consistency, applied to the skin for moisturizing or medicinal purposes.

name: Lye
definition: Strong alkaline substance, typically sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide.

name: Mercury
definition: A heavy, silvery d-block element, liquid at room temperature, used in thermometers and barometers.

name: Odor
definition: A distinctive smell, often detected by the sense of olfaction.

name: Paba
definition: Para-aminobenzoic acid, a chemical compound often used in sunscreen formulations.

name: Perfume
definition: A fragrant liquid made from essential oils and aroma compounds used to provide a pleasant scent.

name: Petrolatum
definition: Semi-solid mixture of hydrocarbons, commonly used for its moisturizing properties.

name: Sodium lauryl sulfate
definition: Surfactant and detergent commonly found in personal care products and cleaning agents.

name: Steroid
definition: Organic compound with a molecular structure containing four rings, used to treat inflammation.

name: Talc
definition: Mineral composed of hydrated magnesium silicate, used for its soft and absorbent properties.

name: Taste aversive agent
definition: A taste aversive or bittering agent is a chemical substance that is added to a product to help deter inappropriate ingestion and prevent poisonings from occurring. Denatonium benzoate, commonly sold under brand names like Bitrex® or Denatrol®, is one of the most widely used substances.

name: Toluene
definition: Clear liquid aromatic hydrocarbon, used as an industrial solvent and in paint, varnish, adhesive.

name: Unscented
definition: Unscented refers to a product having no added fragrance or scent.

name: Liver only
definition: The liver is an organ which processes blood and helps to clean unwanted substances out of it.

name: Shell on
definition: Fish or seafood with its shell on.

name: Shell removed
definition: Meat from fish or seafood with shell removed / without shell.

name: Skinned fillets
definition: Cut or prepared as a fillet and skin removed.

name: Tail
definition: The tail of a sea animal is the end of its body including the fins / tail fins.

name: Tongue only
definition: The tongue is the muscular organ found in the mouth of sea animals.

name: California Certified Organic Farmers (CCOF)
definition: California Certified Organic Farmers (CCOF) is a nonprofit organization that provides organic certification, education, and advocacy to support and promote organic agriculture in California and beyond.

name: Ecocert
definition: Ecocert is an international certification body that sets standards and provides certification for sustainable practices in agriculture, cosmetics, and other industries, ensuring compliance with environmental and social criteria.

name: Where Food Comes From (WFCF)
definition: Where Food Comes From, Inc., is an independent, third-party food verification company.

name: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)
definition: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) is an internationally recognized certification for textiles made from organic fibers, ensuring environmental and social criteria are met throughout the supply chain.

name: Organic Crop Improvement Association (OCIA)
definition: OCIA International is an organic certification agency. OCIA certifies and verifies farm, livestock, processor/handlers, broker-traders, Community Grower Groups (CGGs), and Private Labels to various programs.

name: Oregon Tilth
definition: Oregon Tilth is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting and advocating for organic food and farming practices.
